人工智能代理已经可以自主执行高能物理实验AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics

埃里克·A·莫雷诺[*†][1,2]，塞缪尔·布莱特-托尼[Eric A. Moreno[∗†][1,2] , Samuel Bright-Thonney[][‡][1,2] , 安杰伊·诺瓦克[][‡][1,2] , Andrzej Novak[][§][1,2]、多洛雷斯·加西亚[¶][3] 和菲利普·哈里斯[‖][1,2]][§][1,2] , Dolores Garcia[¶][3] , and Philip Harris[‖][1,2]

1麻省理工学院物理系1Department of Physics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology

2NSF AI 人工智能和基本交互研究所 3CERN2NSF AI Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Fundamental Interactions 3CERN

2026 年 3 月 23 日March 23, 2026

摘要Abstract

基于大型语言模型的人工智能代理现在能够以最少的专家策划输入自主执行高能物理 (HEP) 分析管道的大部分。通过访问 HEP 数据集、执行框架和先前实验文献的语料库，我们发现 Claude Code 成功地自动化了典型分析的所有阶段：事件选择、背景估计、不确定性量化、统计推断和论文起草。我们认为，实验性 HEP 社区低估了这些系统当前的功能，并且大多数提出的代理工作流程的范围过于狭窄或仅限于特定的分析结构。我们提出了一个概念验证框架，Large language model-based AI agents are now able to autonomously execute substantial portions of a high energy physics (HEP) analysis pipeline with minimal expert-curated input. Given access to a HEP dataset, an execution framework, and a corpus of prior experimental literature, we find that Claude Code succeeds in automating all stages of a typical analysis: event selection, background estimation, uncertainty quantification, statistical inference, and paper drafting. We argue that the experimental HEP community is underestimating the current capabilities of these systems, and that most proposed agentic workflows are too narrowly scoped or scaffolded to specific analysis structures. We present a proof-of-concept framework,只需提供上下文Just Furnish Context（JFC），它将自主分析代理与基于文献的知识检索和多代理审查相结合，并表明这足以规划、执行和记录可信的高能物理分析。我们通过对来自 ALEPH、DELPHI 和 CMS 的开放数据进行分析来证明这一点，以执行电弱、QCD 和希格斯玻色子测量。这些工具不会取代物理学家，而是有望减轻分析代码开发的重复性技术负担，使研究人员能够专注于物理洞察、真正新颖的方法开发和严格的验证。鉴于这些发展，我们倡导社区如何培训学生、组织分析工作和分配人力专业知识的新策略。(JFC), that integrates autonomous analysis agents with literature-based knowledge retrieval and multi-agent review, and show that this is sufficient to plan, execute, and document a credible high energy physics analysis. We demonstrate this by conducting analyses on open data from ALEPH, DELPHI, and CMS to perform electroweak, QCD, and Higgs boson measurements. Rather than replacing physicists, these tools promise to offload the repetitive technical burden of analysis code development, freeing researchers to focus on physics insight, truly novel method development, and rigorous validation. Given these developments, we advocate for new strategies for how the community trains students, organizes analysis efforts, and allocates human expertise.

1 简介1 Introduction

典型的实验高能物理分析是一项长达数年的工作，通常跨越学术机构研究生或博士后的大部分时间。对于大型对撞机实验，该过程是算法性的：物理学家（a）识别有趣的测量通道或新的物理特征，（b）研究现有文献以了解如何完成类似的测量，（c）使用蒙特卡罗（MC）模拟设计和验证事件选择程序，量化系统不确定性的所有相关来源，最后（d）对真实实验数据进行“揭盲”并执行统计假设检验以提取测量或限制。A typical experimental high energy physics analysis is a years-long endeavor, often spanning the majority of a graduate student or postdoc’s time at an academic institution. For large collider experiments the process is algorithmic: a physicist (a) identifies an interesting measurement channel or new physics signature, (b) studies existing literature to understand how similar measurements have been done, (c) designs and validates an event selection procedure using Monte Carlo (MC) simulation, quantifies all relevant sources of systematic uncertainty, and finally (d) “unblinds” on real experimental data and performs statistical hypothesis tests to extract measurements or limits.

这个过程总是涉及编写数千行代码来处理数据并应用标准的（尽管不是现成的）分析技术，其中大部分在结构上与同一协作中的数十个其他分析中编写的代码相似。虽然这对于开发编程来说是一个有用的练习This process invariably involves writing thousands of lines of code to process data and apply standard, though not off-the-shelf, analysis techniques, most of which is structurally similar to code written in dozens of other analyses within the same collaboration. While this can be a useful exercise for developing programming

它通常会占用物理学家很大一部分工作时间，并且几乎不需要物理推理或洞察力。由于实验合作中的许多核心软件基础设施缺乏高质量、集中或最新的文档，这种情况经常会加剧。结果是一个缓慢、容易出错且乏味的过程，除了短暂的初始学习阶段之外，对学生的教育几乎没有什么帮助，并且剥夺了所有从业者本来可以更好地花在更高层次问题上的宝贵时间。skills, it often consumes a substantial fraction of a physicist’s working time and demands little physics reasoning or insight. This is frequently exacerbated by the absence of high-quality, centralized, or up-to-date documentation for much of the core software infrastructure within experimental collaborations. The result is a slow, error-prone, and tedious process that, beyond a brief initial learning phase, adds little to a student’s education and robs all practitioners of valuable time that could be better spent on higher-level questions.

在本文中，我们认为这个过程的大部分可以委托给人工智能代理。现代编码助理可以自主编写和执行代码、访问文档（本地和在线）、迭代地批评和调试自己的输出，并为人类监督者记录他们的进度 [14, 2]。随着大型语言模型（LLM）和商业代理框架的不断改进，这些工具只会变得更加可靠。In this paper, we argue that the majority of this process can be delegated to AI agents. Modern coding assistants can autonomously write and execute code, access documentation (both local and online), iteratively critique and debug their own output, and document their progress for human overseers [14, 2]. As large language models (LLMs) and commercial agentic frameworks continue to improve, these tools will only become more reliable.

这并不是对未来能力的推测。在本文中，我们表明，给定一个提炼大型 HEP 合作实践中使用的过程的通用框架和初始的高级物理提示，Claude Code[1] 能够生成完整的分析：事件选择、背景估计、系统不确定性评估、统计推断和带有出版级数据的书面报告。经过粗略的专家审查，报告的质量通常与初级研究生（或时间有限的专家）制作的报告没有什么区别。 Badea 等人的最新工作。 [4] 证明，人工智能代理在每一步都有物理学家的迭代监督，可以为使用 LEP 开放数据的测量做出贡献。我们以此为基础，但采取了根本不同的方法：JFC 不需要持续的人类反馈，而是将审查委托给专门的人工智能代理，将人类监督集中在一个单一的非盲门上，从而产生一个几乎完全自主的框架。This is not a speculative claim about future capabilities. In this paper we show that, given a general framework distilling the processes used in practice at large HEP collaborations and an initial high-level physics prompt, Claude Code[1] is able to produce a complete analysis: event selection, background estimation, systematic uncertainty evaluation, statistical inference, and a written report with publication-grade figures. The report quality is typically, at a cursory expert review, indistinguishable from a report produced by a junior graduate student (or an expert under time constraints). Recent work by Badea et al. [4] demonstrated that an AI agent, with iterative physicist supervision at each step, can contribute to a measurement using LEP open data. We build on this direction but take a fundamentally different approach: rather than requiring continuous human feedback, JFC delegates review to specialized AI agents, concentrating human oversight at a single unblinding gate, yielding a nearly fully autonomous framework.

框架规范大致分为三个独立的部分：The framework specification splits roughly into three independent components:

  • 方法论Methodology。我们对典型的粒子物理分析工作流程进行了编码，从规划和数据探索到统计分析。这种结构虽然通常没有明确说明，但通常作为科学合作和研究小组中的机构知识存在。粗略地说，这相当于研究生在论文研究过程中所获得的指导。. We encode what a typical particle physics analysis workflow looks like, from planning and data exploration to statistical analysis. This structure, while not usually explicitly spelled out, generally lives as institutional knowledge in scientific collaborations and research groups. Roughly, this corresponds to the guidance a graduate student would receive as they progress through their thesis research.

  • 评论Review。研究方法的另一个方面是科学合作如何确保其发表的结果是准确的。通常有一个官方评审流程，从小组内的初级博士后到合作中领导分析小组的高级博士后，再到有效充当内部期刊审稿人的高级学者。为了模拟这一点，我们在分析的每一步对评论子代理层进行编码。. A separate aspect of the research methodology is how a scientific collaboration ensures that its published results are accurate. There is typically an official review process that progresses in tiers from junior postdocs within a group to senior postdocs leading analysis groups within collaborations, to senior academics who effectively function as internal journal reviewers. To simulate this, we encode tiers of review subagents at every step of the analysis.

  • 一般代理行为General agent behavior。为了管理上下文窗口，方法中概述的分析步骤被发送到单独的子代理。然而，这些代理仍然需要了解整体分析背景和计划。因此，我们对每个代理接收和输出的内容（在操作上，没有物理信息）以及允许人类探索和验证该过程的日志进行了严格的规范编码，并且还有助于对复杂故障进行代理级调试。. In order to manage context windows, the analysis steps outlined in the methodology are sent to separate subagents. However, these agents still need to know the overall analysis context and plan. We therefore encode a strict specification of what each agent receives and outputs (operationally, no physics information), as well as a log that allows the process to be explored and verified by humans and that also facilitates agent-level debugging of complex failures.

  • 特定领域的约定Domain-specific conventions。最后，我们指定一组隔离良好的所需约定，例如工具使用、可视化或更晦涩或最新的分析技术。对这个基线水平进行编码似乎是不可避免的，因为通用模型无法正确猜测因领域而异的特定约定。. Finally, we specify a well-isolated set of desired conventions, such as tool use, visualizations, or more obscure or recent analysis techniques. Encoding this baseline level seems unavoidable, as general models are unable to correctly guess the specific conventions that vary greatly by field.

本文附录中提出的分析完全由人工智能代理对存档的开放 ALEPH 和 DELPHI 数据以及来自大型正负电子 (LEP) 对撞机的蒙特卡罗模拟和来自大型强子对撞机 (LHC) [7] 的 CMS 开放数据进行操作，代理可以选择通过结构化检索系统访问已发表的 LEP 论文中的领域知识。The analyses presented in the appendices of this paper were produced entirely by AI agents operating on archived open ALEPH and DELPHI data and Monte Carlo simulation from the Large Electron-Positron (LEP) collider and CMS Open Data from the Large Hadron Collider (LHC)[7], with the agents optionally accessing domain knowledge from published LEP papers through a structured retrieval system.

重要的是，Importantly,我们并不将这些分析视为合法的科学结果，而是展示当前代理系统可以完全自主产生的 HEP 分析水平we do not present these analyses as legitimate scientific results, but rather to showcase the level of HEP analysis that current agentic systems can produce entirely autonomously，仅基于简短的物理提示和我们作为如何完成物理分析的脚手架呈现的框架。, based only on a short physics prompt and the framework we present as scaffolding for how a physics analysis is done.我们认为，这需要重新思考 HEP 合作中主流分析工作的完成方式以及学生劳动力的利用方式。We believe this warrants rethinking how mainstream analysis work is done in HEP collaborations and how student labor is utilized.这些发展也有These developments also have

图 1：如何使用 AI 代理工作流程来反映典型的高能物理分析工作流程的图表。在左侧，我们展示了典型的分析管道，通常从遗留代码开始，然后对其进行修改以执行分析。分析通常涉及 3 个或更多级别的审查，从其他博士后、学生和合作分析的教师的反馈（办公室反馈）开始。下一层通常在分析子组（通俗称为 3 级组）中完成。第二层审查涉及预批准阶段，其中物理小组召集人审查分析，然后进行正式的合作审查，得出结果并提交出版。在右侧，等效的交互式工作流程可以完全由人工智能代理处理，从想法的构思到结果，然后经过类似的协作审查，然后发布。Figure 1: Diagram of how an AI-agent workflow can be used to mirror the typical high-energy physics analysis workflow. On the left, we show the typical analysis pipeline, which usually starts with legacy code that is then modified to perform the analysis. Analyses typically involve 3 or more levels of review, starting with feedback from other postdocs, students, and faculty collaborating on the analysis (office feedback). The next tier is typically done in an analysis subgroup (colloquially referred to as a level 3 group). The second tier of review involves a pre-approval phase, in which physics group conveners review an analysis, followed by a formal collaboration review leading to a result and a submission for publication. On the right side, an equivalent interactive workflow can be entirely handled by AI agents, from the conception of an idea through a result that would then undergo a similar collaboration review, followed by publication.

超出常规分析的影响：它们实现了系统的可重复性研究，降低了重新分析存档数据集的障碍，并促进了分析工作流程的严格记录——所有这些都是该领域长期存在的挑战，但在历史上却因大规模开展这些工作所需的大量人力和专业知识而受到阻碍。implications beyond routine analysis: they enable systematic reproducibility studies, lower the barrier to reanalyzing archived datasets, and facilitate rigorous documentation of analysis workflows—all longstanding challenges in the field, historically hindered by the significant human effort and expertise required to carry them out at scale.

我们强调，我们并不是要求人工智能代理取代人类产生科学成果。任何人工智能辅助分析的最终输出都必须经过领域专家的彻底检查、理解和验证，然后才能被视为科学结果，并且必须接受与任何其他合作论文相同的内部审查。我们也不声称当前的代理可以处理每项分析的各个方面；涉及新技术、定制重建算法或多个系统不确定性之间微妙相互作用的复杂分析将继续需要大量的人工参与。智能体会犯错误，有时是微妙的错误，而人类必须继续负责判断他们的输出，并对他们的错误承担公开责任。最重要的是，我们的创造力、专业知识和判断力定义了这些工具将帮助我们追求的研究议程。We emphasize that we are not calling for AI agents to supplant humans in producing scientific results. The final output of any AI-assisted analysis must be thoroughly checked, understood, and validated by domain experts before it can be considered a scientific result, and must undergo the same internal scrutiny as any other collaboration paper. We also do not claim that current agents can handle every aspect of every analysis; complex analyses involving novel techniques, bespoke reconstruction algorithms, or subtle interplay between multiple systematic uncertainties will continue to require substantial hands-on human involvement. Agents make mistakes, sometimes subtle ones, and humans must remain responsible for judging their outputs and be held publicly accountable for their mistakes. Most importantly, it is our creativity, expertise, and judgment that defines the research agenda these tools will help us pursue.

2 相关工作2 Related Work

人工智能代理在科学研究中的应用是一个快速发展的领域，涵盖从化学和药物发现到材料科学和数学等多个领域。在化学领域，ChemCrow [6] 使用专家设计的化学工具增强大型语言模型，以自主规划和执行合成任务，而 Coscientist [5] 将法学硕士与互联网搜索、代码执行和机器人实验室设备集成，以设计和进行端到端的化学实验。人工智能科学家 [16] 展示了一个完全自主的流程，从想法生成到实验执行再到论文写作。多智能体架构也被探索用于科学发现：SciAgents [11] 在材料科学的多智能体框架中将法学硕士与知识图结合起来，而 PaperQA2 [19] 通过智能检索增强生成管道在科学文献合成方面实现了超人的性能。这些努力说明了自主人工智能驱动研究的广泛趋势，但每个领域在数据复杂性、验证要求和特定领域推理的需求方面都带来了自己独特的挑战。The application of AI agents to scientific research is a rapidly growing field spanning many domains, from chemistry and drug discovery to materials science and mathematics. In chemistry, ChemCrow [6] augments large language models with expert-designed chemistry tools to autonomously plan and execute synthesis tasks, while Coscientist [5] integrates LLMs with internet search, code execution, and robotic lab equipment to design and carry out chemical experiments end-to-end. The AI Scientist [16] demonstrated a fully autonomous pipeline, from idea generation through experiment execution to paper writing. Multi-agent architectures have also been explored for scientific discovery: SciAgents [11] combines LLMs with knowledge graphs in a multi-agent framework for materials science, while PaperQA2 [19] achieves superhuman performance on scientific literature synthesis through an agentic retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. These efforts illustrate a broad trend toward autonomous AI-driven research, but each domain brings its own unique challenges in terms of data complexity, validation requirements, and the need for domain-specific reasoning.

在高能物理 (HEP) 领域，过去一年，人们对将基于 LLM 的代理应用于分析工作流程的兴趣显着增长，并出现了一些并行和互补的工作。最近的一篇社区愿景论文 [1] 概述了为实验粒子物理构建人工智能原生研究生态系统的巨大挑战，为当前和未来的设施如何从人工智能集成中受益提供了高级路线图。我们回顾了下面以 HEP 为重点的代理人工智能工作的现有情况，按照它们处理的任务类型进行组织。Within high energy physics (HEP), interest in applying LLM-based agents to analysis workflows has grown significantly in the past year, with several concurrent and complementary efforts emerging. A community vision paper [1] recently outlined grand challenges for building an AI-native research ecosystem for experimental particle physics, providing a high-level roadmap for how current and future facilities can benefit from AI integration. We review the existing landscape of HEP-focused agentic AI efforts below, organized by the type of task they address.

2.1 数据分析代理2.1 Agents for data analysis

最直接相关的先前工作是 Gendreau-Distler 等人的工作。 [10]，提出了一个 LLM 代理驱动的数据分析框架。他们的系统将基于 LLM 的主管编码器代理与 Snakemake 工作流程管理器配对，使用 ATLAS Open Data 自动执行希格斯玻色子双光子横截面测量。工作流管理器强制执行可重复性和确定性，而代理则生成、执行并迭代地纠正分析代码。作者对 Gemini、GPT 和 Claude 系列的几个最先进的法学硕士以及领先的开放权重模型进行了基准测试。然而，值得注意的是，作者自己指出，“多步骤任务规划超出了他们系统的当前范围”[10]，强调代理在相当严格的预定义分析结构中运行，而不是根据高级规范自主规划和执行完整分析。The most directly relevant prior work is that of Gendreau-Distler et al. [10], who present an LLM-agent-driven data analysis framework. Their system pairs an LLM-based supervisor-coder agent with the Snakemake workflow manager to automate a Higgs boson diphoton cross-section measurement using ATLAS Open Data. The workflow manager enforces reproducibility and determinism, while the agent generates, executes, and iteratively corrects analysis code. The authors benchmark several state-of-the-art LLMs spanning the Gemini, GPT, and Claude families, as well as leading open-weight models. Notably, however, the authors themselves state that “multi-step task planning is beyond the current scope” of their system [10], highlighting that the agent operates within a fairly rigid, pre-defined analysis structure rather than autonomously planning and executing a full analysis from a high-level specification.

迪芬巴赫等人。 [8] 使用 LHC Olympics 数据集 [15] 研究基于 LLM 的代理进行异常检测，证明代理设置可以开发和测试反映人类最先进表现的分析方法。他们的研究对提示策略和法学硕士模型进行了系统比较，对多次运行的稳定性、成本和可重复性进行了基准测试。这项工作值得注意的是，它表明智能体可以独立地得出合理的分析策略，例如将碰撞搜索与 CWoLa 等弱监督方法相结合，而无需明确指示这样做。Diefenbacher et al. [8] investigate LLM-based agents for anomaly detection using the LHC Olympics dataset [15], demonstrating that agentic setups can develop and test analysis methods that mirror human state-of-the-art performance. Their study provides a systematic comparison of prompting strategies and LLM models, benchmarking stability, cost, and reproducibility across multiple runs. This work is notable for showing that agents can independently arrive at sensible analysis strategies—such as combining bump hunts with weakly supervised approaches like CWoLa—without being explicitly instructed to do so.

门佐等人。提出了 HEPTAPOD [18]，这是一个编排框架，使大型语言模型能够与特定领域的 HEP 工具交互、构建模拟工作流程并管理多步骤研究流程。该系统使用模式验证的操作和运行卡驱动的配置来确保可重复性，并在具有代表性的 BSM 蒙特卡罗验证管道上进行了演示，涵盖统一工作流程中的模型生成、事件模拟和下游分析。通过在人类研究人员、法学硕士和计算基础设施之间提供结构化和可审计的层，HEPTAPOD 专注于上游模拟和工作流程管理问题，而不是端到端数据分析，并强调整个过程中的人在环监督。Menzo et al. present HEPTAPOD [18], an orchestration framework that enables large language models to interface with domain-specific HEP tools, construct simulation workflows, and manage multi-step research pipelines. The system uses schema-validated operations and run-card-driven configuration to ensure reproducibility, and is demonstrated on a representative BSM Monte Carlo validation pipeline spanning model generation, event simulation, and downstream analysis within a unified workflow. By providing a structured and auditable layer between human researchers, LLMs, and computational infrastructure, HEPTAPOD focuses on the upstream simulation and workflow management problem rather than end-to-end data analysis, and emphasizes human-in-the-loop oversight throughout the process.

最近，Badea 等人。 [4] 提出了一种使用 LEP 开放数据与代理人工智能物理学家合作进行的概念验证测量。他们的方法依赖于迭代的人机交互循环，其中物理学家在每次代理尝试后提供详细的反馈，指导分析得出正确的结果。在证明代理可以对实际测量做出有意义的贡献的同时，这种监督Most recently, Badea et al. [4] present a proof-of-concept measurement using LEP open data with an agentic AI–physicist collaboration. Their approach relies on an iterative human-in-the-loop cycle in which the physicist provides detailed feedback after each agent attempt, guiding the analysis toward a correct result. While demonstrating that agents can contribute meaningfully to a real measurement, this supervised

4

工作流程与我们提出的自主方法有根本的不同：在 JFC 中，多智能体审查取代了分析开发过程中的人类反馈循环，并且人类监督集中在一个正式的非盲门上，而不是分布在整个过程中。workflow differs fundamentally from the autonomous approach we propose: in JFC, multi-agent review replaces the human feedback loop during analysis development, and human oversight is concentrated at a single formal unblinding gate rather than distributed throughout the process.

2.2 模拟和实验设计代理2.2 Agents for simulation and experiment design

GRACE [12]采取了不同的方法，针对实验设计的上游问题而不是数据分析。给定自然语言提示或已发表的实验论文，GRACE 会提取实验的结构化表示，构建可运行的模拟，并使用蒙特卡罗方法自主探索设计修改。该系统表明，探测器几何优化的代理方法可以仅使用基线模拟输入来识别与已知升级优先级一致的方向。GRACE [12] takes a different approach, targeting the upstream problem of experimental design rather than data analysis. Given a natural-language prompt or a published experimental paper, GRACE extracts a structured representation of the experiment, constructs a runnable simulation, and autonomously explores design modifications using Monte Carlo methods. The system demonstrates that an agentic approach to detector geometry optimization can identify directions consistent with known upgrade priorities, using only baseline simulation inputs.

2.3 法学硕士辅助工具包2.3 LLM-assisted toolkits

CoLLM [9] 提供了从简单语言分析规范到用于碰撞分析的训练有素的深度学习分类器的端到端管道。虽然它使用法学硕士在物理约束下生成分析代码，但它的功能更像是具有图形用户界面的人工智能辅助工具包，而不是完全自主的代理，并且特别专注于分析的深度学习分类步骤。 Xiwu [20] 是 HEP 的 LLM 助手，可以在开放权重模型之间切换并根据领域知识进行微调。CoLLM [9] provides an end-to-end pipeline from plain-language analysis specifications to trained deep learning classifiers for collider analyses. While it uses LLMs to generate analysis code under physics constraints, it functions more as an AI-assisted toolkit with a graphical user interface than as a fully autonomous agent, and focuses specifically on the deep learning classification step of an analysis. Xiwu [20] is an LLM assistant for HEP that can switch between open-weight models and be fine-tuned on domain knowledge.

2.4 基准和社区努力2.4 Benchmarks and community efforts

CelloAI 基准测试 [3] 提供了一个在 HEP 环境中评估 AI 助手的框架，重点关注代码文档和生成任务。值得注意的是，CelloAI 基准套件尚不包括物理分析任务，这使得社区系统评估 HEP 中人工智能代理最有影响力的潜在应用的能力存在差距。The CelloAI benchmarks [3] provide a framework for evaluating AI assistants in HEP contexts, focusing on code documentation and generation tasks. Notably, the CelloAI benchmark suite does not yet include physics analysis tasks, leaving a gap in the community’s ability to systematically evaluate the most impactful potential application of AI agents in HEP.

2.5 物理分析的知识检索2.5 Knowledge retrieval for physics analysis

自主分析代理面临的一个关键挑战是访问和应用现有文献中的领域知识。标准的检索增强生成（RAG）方法很难处理科学文本，因为相关信息通常跨越多个部分、图表，甚至多篇论文。麦克格雷维等人。 [17] 使用 SciTreeRAG 解决了这个问题，它利用实验物理论文的层次结构来构建文档语料库的树表示，从而实现比平面分块方法更上下文连贯的检索。他们还引入了 SciGraphRAG，它将非结构化文献转换为结构化知识图以捕获跨文档关系。这两个系统都在 LHCb 实验语料库上进行了演示。 PaperQA2 [19] 采用一种补充方法，将检索和响应生成视为多步骤代理任务，可以修改其搜索参数并在生成最终响应之前检查候选答案，从而在科学文献综合基准上实现超人的准确性。A key challenge for autonomous analysis agents is accessing and applying domain knowledge from the existing literature. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches struggle with scientific text because relevant information often spans multiple sections, figures, and even multiple papers. McGreivy et al. [17] address this with SciTreeRAG, which exploits the hierarchical structure of experimental physics papers to build a tree representation of a document corpus, enabling more contextually coherent retrieval than flat chunking approaches. They additionally introduce SciGraphRAG, which transforms unstructured literature into structured knowledge graphs to capture cross-document relationships. Both systems are demonstrated on the LHCb experiment corpus. PaperQA2 [19] takes a complementary approach, treating retrieval and response generation as a multi-step agent task that can revise its search parameters and examine candidate answers before producing a final response, achieving superhuman accuracy on scientific literature synthesis benchmarks.

2.6 总结和差距2.6 Summary and gaps

表 1 总结了上述讨论的现有 HEP 代理系统的功能。Table 1 summarizes the capabilities of the existing agentic systems for HEP discussed above.

现有的景观揭示了几个重要的模式。首先，大多数以 HEP 为中心的代理系统在高度支架化的工作流程中运行，其中分析结构是预先定义的，并且代理的角色仅限于固定步骤内的代码生成。其次，现有系统都没有将自主多步骤规划、文献领域知识检索和多智能体审查结合到一个集成框架中。第三，社区缺乏评估智能体执行现实的端到端物理分析任务的基准，这种任务需要事件选择、背景估计、系统不确定性量化和统计推断。这些差距激发了我们在以下各节中介绍的框架。The existing landscape reveals several important patterns. First, most HEP-focused agentic systems operate within highly scaffolded workflows where the analysis structure is pre-defined and the agent’s role is limited to code generation within fixed steps. Second, none of the existing systems combine autonomous multi-step planning, domain knowledge retrieval from the literature, and multi-agent review into an integrated framework. Third, the community lacks benchmarks for evaluating agents on realistic, end-to-end physics analysis tasks—the kind that require event selection, background estimation, systematic uncertainty quantification, and statistical inference. These gaps motivate the framework we present in the following sections.

3 JFC 框架3 The JFC Framework

JFC 是一个用于自主执行 HEP 分析管道的代理框架。协调器代理将执行和审查工作委托给跨连续阶段的子代理。每个阶段都必须生成书面工件并在下一阶段开始之前通过独立审查，从而提供结构化任务分解和新的上下文管理。在本节中，我们描述其特定领域的功能：物理感知分析规划、基于文献的知识检索以及具有专业评论家的多智能体审查。JFC is an agentic framework for autonomous execution of HEP analysis pipelines. An orchestrator agent delegates execution and review work to subagents across sequential phases. Each phase must produce a written artifact and pass an independent review before the next phase can begin, providing structured task decomposition and fresh context management. In this section, we describe its domain-specific capabilities: physics-aware analysis planning, literature-based knowledge retrieval, and multi-agent review with rolespecialized critics.

3.1 架构概述3.1 Architecture overview

JFC 框架构建于The JFC framework is built on克劳德·科德Claude Code，Anthropic 的代理编码 CLI，它既充当 LLM 后端又充当代理运行时。底层模型是 Claude Opus（具体来说，, Anthropic’s agentic coding CLI, which serves as both the LLM backend and the agent runtime. The underlying model is Claude Opus (specifically,claude-opus-4-6具有一百万个令牌上下文窗口），用于所有执行者、审核者和仲裁者子代理。本文中提出的所有分析都是使用 Opus 对每个代理角色进行的，以确保推理质量永远不会默默下降；第 4.2 节讨论了通过将范围狭窄的角色委托给轻量级模型来降低成本的机会。with a one-million-token context window), used for all executor, reviewer, and arbiter subagents. All analyses presented in this paper were run with Opus for every agent role to ensure reasoning quality is never silently degraded; opportunities for cost reduction by delegating narrowly scoped roles to lighter-weight models are discussed in Section 4.2.

关键的架构原则是代理在分析工作流程上具有真正的自主权。与将代理限制在预定义分析步骤内生成代码的现有系统不同[10]，JFC 分析代理接收高级物理目标（例如“使用 ALEPH 数据测量 Z 玻色子的强子截面”），并且必须自主确定完整的分析策略：应用什么事件选择、如何估计背景、评估哪些系统不确定性、使用什么统计框架以及如何呈现结果。代理没有得到需要填写的模板或骨架分析；它必须从头开始规划和执行整个流程，并根据需要查阅文献。The key architectural principle is that the agent operates with genuine autonomy over the analysis workflow. Unlike prior systems that constrain the agent to code generation within pre-defined analysis steps [10], the JFC analysis agent receives a high-level physics objective—such as “measure the hadronic cross-section of the Z boson using ALEPH data”—and must autonomously determine the full analysis strategy: what event selection to apply, how to estimate backgrounds, which systematic uncertainties to evaluate, what statistical framework to use, and how to present the results. The agent is not given a template or skeleton analysis to fill in; it must plan and execute the entire pipeline from scratch, consulting the literature as needed.

这种自主权是有框架的，而不是不受约束。该代理在物理学家开发的知识库中运行，该知识库采用两种互补的形式。第一个是方法规范：一个自然语言文档，定义分析的阶段、每个阶段必须产生的输出以及将它们分开的审查门——用散文而不是代码表达，以便代理在约束内进行判断，而不是执行严格的管道。第二个是约定目录：一组动态文档，由物理学家在每次分析后维护和更新，编码特定技术积累的领域知识——哪些系统不确定性源是给定测量类型的标准，给定校正方法需要哪些验证检查，以及经验丰富的分析师知道要避免哪些陷阱。方法论告诉代理的地方This autonomy is scaffolded, not unconstrained. The agent operates within a physicist-developed knowledge base that takes two complementary forms. The first is a methodology specification: a natural-language document defining the phases of the analysis, the outputs each phase must produce, and the review gates separating them—expressed in prose rather than code, so that the agent exercises judgment within constraints rather than executing a rigid pipeline. The second is a conventions directory: a set of living documents, maintained and updated by physicists after each analysis, encoding accumulated domain knowledge for specific techniques—which systematic uncertainty sources are standard for a given measurement type, what validation checks a given correction method requires, and what pitfalls experienced analysts know to avoid. Where the methodology tells the agent那个that公约告诉它，它必须评估系统的不确定性it must evaluate systematic uncertainties, the conventions tell it其中which来源是标准的以及原因。这些共同构成了类似于研究生课程的操作环境：不是规定每一步，而是建立制定和审查代理决策的标准和领域知识。sources are standard and why. Together, these constitute an operational context analogous to a graduate course curriculum: not prescribing every step, but establishing the standards and domain knowledge against which the agent’s decisions are made and reviewed.

A high-level physics objective is passed to an autonomous analysis agent, which plans and executes the full pipeline while querying a literature retrieval system (SciTreeRAG) for domain knowledge. The resulting analysis undergoes multi-agent review; if any reviewer flags an issue the agent revises and resubmits until all reviewers approve. Eventually the final document (a rich analysis note) is passed to human physicists for evaluation.

Orchestrator代理本身从不编写分析代码或读取完整的数据文件；它只保存物理提示、阶段摘要和审查结论，将所有计算工作委托给一次性子代理，每次调用后其上下文都会被丢弃。The orchestrator agent itself never writes analysis code or reads full data files; it only holds the physics prompt, phase summaries, and review verdicts, delegating all computational work to disposable subagents whose contexts are discarded after each invocation.

所有分析代码均以柱状样式编写：选择是数组上的布尔掩码，而不是事件循环。代理原型All analysis code is written in a columnar style: selections are boolean masks over arrays, not event loops. 3.4 基于文献的知识检索3.4 Literature-based knowledge retrieval

JFC 框架的一个关键组成部分是它与基于 SciTreeRAG 构建的基于文献的知识检索系统的集成 [17]。无法访问现有文献的分析代理需要完全依赖于预训练期间吸收的知识，这是一个脆弱的基础，因为如何设计特定实验的事件选择、必须考虑哪些探测器效应或如何历史评估特定系统不确定性的具体细节很少在法学硕士的训练数据中以足够的保真度直接有用。A critical component of the JFC framework is its integration with a literature-based knowledge retrieval system built on SciTreeRAG [17]. An analysis agent operating without access to the existing literature would need to rely entirely on knowledge absorbed during pre-training—a brittle foundation, since the specific details of how a particular experiment’s event selection was designed, what detector effects must be accounted for, or how a particular systematic uncertainty was historically evaluated are rarely represented in an LLM’s training data with sufficient fidelity to be directly useful.

我们的检索系统对已发表的 LEP（ALEPH、DELPHI）论文的语料库进行索引，利用分层文档结构（节、小节、图、表）来构建上下文连贯的检索，而不是标准 RAG 系统使用的平面文本块。Our retrieval system indexes a corpus of published LEP (ALEPH, DELPHI) papers, exploiting the hierarchical document structure (sections, subsections, figures, tables) to build contextually coherent retrievals rather than the flat text chunks used by standard RAG systems.

ALEPH 目录总共包含 1,503 个条目（399 篇论文、736 篇论文集、368 篇论文）。其中，721 个有可用的源材料，575 个已成功转换为降价。 DELPHI 目录总共包含 4,305 个条目（2,967 篇论文、763 个会议记录、575 篇论文）。其中，2,083 个有可用的源材料，1,868 个已成功转换为降价。The ALEPH catalog contains 1,503 total entries (399 papers, 736 proceedings, 368 theses). Of those, 721 have source material available, and 575 were successfully converted to markdown. The DELPHI catalog contains 4,305 total entries (2,967 papers, 763 proceedings, 575 theses). Of those, 2,083 have source material available, and 1,868 were successfully converted to markdown.

元数据来自 INSPIRE-HEP 和 CERN CDS。然后下载源 PDF 和 LaTeX。使用在 A100 80GB GPU 上运行的 Nougat（基于 GPU 的神经 OCR 模型）将 PDF 转换为结构化 Markdown，而 LaTeX 源则通过 Pandoc 转换。然后，原始降价经过可重复的后处理管道，该管道标准化数学分隔符、去除缺失页面标记和样板文件、删除 Pandoc div 标记并折叠多余的空白。Metadata was harvested from INSPIRE-HEP and CERN CDS. Source PDFs and LaTeX were then downloaded. PDFs were converted to structured markdown using Nougat (a GPU-based neural OCR model) running on A100 80GB GPUs, while LaTeX sources were converted via Pandoc. The raw markdown then went through a reproducible postprocessing pipeline that normalizes math delimiters, strips missing-page markers and boilerplate, removes Pandoc div markers, and collapses excess whitespace.

当分析代理需要领域知识时——例如，在之前的 ALEPH 强子事件选择中使用了哪些带电轨道质量削减，或者在特定测量中考虑了哪些系统不确定性来源——它会查询检索系统并接收已发表论文中的相关段落，以及正确解释它们所需的周围上下文。这使得智能体能够根据既定的实验实践做出明智的决策，而不是猜测或幻觉分析选择。When the analysis agent needs domain knowledge—for example, what charged-track quality cuts were used in previous ALEPH hadronic event selections, or what sources of systematic uncertainty were considered in a particular measurement—it queries the retrieval system and receives relevant passages from published papers, complete with the surrounding context needed to interpret them correctly. This allows the agent to make informed decisions grounded in established experimental practice rather than guessing or hallucinating analysis choices.

检索系统对于分析的三个方面尤为重要：The retrieval system is particularly important for three aspects of an analysis:

  • 活动选择Event selection：代理检索类似已发表分析中使用的选择标准的描述，以告知其自己的选择设计，根据具体测量调整削减，同时保持与既定实践的一致性。: The agent retrieves descriptions of selection criteria used in similar published analyses to inform its own selection design, adapting cuts to the specific measurement while maintaining consistency with established practice.

  • 系统性不确定性Systematic uncertainties：识别给定测量的系统不确定性的相关来源是分析中专业知识最密集的方面之一。检索系统为代理提供了如何在先前的工作中评估系统不确定性的描述，包括考虑了哪些变化以及它们是如何传播的。: Identifying the relevant sources of systematic uncertainty for a given measurement is one of the most expertise-intensive aspects of an analysis. The retrieval system provides the agent with descriptions of how systematic uncertainties were evaluated in prior work, including which variations were considered and how they were propagated.

  • 统计方法Statistical methods：代理检索有关类似测量中使用的统计框架的信息（例如，轮廓似然拟合、模板方法），以指导其推理过程的选择。: The agent retrieves information about the statistical frameworks used in similar measurements (e.g., profile likelihood fits, template methods) to guide its choice of inference procedure.

对 ALEPH 开放数据进行的分析可以访问这种基于文献的知识检索，而 DELPHI 和 CMS 上的分析则不能。Presented analyses performed on the ALEPH Open Data have had access to this literature-based knowledge retrieval, whereas the ones on DELPHI and CMS did not.

3.5 代理架构3.5 Agent architecture

该框架定义了专家代理配置文件，每个配置文件都指定为 Markdown 文件The framework defines specialist agent profiles, each specified as a Markdown file in.claude/agents/使用 YAML frontmatter 声明代理的名称、描述、可用工具和模型层。这些代理分为四个功能类别：with a YAML frontmatter declaring the agent’s name, description, available tools, and model tier. These agents fall into four functional categories:

  • 执行代理人Executor agents (7): lead-analyst , data-explorer , detector-specialist , theory-scout , signal-lead , background-estimator , systematics-fitter，每个都有深域提示编码 HEP 方法（例如，装配工的提示指定所有八个强制装配诊断、三个现场约束策略以及 CL, each with deep domain prompts encoding HEP methodology (e.g., the fitter’s prompt specifies all eight mandatory fit diagnostics, three in-situ constraint strategies, and the CLs排除程序）。exclusion procedure).

  • 专业代理Specialist agents (4): systematic-source-evaluator , cross-checker , note-writer , ml-specialist，根据特定子任务的需要激活。, activated as needed for specific sub-tasks.

9

  • 审稿代理人Reviewer agents (5): physics-reviewer（纯粹根据物理优点进行评论，无法获取方法论文件），(reviews purely on physics merit, without access to methodology documents),critical-reviewer , constructive-reviewer , rendering-reviewer（编译并检查 PDF），以及(compiles and inspects the PDF), andplot-validator（绘图代码和直方图数据的编程、非视觉验证）。更多信息请参见第 2 节。 3.6(programmatic, non-visual validation of plotting code and histogram data). Further information in Sec. 3.6

  • 审判代理人Adjudication agents (2): arbiter（将所有审稿人的发现综合为“通过”/“迭代”/“升级”判决）以及(synthesizes all reviewer findings into a PASS/ITERATE/ESCALATE verdict) andinvestigator（跨阶段追踪回归触发因素到其根本原因）。(traces regression triggers to their root cause across phases).

每个子代理都是作为一个新进程生成的，没有先前调用的记忆，仅接收与其任务相关的特定工件和指令。这种一次性上下文架构可以防止长时间分析期间上下文窗口耗尽（Context Rot [13]），并确保每个代理在干净的状态下运行。Every subagent is spawned as a fresh process with no memory of prior invocations, receiving only the specific artifacts and instructions relevant to its task. This disposable-context architecture prevents context window exhaustion (Context Rot [13]) during long analyses and ensures that each agent operates from a clean state.

3.6 多智能体评审3.6 Multi-agent review

在任何分析阶段被视为完成之前，都会由一组专门的审核代理进行自动审核。这种多代理审查系统旨在反映真实 HEP 协作的内部审查流程，其中不同的专家在分析被批准发布之前对其不同方面进行审查。Before any analysis phase is considered complete, it undergoes automated review by a panel of specialized reviewer agents. This multi-agent review system is designed to mirror the internal review process of a real HEP collaboration, where different experts scrutinize different aspects of an analysis before it is approved for publication.

六个不同的代理参与审核过程，每个代理都由 Markdown 配置文件定义Six distinct agents participate in the review process, each defined by a Markdown profile in.claude/agents/指定其角色、可用工具、模型层和评估标准。specifying its role, available tools, model tier, and evaluation criteria.

物理审稿人（Physics reviewer ( physics-reviewer ).作为独立高级协作成员，相当于分析审查委员会 (ARC) 成员或二级召集人。关键的是，这个代理是Operates as an independent senior collaboration member equivalent to an Analysis Review Committee (ARC) member or Level-2 convener. Critically, this agent is故意拒绝访问deliberately denied access方法规范、公约文件、审查清单和先前的审查反馈。它仅接收物理提示和正在审查的工件，并纯粹根据物理知识进行评估：信号建模、背景识别和估计、系统不确定性完整性、交叉检查充分性和出版准备情况。这种设计选择确保物理审阅者像外部裁判一样评估分析，而不受框架自身标准的指导。问题分为 A 类（阻碍：“会导致拒绝”）、B 类（重要：“削弱分析”）或 C 类（次要：“风格或清晰度”）。to the methodology specification, conventions documents, review checklists, and previous review feedback. It receives only the physics prompt and the artifact under review, and evaluates purely on the basis of physics knowledge: signal modeling, background identification and estimation, systematic uncertainty completeness, cross-check adequacy, and publication readiness. This design choice ensures that the physics reviewer assesses the analysis as an external referee would, without being guided by the framework’s own criteria. Issues are classified as Category A (blocking: “would cause rejection”), B (important: “weakens the analysis”), or C (minor: “style or clarity”).

批判性评论家（Critical reviewer ( critical-reviewer ).进行最全面的审查。与物理审稿人不同，批判性审稿人Performs the most comprehensive review. Unlike the physics reviewer, the critical reviewer确实does阅读方法规范和公约文件，并系统地应用它们。其协议包括八个强制性步骤：（1）特定阶段的审查重点，（2）问题分类（A/B/C），（3）根据适用的公约文件逐行进行公约合规性检查，（4）参考分析比较（“竞争组有什么我们没有的？”），（5）14点图形和标签清单（用单位验证轴标签，光度标记，实验标签，比率面板，不确定性带以及是否存在图形等禁止元素）标题），（6）对每个图进行物理健全性检查（分布形状，产量大小，数据/MC协议，不确定性比例），（7）通过将当前工件与早期阶段输出进行比较进行回归检测，以及（8）上游反馈识别源自先前阶段的问题。每个发现都包括文件路径或图形参考、影响声明和建议的修复。read the methodology specification and conventions documents, and applies them systematically. Its protocol includes eight mandatory steps: (1) phase-specific review focus, (2) issue classification (A/B/C), (3) row-by-row conventions compliance check against the applicable conventions document, (4) reference analysis comparison (“what would a competing group have that we do not?”), (5) a 14-point figure and label checklist (verifying axis labels with units, luminosity stamps, experiment labels, ratio panels, uncertainty bands, and the absence of forbidden elements such as figure titles), (6) physics sanity checks on every plot (distribution shapes, yield magnitudes, data/MC agreement, uncertainty proportionality), (7) regression detection by comparing the current artifact against earlier phase outputs, and (8) upstream feedback identifying issues that originate in prior phases. Each finding includes a file path or figure reference, an impact statement, and a suggested fix.

建设性审稿人（Constructive reviewer ( constructive-reviewer ).通过专注于改进和替代方案而不是缺陷检测来补充批评者。它评估清晰度、验证充分性、替代方法（额外的信号区域、补充交叉检查、改进的统计方法）、演示质量和符号一致性。每个建议都包括当前状态、改进的状态、理由和工作量估计（低/中/高）。建设性审稿人还提供明确的积极反馈（标有Complements the critical reviewer by focusing on improvements and alternatives rather than flaw detection. It evaluates clarity, validation sufficiency, alternative approaches (additional signal regions, complementary cross-checks, improved statistical methodology), presentation quality, and notation consistency. Each suggestion includes the current state, the improved state, a justification, and an effort estimate (low/medium/high). The constructive reviewer also provides explicit positive feedback (marked with[+]）对于分析的真正强有力的方面，并被指示不要重复批判性审稿人已经提出的发现。虽然它主要产生 B 类和 C 类结果，但如果发现根本性差距，它可以升级到 A 类。) for genuinely strong aspects of the analysis, and is instructed not to duplicate findings already raised by the critical reviewer. While it primarily produces Category B and C findings, it can escalate to Category A if a fundamental gap is discovered.

10

渲染审核员（Rendering reviewer ( rendering-reviewer ).仅在第 5 阶段（文档）审核期间激活，向小组添加第五位审核者。该代理将分析注释编译为 PDF，然后检查八个维度的编译输出：图形渲染完整性、LaTeX 数学编译、页面布局（孤立文本、分页符、边距）、交叉引用分辨率（Activated only during Phase 5 (documentation) review, adding a fifth reviewer to the panel. This agent compiles the analysis note to PDF, then inspects the compiled output across eight dimensions: figure rendering integrity, LaTeX math compilation, page layout (orphaned text, page breaks, margins), cross-reference resolution (@fig: , @tbl: , @eq: , @sec:标签）、参考书目的引文解析、表格格式和溢出以及页数评估（完整分析笔记的目标页数为 50-100 页）。它只关注渲染质量，不评论物理内容。labels), citation resolution against the bibliography, table formatting and overflow, and page count assessment (targeting 50– 100 pages for a complete analysis note). It focuses exclusively on rendering quality and does not comment on physics content.

绘图验证器 (Plot validator ( plot-validator ).与其他审阅者不同，绘图验证器执行Unlike the other reviewers, the plot validator performs程序化的programmatic，非视觉验证。在涉及图形生成阶段的每个审核周期中，它与其他审核者并行运行。其检查分为四类：, non-visual validation. It runs in parallel with the other reviewers during every review cycle that involves figure-producing phases. Its checks fall into four categories:

  • 程序化图形检查Programmatic figure checks（8 个检查）：验证协作绘图样式（(8 checks): Verifies that collaboration plotting styles (mplhep）适用，图形尺寸与模板相符，无禁止) are applied, figure sizes match the template, no forbiddenax.set ~~t~~ itle()存在调用，轴标签包含单位，没有出现硬编码字体大小，calls exist, axis labels include units, no hardcoded font sizes appear,bbox inches="tight"保存时使用，PDF和PNG格式均保存，并且is used at save time, both PDF and PNG formats are saved, andplt.close()保存后调用。is called after saving.

  • 物理健全性检查Physics sanity checks（11 个检查）：验证收益率为非负值，效率位于 [0(11 checks): Verifies that yields are non-negative, efficiencies lie in [0,1]，控制区域的数据/MC比率落在[01], data/MC ratios in control regions fall within [0. 5 , 2 .0]，不确定性规模为0], uncertainties scale as√N , pT并且质量分布在高值处下降，切流产率单调非增加，并且背景成分分数总和为and mass distributions fall off at high values, cutflow yields are monotonically non-increasing, and background composition fractions sum to∼100%。100%.

  • 一致性检查Consistency checks（6 个检查）：交叉验证同一过程在不同地块上具有一致的产量，拟合前和拟合后产量与拟合一致，并且滋扰参数影响排名与不确定性细分表匹配。(6 checks): Cross-validates that the same process has consistent yields across different plots, pre-fit and post-fit yields are consistent with the fit, and nuisance parameter impact rankings match the uncertainty breakdown table.

  • 红旗检测Red flag detection（10 项检查）：自动 A 类触发器，包括负面事件发生率、效率超出 [0(10 checks): Automatic Category A triggers including negative event yields, efficiencies outside [0,1]，数据/MC比率超出[01], data/MC ratios outside [0. 2 , 5 .0] 在控制区域中，非零预测的零不确定性、非收敛拟合、干扰参数拉动0] in control regions, zero uncertainty on nonzero predictions, non-converged fits, nuisance parameter pulls> 3 σ , χ[2] /NDFndf> 5 .0，系统变异超过100%。0, and systematic variations exceeding 100%.

来自图验证器的危险信号会自动归类为 A 类结果；仲裁者被明确禁止降级。Red flags from the plot validator are automatically classified as Category A findings; the arbiter is explicitly forbidden from downgrading them.

仲裁者（Arbiter ( arbiter ).仲裁者不是审阅者，而是裁决者：它读取所有审阅者输出和原始工件，然后综合一个裁决。其裁决遵循五种情况的决策框架：（1）双方评审员都同意The arbiter is not a reviewer but an adjudicator: it reads all reviewer outputs and the original artifact, then synthesizes a single verdict. Its adjudication follows a five-case decision framework: (1) both reviewers agree→接受较高的严重程度； (2) 审稿人对严重程度意见不一accept at the higher severity; (2) reviewers disagree on severity→评估论点并根据记录的推理进行分配； (3) 只有一名评审员提出了这一发现evaluate arguments and assign with documented reasoning; (3) only one reviewer raised the finding→独立评估有效性； (4)审稿人互相矛盾assess validity independently; (4) reviewers contradict each other→直接检查工件来解决； (5) 两位审稿人都遗漏了一些东西examine the artifact directly to resolve; (5) both reviewers missed something→仲裁者添加了自己的发现。仲裁员生成一个结构化裁决表，将每个发现映射到其来源审阅者、其指定的类别以及带有理由的最终裁决类别。然后它发布三个决定之一：the arbiter adds its own finding. The arbiter produces a structured adjudication table mapping each finding to its source reviewer(s), their assigned categories, and the final adjudicated category with rationale. It then issues one of three decisions:通行证PASS（不存在 A 类或未解决的 B 类项目），(no Category A or unresolved B items remain),迭代ITERATE（存在可在当前阶段修复的可操作 A 类项目），或者(actionable Category A items exist that can be fixed within the current phase), or升级ESCALATE（需要人为判断或上游阶段变化的基本问题）。(fundamental problem requiring human judgment or upstream phase changes).

这个自动审查层有两个目的。首先，在人类物理学家需要查看分析之前，它会发现一类错误，例如应用无意中删除信号的选择削减、重复计算系统不确定性或使用不适当的测试统计量。其次，它提供了分析决策及其理由的结构化文档，使后续的人工审核更加高效，因为审核者可以专注于物理判断，而不是寻找机械错误。This automated review layer serves two purposes. First, it catches a class of errors—such as applying a selection cut that inadvertently removes signal, double-counting a systematic uncertainty, or using an inappropriate test statistic—before a human physicist ever needs to look at the analysis. Second, it provides structured documentation of the analysis decisions and their justifications, making subsequent human review more efficient because the reviewer can focus on physics judgment rather than hunting for mechanical errors.

审查过程故意保守：在所有审查代理签署之前，不允许分析继续“揭盲”（检查信号区域中的真实数据）。审查方案不是建议性的；是的The review process is deliberately conservative: the analysis is not permitted to proceed to “unblinding”— examining the real data in the signal region—until all reviewer agents have signed off. The review protocol is not advisory; it is绑定binding。当仲裁者发出. When the arbiter issues anITERATE裁决后，协调器启动一个闭环修订周期，其中执行者代理必须明确解决每个 A 类发现，然后才能继续进行分析。verdict, the orchestrator initiates a closedloop revision cycle in which the executor agent must demonstrably address every Category A finding before the analysis can advance.

在最后的文档阶段，审查系统扩展到书面分析报告本身：本文附录中提出的分析，包括所有出版物质量的图，完全由代理系统起草，并通过相同的多代理审查周期进行完善。In the final documentation phase, the review system extends to the written analysis report itself: the analyses presented in the appendices of this paper, including all publication-quality plots, were drafted entirely by the agent system and refined through the same multi-agent review cycle.

3.7 管道状态跟踪3.7 Pipeline state tracking

协调器维护一个机器可读的状态文件（The orchestrator maintains a machine-readable state file (STATE.md），记录当前阶段、状态、时间戳、阶段历史表（包含工件路径、审核层、迭代计数和注释）、活动阻止程序和回归日志。每个状态转换（执行、审查、通过、阻止、人工操作、回归）都有时间戳。一个专门的) that records the current phase, status, timestamp, a phase history table (with artifact paths, review tiers, iteration counts, and notes), active blockers, and a regression log. Every state transition—executing, reviewing, passed, blocked, human ~~g~~ ate, regression—is timestamped. A dedicated/check-status命令读取此文件并提供格式化的状态报告，包括已完成的工件、每个阶段的审查迭代计数以及任何未解决的阻塞程序。这种状态跟踪使协调器能够在中断后从正确的点恢复，并提供分析管道进展的完整审计跟踪。command reads this file and presents a formatted status report including completed artifacts, review iteration counts per phase, and any outstanding blockers. This state tracking enables the orchestrator to resume from the correct point after interruptions and provides a complete audit trail of the analysis pipeline’s progression.

3.8 正式揭盲协议3.8 Formal unblinding protocol

该框架实现了一种结构化的多阶段致盲协议，该协议在检查信号区域中观察到的数据之前强制执行强制人为门控。The framework implements a structured, multi-stage blinding protocol that enforces a mandatory human gate before observed data in the signal region can be examined.

致盲执法。Blinding enforcement.从分析开始，第一阶段定义的致盲协议指定致盲变量和信号区域边界。所有特工都在一个长期约束下运作：“在明确告知揭盲获得批准之前，切勿访问信号区域数据。”在阶段 1-4a 期间，统计分析仅使用阿西莫夫数据集（预期背景，可选择在From the start of the analysis, a blinding protocol defined in Phase 1 specifies the blinding variable and the signal region boundaries. All agents operate under a standing constraint: “never access signal region data until explicitly told unblinding is approved.” During Phases 1–4a, the statistical analysis uses exclusively Asimov datasets (expected background, optionally with injected signal atµ= 1 表示发现预测）。拟合后分布显示从信号区域中删除的数据点或用阿西莫夫伪数据替换的数据点。的= 1 for discovery projections). Post-fit distributions show data points removed from the signal region or replaced with Asimov pseudodata. 部分揭盲（阶段 4b）。Partial unblinding (Phase 4b).第 4b 阶段引入了受控部分揭盲：Phase 4b introduces a controlled partial unblinding: thesystematics-fitter代理对信号区域数据的 10% 随机子样本运行统计拟合，使用固定随机种子来实现可重复性。这种有限的暴露使分析能够验证是否出现意外的病理现象（例如，戏剧性的数据/MC 不一致、拟合不收敛、异常的干扰参数拉动），而无需透露完整的结果。的agent runs the statistical fit on a 10% random subsample of the signal region data, using a fixed random seed for reproducibility. This limited exposure allows the analysis to verify that no unexpected pathologies appear (e.g., dramatic data/MC disagreement, fit non-convergence, anomalous nuisance parameter pulls) without revealing the full result. Thenote-writer代理人同时制作一份分析说明草案和一份涵盖七个标准的揭盲清单：agent simultaneously produces a draft analysis note and an unblinding checklist covering seven criteria:

  1. 背景模型已验证（闭合测试在所有验证区域均通过），Background model validated (closure tests pass in all validation regions),

  2. 评估系统不确定性并拟合模型稳定，Systematic uncertainties evaluated and fit model stable,

  3. 物理上合理的预期结果，Expected results physically sensible,

  4. 信号注入测试确认适合恢复注入信号，Signal injection tests confirm fit recovers injected signals,

  5. 10% 部分揭盲显示没有意外的病理变化，10% partial unblinding shows no unexpected pathologies,

  6. 所有代理审核周期均已解决（仲裁者通过），All agent review cycles resolved (arbiter PASS),

  7. 分析说明草案审查并考虑了可发表的模完整观察结果。Draft analysis note reviewed and considered publication-ready modulo full observed results.

设计原理。Design rationale.三阶段揭盲序列（阿西莫夫The three-stage unblinding sequence (Asimov→10% 数据10% data→完整数据）和强制人为门反映了主要 HEP 合作所使用的致盲协议。人为门是管道中故意暂停自主执行的单点，确保检查完整信号区域数据的决策仍处于人的控制之下。这种设计反映了这样的原则：虽然分析执行和审查可以自动化，但揭盲结果的科学判断不应该自动化。full data) with a mandatory human gate mirrors the blinding protocols used by major HEP collaborations. The human gate is the single point in the pipeline where autonomous execution is deliberately suspended, ensuring that the decision to examine the full signal region data remains under human control. This design reflects the principle that while analysis execution and review can be automated, the scientific judgment to unblind a result should not be.

4 结果与讨论4 Results & Discussion

我们通过使用存档的 LEP 数据和蒙特卡罗模拟样本重现多个已发布的 ALEPH 和 DELPHI 测量结果以及使用 CMS 开放数据 [7] 的 CMS 希格斯玻色子测量结果来演示 JFC 框架。完整的分析，包括事件选择的详细描述、系统不确定性评估和统计结果，在附录中作为独立论文提供。这些附录论文完全由代理系统编写，除了描述一般任务和数据位置的简单提示之外，零人工反馈。分析笔记最初是作为独立文件制作的；为了纳入本文，人工智能代理执行了较小的重新格式化（部分级别调整、图形路径更新），而物理内容、方法或结果没有变化。We demonstrate the JFC framework by reproducing several published ALEPH and DELPHI measurements using archived LEP data and Monte Carlo simulation samples, and a CMS Higgs boson measurement using CMS Open Data [7]. The full analyses, including detailed descriptions of event selection, systematic uncertainty evaluation, and statistical results, are presented as standalone papers in the appendices. These appendix papers were written entirely by the agent system, with zero human feedback beyond a simple prompt describing the general task and data location. The analysis notes were originally produced as standalone documents; for inclusion in this paper, an AI agent performed minor reformatting (section-level adjustments, figure path updates) with no changes to physics content, methodology, or results.

表 3 总结了使用 JFC 进行的分析。每次分析都以简短的自然语言提示（在表中复制）启动，仅指定测量目标和数据位置；代理自主确定完整的分析策略。所有运行均使用 Claude Max 订阅[2] 和 Claude Opus 模型，通常在 4-6 小时内完成端到端。在某些情况下，克劳德代码使用限制的等待期会重置减慢的执行时间。附录中转载了代理制作的完整分析笔记，其中包含一些代表性示例。框架规范、代理定义和其他自动生成的分析可在我们的 github 存储库中找到（请参阅第 6 节）。Table 3 summarizes the analyses produced with JFC. Each analysis was initiated with a short naturallanguage prompt (reproduced in the table) specifying only the measurement goal and the data location; the agent autonomously determined the full analysis strategy. All runs used a Claude Max subscription[2] with the Claude Opus model, and generally completed end-to-end within 4-6 hours. In some cases, waiting periods for Claude Code usage limit resets slowed execution times. The complete agent-produced analysis notes are reproduced in the appendices for a few representative examples. The framework specification, agent definitions, and additional autonomously generated analyses are available in our github repository (see Section 6).
