4.2 成本和规模4.2 Cost and scaling

本文中提出的所有分析都是使用 Claude Max 订阅（在撰写本文时约为 200 美元/月）运行的，这为包括所有审核迭代在内的整个流程提供了足够的吞吐量。每个端到端分析大约在 4-6 个挂钟时间内完成，审核周期目前施加软和硬迭代上限：阶段通常在一到两次迭代后通过审核，并采用硬上限来防止失控循环。All analyses presented in this paper were run using a Claude Max subscription (approximately $200/month at the time of writing), which provides sufficient throughput for the full pipeline including all review iterations. Each end-to-end analysis completes in approximately 4-6 of wall-clock time, with the review cycles currently imposing soft and hard iteration caps: phases typically pass review after one to two iterations, with a hard cap to prevent runaway loops.

当前配置对所有代理角色使用 Claude Opus，优先考虑推理质量而不是成本。原则上，通过将范围狭窄的角色委托给轻量级模型，可以节省大量成本，例如，Claude Sonnet 负责信号选择开发、背景估计、理论探索、笔记编写和渲染审查，Claude Haiku 负责执行快速样本盘点的只读数据侦察代理。相反，额外的审核迭代（超出当前的一到两轮默认值）代表了提高分析质量的机会，但代价是额外的模型调用和挂钟时间。对这种质量与成本权衡的系统探索留待未来的工作。The current configuration uses Claude Opus for all agent roles, prioritizing reasoning quality over cost. In principle, substantial cost savings could be achieved by delegating narrowly scoped roles to lighterweight models—for example, Claude Sonnet for signal selection development, background estimation, theory scouting, note writing, and rendering review, and Claude Haiku for the read-only data reconnaissance agent that performs fast sample inventory. Conversely, additional review iterations (beyond the current one-totwo-round default) represent an opportunity to improve analysis quality at the cost of additional model invocations and wall-clock time. Systematic exploration of this quality–cost trade-off is left for future work.

4.3 分析质量4.3 Analysis quality

除了数值结果之外，我们还可以从多个维度评估代理生成的分析的质量。代理生成的分析表明，法学硕士驱动的系统可以设计和执行结构合理、方法标准且真实记录的粒子物理分析。事件选择是明智的，并且可以识别正确的系统不确定性来源，即使并非所有因素都可以得到充分评估。分析策略与已发布的方法紧密一致，并且有充分的理由和明确记录的偏差。Beyond the numerical results, we can assess the quality of the agent-produced analyses along several dimensions. The agent-produced analyses demonstrate that an LLM-driven system can design and execute particle physics analyses that are structurally sound, methodologically standard, and honestly documented. The event selections are sensible, and correct systematic uncertainty sources are identified, even when not all can be fully evaluated. The analysis strategies align closely with published approaches, with deviations that are well-motivated and clearly documented.

在所有情况下，代理的分析策略都与相应已发布的分析相似。该代理始终做出与原始实验合作相同的高级选择，例如，QCD 测量的迭代贝叶斯展开（或适当的逐箱校正）、希格斯搜索的 HistFactory 似然、Breit-Wigner 线形拟合In all cases, the agent’s analysis strategy is recognizably similar to the corresponding published analysis. The agent consistently makes the same high-level choices that the original experimental collaborations made, for example, iterative Bayesian unfolding (or bin-by-bin correction where appropriate) for the QCD measurements, HistFactory likelihood for the Higgs search, Breit–Wigner lineshape fitting forNν。可观测值的选择、分箱策略和校正程序都是标准且动机良好的。此外，智能体对系统不确定性的处理是这些分析中最有力的方面之一。每个注释都包含一个系统完整性表，该表将考虑的来源与相应已发表的分析（DELPHI、ALEPH、OPAL、CMS、ATLAS 或 ALICE）中的来源进行明确比较。预计与已发表的分析相似，因为代理人明确查阅现有文献并被要求重复以前做过的测量。追求全新的分析对于智能体来说可能更具挑战性，我们将这个问题留待未来的工作。自主复制完整的分析工作流程本身就是其 HEP 分析能力的一个非常重要的展示。. The selection of observables, binning strategies, and correction procedures are all standard and well-motivated. Additionally, the agent’s treatment of systematic uncertainties is one of the strongest aspects of these analyses. Every note includes a systematic completeness table that explicitly compares the sources considered against those in the corresponding published analyses (DELPHI, ALEPH, OPAL, CMS, ATLAS, or ALICE). Similarity to published analyses is expected, as the agents explicitly consult existing literature and are asked to repeat measurements that have been done before. Pursuing wholly novel analyses is likely to be more challenging for the agents, and we leave this as a question for future work. Autonomously reproducing full analysis workflows is, by itself, a very significant demonstration of their HEP analysis capabilities.

主要弱点——包括有限的统计数据、近似的理论输入和不完整的强子化模型比较——是原型范围固有的，而不是代理物理推理中的错误。最显着的真实错误（DY 模板污染、秩亏协方差、NLOonlyThe main weaknesses—including limited statistics, approximate theory inputs, and incomplete hadronization model comparisons—are inherent to the prototype scope rather than to errors in the agent’s physics reasoning. The most significant genuine errors (DY template contamination, rank-deficient covariance, NLOonlyαs偏见）是标准审查流程旨在捕获的问题类型，代理本身在其“限制”讨论中标记了其中的大多数问题。该试剂在选择削减方面趋于保守，更喜欢高纯度而不是高效率。对于首次分析来说，这是合理的默认值，但在某些情况下，它会严重损害灵敏度。经验丰富的分析师可能会在分析周期的早期进行调查并放松或解决此类削减。bias) are the kinds of issues that standard review processes are designed to catch, and the agent itself flags most of them in its “limitations” discussions. The agent tends to be conservative with selection cuts, preferring high purity over high efficiency. This is a reasonable default for a first-pass analysis, but in several cases, it substantially hurts sensitivity. A more experienced analyst would likely investigate and relax or work around such cuts earlier in the analysis cycle.

与经验丰富的人类分析师相比，代理的不足之处在于迭代细化循环：人类可能会修复问题Where the agent falls short relative to an experienced human analyst is in the iterative refinement loop: a human would likely fix theZ → µµ希格斯粒子的污染contamination in the Higgs toττ在围绕它编写 55 页之前进行分析，并在接受之前在同一分析中实施事件分类analysis before writing 55 pages around it, and would implement event categorization in the same analysis before acceptingσµ = 5 .6、并且不会继续6, and would not proceed with aχ[2] 使用条件号 10[19] 进行测试。代理人会制定彻底的初稿，找出自己的问题，但并不总是能够解决问题。这种正确诊断、延迟治疗的模式是所有分析中代理工作风格的最典型特征，它表明审查和迭代周期是最有价值的地方，来自更紧密的人类代理协作。[2] test using a condition number of 10[19] . The agent produces thorough first drafts that identify their own problems but does not always close the loop on fixing them. This pattern of correct diagnosis, deferred treatment is the single most characteristic feature of the agent’s working style across all analyses, and it suggests that the review-and-iterate cycle is where the most value would come from tighter human-agent collaboration.

多轮审查对于纠正错误也非常有价值。每个独立评审员的任务是阅读一份分析笔记并做出批判性评估。可以进行一些定性观察：The review rounds were also invaluable to correcting mistakes. Each independent reviewer agent was tasked with reading one analysis note and producing a critical assessment. Several qualitative observations can be made:

17

  • 审稿人评估的一致性：Consistency of reviewer assessments:所有六位评审代理都集中在相同的结构性批评上——这些分析是精心设计的可行性论证，主要受到原型统计数据和缺失的理论/MC 输入的限制，而不是受到基本方法论错误的限制。独立评审之间的这种一致性让人相信评估不是任何单个评审员偏见的产物。All six reviewer agents converged on the same structural critique — that the analyses are well-designed feasibility demonstrations limited primarily by prototype statistics and missing theory/MC inputs, rather than by fundamental methodological errors. This consistency across independent reviews lends confidence that the assessment is not an artifact of any single reviewer’s biases.

  • 审稿人发现的错误：Errors caught by reviewers:审查代理确定了几个具体问题：EEC 分析中的秩亏协方差矩阵、The reviewer agents identified several concrete issues: the rankdeficient covariance matrix in the EEC analysis, theZ → µµ模板污染template contamination inH → ττ, 膨胀的, the inflatedαs来自仅 NLO 理论，以及喷气机下部结构的应力测试失败。这些正是内部审查委员会在实际合作中发现的问题。from NLO-only theory, and the stress test failures in jet substructure. These are precisely the kinds of issues that internal review committees catch in real collaborations.

  • 可能需要人工审核的错误：Errors likely requiring human review:一些更微妙的问题——例如 CMS Open Data NanoAOD 中的反 μ 子鉴别器行为是否是数据格式工件而不是真正的分析选择，或者与 Herwig 相比，APACIC 生成器是否提供了足够的强子化模型变化——需要领域专业知识以及对特定检测器和数据格式的熟悉程度，这超出了审阅代理仅从注释文本中可以完全评估的范围。具有 LEP 或 CMS 经验的人工审核员可能会更深入地探讨这些要点。Some subtler issues — such as whether the anti-muon discriminator behavior in CMS Open Data NanoAOD is a data-format artifact versus a genuine analysis choice, or whether the APACIC generator provides sufficient hadronization model variation compared to Herwig — require domain expertise and familiarity with the specific detector and data formats that goes beyond what the reviewer agents can fully assess from the note text alone. A human reviewer with LEP or CMS experience would likely probe these points more deeply.

  • 自我意识的局限性：Self-awareness of limitations:代理制作的票据的一个显着特点是它们对缺失内容的透明度。每个分析都包含一个“主要限制”小节和完整统计分析的优先改进列表。这种自我批评的态度减轻了审阅者的负担，他们可以专注于代理所做的问题A striking feature of the agent-produced notes is their transparency about what is missing. Every analysis includes a “dominant limitations” subsection and a prioritized list of improvements for the full-statistics analysis. This self-critical posture reduces the burden on reviewers, who can focus on issues the agent did不not识别而不是那些它所做的。identify rather than those it did.

4.4 对分析工作流程的影响4.4 Implications for analysis workflows

这里给出的结果表明，标准 HEP 分析中的很大一部分技术工作可以通过当前的 AI 代理技术实现自动化。这并不意味着不再需要人类物理学家——恰恰相反。物理学家的角色从实施者转变为架构师和评论家：定义应该测量的内容和原因，评估代理的方法在物理上是否合理，并发现自动审查可能错过的微妙错误。The results presented here suggest that a significant fraction of the technical work in a standard HEP analysis can be automated with current AI agent technology. This does not mean that human physicists are no longer needed - quite the opposite. The role of the physicist shifts from implementer to architect and critic: defining what should be measured and why, assessing whether the agent’s approach is physically sensible, and catching the subtle errors that automated review may miss.

随着人工智能系统能够实现复杂的软件框架或自动运行端到端分析管道，高级思维、分析设计、构思和物理推理（教师候选人所寻求的技能和职业成功的基础技能）成为学术层次各个级别的主要职业。对于学生来说，没有花在编程上的时间可以用来拓宽理论和统计基础、建立仪器专业知识、规划项目、跟踪文献和撰写结果。从这个角度来看，人工智能编码代理只是加入了一系列节省时间的创新，使科学家摆脱了技术苦差事。With AI systems capable of implementing complex software frameworks or autonomously running endto-end analysis pipelines, high-level thinking, analysis design, ideation, and physical reasoning (skills that are sought in faculty candidates and foundational to career success) become the primary occupation across all levels of the academic hierarchy. For students, time not spent programming can be dedicated to broadening theoretical and statistical foundations, building instrumentation expertise, planning projects, keeping up with the literature, and writing up results. From this perspective, AI coding agents simply join a long lineage of time-saving innovations that unburden scientists from technical drudgery.

这种转变有可能显着提高实验程序的吞吐量。考虑一下大型强子对撞机实验今天面临的情况：可以利用现有数据进行数千种潜在的测量，但只有有限数量的学生和博士后来执行这些测量。每个分析可能需要一个人花费数年时间，因此如果实施阶段可以从几年压缩到几个月，那么瓶颈就会从编码能力转移到物理思想和人工审查带宽——这是一个更理想的约束，因为这意味着限制因素是智力而不是机械。可能需要一年才能完成的测量结果可能会在几天内完成，在任何人查看结果之前由一套专门的人工智能代理进行审查，并根据反馈快速迭代。后续研究、封闭检查、系统学调查和许多其他繁重的任务都可以在代码级别上在几分钟内完成，并且仅在大型数据集上的运行时出现瓶颈，就像现在一样。当实施成本下降几个数量级时，目前因“太乏味”而被跳过的研究变得容易处理。即使使用 LEP 数据，也存在显着的前瞻性改进，例如所有标准模型参数的事件级分析、每次分析的强子簇射调整以及核心标准模型参数的优化粒子重建。有了这些工具包，分析的负担就减轻了，鼓励我们所有人更广泛地思考可以进行的研究范围。This shift has the potential to dramatically increase the throughput of an experimental program. Consider the situation facing the LHC experiments today: thousands of potential measurements that could be performed with existing data, but only a finite number of students and postdocs to carry them out. Each analysis can occupy a person for years, so if the implementation phase can be compressed from years to months, the bottleneck moves from coding capacity to physics ideas and human review bandwidth—a much more desirable constraint, because it means the limiting factor is intellectual rather than mechanical. Measurements that might take a year to complete could potentially be produced in days, reviewed by a suite of specialized AI agents before any human even looks at the result, and iterated rapidly in response to feedback. Follow-up studies, closure checks, systematics investigations, and many other burdensome tasks could be implemented within minutes at the level of code and bottlenecked only by runtime on large datasets, as they are now anyway. Studies that are currently skipped because they are “too tedious” become tractable when the cost of implementation drops by orders of magnitude. Even with LEP data, there are significant prospective improvements, such as event-level analyses of all standard model parameters, tunes of the hadronic shower for every analysis, and optimized particle reconstruction for core standard model parameters. With these toolkits, the burden of analysis is lifted, encouraging all of us to think more broadly about the scope of research that can be conducted.

此外，可以加快涉及 3-4 个级别的人工审核（见图 1）的大型协作审核。代理在审查和测试阶段都发挥作用，提供即时反馈和Furthermore, large collaboration reviews, which involve 3–4 levels of human review (see Fig. 1), can be expedited. Agents have a role at both the review and testing stages, providing immediate feedback and

18

交叉检查立即得出结果。然后，人工审核员的角色侧重于审核过程中技术上具有挑战性的要素，这在很大程度上与后期阶段执行的“批准”和“协作范围内的审核”类似。immediate results from cross-checks. The role of the human reviewer then focuses on the technically challenging elements of the review process, largely paralleling the “approvals” and “collaboration-wide reviews” performed in the later stages.

虽然减少编码负担会让该领域的大多数人松一口气，While a reduced coding burden would come as a relief to most in the field,对于所有 HEP 从业者来说，编程技术熟练程度必须是一项关键且精心培养的技能technical proficiency in programming must remain a critical and carefully developed skill for all HEP practitioners。如果人工智能代理编写复杂的分析管道，物理学家至少必须能够阅读和理解代码库以检查正确性。现代编码助手的能力令人难以置信，但仍然经常犯根本性错误，特别是在执行 HEP 所需的各种专门任务时（例如复杂的拟合和统计假设检验）。这些系统的可靠性会不断提高，但所有软件的概念基础——代码应该是什么. If an AI agent writes a sophisticated analysis pipeline, a physicist must, at minimum, be able to read and understand the codebase to check for correctness. Modern coding assistants are incredibly capable but still routinely make fundamental errors, particularly when performing the kinds of specialized tasks required in HEP (e.g. complicated fits and statistical hypothesis testing). The reliability of these systems will continue to improve, but the conceptual basis of all software—what the code shoulddo——仍将以人为本。—will remain human-driven.

4.5 重新思考研究生培养4.5 Rethinking graduate training

对研究生教育的影响值得特别关注。随着计算机技术和深度学习与 HEP 的“大数据”时代共同发展，软件工程可能无意中成为研究生培训的重要组成部分。这是一个宝贵的技术基础，可以帮助学生为学术界内外的未来做好准备[3]，但不可避免地会分散对核心培训的注意力。The implications for graduate education deserve particular attention. As computer technology and deep learning have co-evolved with HEP’s “big data” era, software engineering has, perhaps unintentionally, become a significant component of a graduate student’s training. This is a valuable technical foundation and prepares students well for futures inside and outside academia[3] , but inevitably distracts from core training as a物理学家physicist。编写代码已经成为HEP研究生工作的代名词，而技术实现是实现一个想法的最大瓶颈。. Writing code has become synonymous with HEP graduate student work, and technical implementation is the largest bottleneck to the realization of an idea.

如果人工智能代理能够处理实施问题，那么研究生培训就可以重新调整，以强调需要人类智能的研究方面：发展身体直觉，学会提出好的问题，理解测量的理论背景，以及练习评估分析结果是否可信所需的批判性思维。学生仍然需要理解他们的分析代码，并能够验证代理贡献的任何内容，但他们不需要从头开始编写每一行。这种对高层设计和评估而不是实施的关注反映了教师和博士后的工作方式，他们中的大多数人通过科学判断而不是编写代码做出最重要的贡献。人工智能代理只需将这种培训扩展到职业生涯的早期阶段。If AI agents can handle the implementation, graduate training can be restructured to emphasize the aspects of research that require human intelligence: developing physical intuition, learning to ask good questions, understanding the theoretical context of measurements, and practicing the kind of critical thinking needed to evaluate whether an analysis result is trustworthy. Students would still need to understand their analysis code and be able to validate anything an agent contributes, but they would not need to write every line of it from scratch. This focus on high-level design and evaluation rather than implementation mirrors how faculty and postdocs work, most of whom contribute most significantly via scientific judgment rather than writing code. AI agents would simply extend this training to earlier career stages.

4.6 遗留数据和重新分析4.6 Legacy data and reanalysis

一项特别引人注目的应用是对遗留数据集的重新分析。来自过去实验（包括 LEP、Tevatron、B-factories）的大量数据保存在档案中，可能包含与当前物理问题相关的信息[4]。自主分析代理可以系统地处理这些数据集，产生初步结果，然后人类物理学家可以对其进行评估和完善。我们对 ALEPH 和 DELPHI 数据的研究正是此类应用程序的概念证明。此外，遗留数据集可以使用现代计算工具进行重新分析，包括最初收集数据时无法使用的深度学习技术。One particularly compelling application is the reanalysis of legacy datasets. Enormous volumes of data from past experiments including LEP, the Tevatron, B-factories, sit in archives, potentially containing information relevant to current physics questions[4] . Autonomous analysis agents could systematically work through these datasets, producing first-pass results that human physicists can then evaluate and refine. Our work with ALEPH and DELPHI data is a proof of concept for exactly this kind of application. Moreover, legacy datasets become accessible to reanalysis with modern computational tools—including deep learning techniques that were unavailable when the data were originally collected.

除了新的分析之外，这种范式还为已发表结果的自动再现打开了大门，人工智能代理可以系统地重新执行现有论文的计算流程，标记不一致之处或以目前由于大规模验证所需的资源和人员限制而无法实现的规模确认研究结果[5]。Beyond new analyses, this paradigm also opens the door to automatic reproducibility of published results, where AI agents could systematically re-execute the computational pipelines of existing papers, flagging inconsistencies or confirming findings at a scale that is currently impractical due to the resource and personnel constraints needed for large-scale verification[5] .

4.7 限制和风险4.7 Limitations and risks

我们不想夸大当前系统的功能。必须承认几个重要的限制。We do not wish to overstate what current systems can do. Several important limitations must be acknowledged.

• 微妙的物理错误Subtle physics errors：代理可以生成表面上正确但包含细微物理错误的分析，例如，应用以不明显的方式使测量产生偏差的选择标准，或者忽略经验丰富的分析师会知道包含的系统不确定性。: Agents can produce analyses that are superficially correct but contain subtle physics errors—for example, applying a selection criterion that biases the measurement in a non-obvious way, or omitting a systematic uncertainty that an experienced analyst would know to include.

3未来几年，软件工程在工业中的价值可能会下降，具体取决于人工智能编码代理的持续发展。在撰写本文时，这个问题正在激烈争论。3The value of software engineering in industry may drop in the coming years, depending on the continued evolution of AI coding agents. At the time of writing, this mattery is hotly debated.

4 https://ee-alliance.org/是一个致力于解决这些问题的组织is one such organization pursuing these questions

5编码助手也将有助于理解遗留代码库和数据格式。5Coding assistants will also prove helpful for understanding legacy codebases and data formats.

19

  • 新奇Novelty：当前的代理擅长重现从文献中检索到的既定分析策略，但当被要求开发真正新颖的方法时，可靠性较差。对于需要创造性新技术的分析，以人为本的设计仍然至关重要。: Current agents excel at reproducing established analysis strategies retrieved from the literature but are less reliable when asked to develop genuinely novel approaches. For analyses that require creative new techniques, human-driven design remains essential.

  • 复杂度上限Complexity ceiling：我们演示的分析——Z 线形状、事件形状、: The analyses we have demonstrated—Z lineshape, event shapes,αS——是相对标准的测量。涉及多变量技术、多个控制区域中数据驱动的背景估计或跨多个通道的同时拟合的更复杂的分析仍有待论证。然而，包括展开技术在内的 Lund-Plane 和 EEC 测量结果从未发表过，这证明代理团队的复杂度上限相当高。—are relatively standard measurements. More complex analyses involving multivariate techniques, data-driven background estimation in multiple control regions, or simultaneous fits across many channels remain to be demonstrated. However, Lund-Plane and EEC measurements including unfolding techiques have never been published, proving that the complexity ceiling is quite high for agent teams.

  • 验证负担Verification burden：对代理生成的结果进行彻底的人工验证不可能是捷径。看起来正确但包含细微错误的分析可以说比根本没有分析更危险，因为它带有一种不劳而获的自信感。社区必须制定强有力的实践来验证人工智能产生的分析。: The need for thorough human verification of agent-produced results cannot be shortcut. An analysis that looks correct but contains a subtle error is arguably more dangerous than no analysis at all, because it carries an unearned sense of confidence. The community must develop robust practices for validating AI-produced analyses.

  • 遵循指令Instruction following：当代理被淹没在大型上下文窗口中时，它们很容易忽略指令。例如，代理可能会在图中重复使用绝对字体大小，尽管有明确的相反指示。: Agents are prone to ignoring instructions when they become buried in a large context window. For example, an agent may repeatedly use absolute font sizes in plots despite explicit instructions to the contrary.

  • 提示非决定论Prompt nondeterminism：代理输出本质上是随机的，使得即时优化变得困难。相同的提示可能会在运行中产生明显不同的分析策略或代码质量。: Agent outputs are inherently stochastic, making prompt optimization difficult. The same prompt can yield markedly different analysis strategies or code quality across runs.

  • 陈旧的工具知识Stale tool knowledge：代理倾向于依赖训练数据中的 API 和接口，说服他们查阅最新的文档以获取较新的软件包版本是非常困难的。: Agents tend to rely on APIs and interfaces from their training data, and convincing them to consult up-to-date documentation for newer package versions is surprisingly difficult.

  • 依赖管理不善Poor dependency management：代理倾向于编写临时补丁或解决方法，而不是提取更新的依赖项或添加轻量级的新依赖项，即使后者是正确的解决方案。: Agents are inclined to write ad hoc patches or workarounds rather than pulling an updated dependency or adding a lightweight new one, even when the latter would be the correct solution.

  • 对审查实践的了解有限Limited knowledge of review practices：内部协作审核流程不公开，并且不太可能出现在培训数据中。智能体可以很好地推理物理，但许多分析都具有经验丰富的审阅者会立即发现的特征性故障模式。在审查文档上构建内部检索增强生成系统可能有助于解决这个问题。: Internal collaboration review processes are not publicly available and are unlikely to appear in training data. Agents can reason about physics reasonably well, but many analyses have characteristic failure modes that experienced reviewers would catch immediately. Building internal retrieval-augmented generation systems over review documentation could help address this.

  • 缺少利基方法Missing niche methods：代理不太可能采用文献中不常见的分析技术，即使它们是合适的。这代表了特定领域微调的机会。: Agents are unlikely to employ analysis techniques that are not widespread in the literature, even when they would be appropriate. This represents an opportunity for domainspecific fine-tuning.

  • 背景和提示工程权衡Context and prompt engineering trade-offs：提供详细说明（这可以提高特异性，但可能会导致上下文膨胀和指令遵循退化）和保持提示简洁（这会保留上下文，但可能会留下未指定的重要约定）之间存在固有的紧张关系。: There is an inherent tension between providing detailed instructions (which improve specificity but risk context bloat and instruction-following degradation) and keeping prompts concise (which preserves context but may leave important conventions unspecified).

  • 风格选择Stylistic choices：虽然 LaTeX 有一些合理的默认值，但有许多选项和包可供选择，并且跨领域和期刊没有统一的风格。在描述和编码最终分析笔记应该如何实现所需的外观时，必须非常具体。: While LaTeX has some reasonable defaults, there are many options and packages to choose from and there is no uniform style across fields and journals. It it necessary to be extremely specific when describing and encoding what the final analysis note should like to achieve the desired look.

4.8 未来的工作4.8 Future Work

该框架的系统改进的几个方向仍有待探索。自然的下一步是对不同规范变体进行 A/B 测试，将更具规范性的方法文档与最小指导提示对分析质量、完整性和错误率的影响进行比较。同样重要的是表征代理输出的随机变异性：多次运行相同的提示和规范，并量化分析策略、数值结果和文档质量的分布，将为再现性建立基线，并确定管道的哪些方面对提示不确定性最敏感。Several directions for systematic improvement of the framework remain to be explored. A natural next step is A/B testing of different specification variants, comparing the effect of more prescriptive methodology documents against minimal-guidance prompts on analysis quality, completeness, and error rates. Equally important is characterizing the stochastic variability of agent outputs: running the same prompt and specification multiple times and quantifying the spread in analysis strategies, numerical results, and documentation quality would establish a baseline for reproducibility and identify which aspects of the pipeline are most sensitive to prompt nondeterminism.

20

审核系统本身提供了丰富的优化目标；当前的迭代上限和评审小组的组成是启发式选择的，并且系统地扫描最大评审轮数、评审代理组合和仲裁阈值可以揭示质量成本边界上的有利操作点。The review system itself offers a rich optimization target; the current iteration caps and reviewer panel composition were chosen heuristically, and a systematic sweep over the maximum number of review rounds, reviewer agent combinations, and arbiter thresholds could reveal favorable operating points on the quality– cost frontier.

除了 Claude Code 之外，该框架的架构原则上与后端无关，并且与其他代理编码系统（例如 OpenAI 的 Codex、Google 的 Jules 或开放权重代理框架）进行基准测试将阐明哪些功能特定于底层模型以及哪些功能来自规范和编排层。Beyond Claude Code, the framework’s architecture is in principle backend-agnostic, and benchmarking against other agentic coding systems such as OpenAI’s Codex, Google’s Jules, or open-weight agent frameworks would clarify which capabilities are specific to the underlying model and which emerge from the specification and orchestration layer.

最后，将框架扩展到更复杂的分析拓扑，包括多通道同时拟合、具有传输因子的数据驱动背景估计以及需要自定义重建或机器学习组件的分析，将映射代理可以自主处理的内容和仍然需要持续人类参与的内容之间的当前边界。Finally, extending the framework to more complex analysis topologies, including multi-channel simultaneous fits, data-driven background estimation with transfer factors, and analyses requiring custom reconstruction or machine learning components, would map the current boundary between what agents can handle autonomously and what still demands sustained human involvement.

4.9 实现稳健的人工智能辅助分析4.9 Toward robust AI-assisted analysis

前进的道路不是将人工智能代理部署为无监督的分析机器，而是在一个框架内将它们开发为强大的工具，以保持 HEP 社区正确要求的严格性和审查性。这需要在几个具体领域进行投资：The path forward is not to deploy AI agents as unsupervised analysis machines, but to develop them as powerful tools within a framework that preserves the rigor and scrutiny that the HEP community rightly demands. This requires investment in several concrete areas:

  1. 物理分析基准。Benchmarks for physics analysis.社区目前缺乏评估智能体在现实的端到端物理分析任务中表现的标准化基准。现有的基准测试（例如 CelloAI [3]）侧重于代码生成和文档；我们需要的是在已知事实的数据集上测试整个分析链（从事件选择设计到统计推断）的基准。 LHC Olympics [15] 异常检测挑战提供了部分模板，但针对具有现实系统不确定性结构的标准测量（横截面、耦合提取、事件形状变量）的基准将提供更多信息。The community currently lacks standardized benchmarks for evaluating agent performance on realistic, end-to-end physics analysis tasks. Existing benchmarks such as CelloAI [3] focus on code generation and documentation; what is needed are benchmarks that test the full analysis chain—from event selection design through statistical inference—on datasets with known ground truth. The LHC Olympics [15] anomaly detection challenge offers a partial template, but benchmarks targeting standard measurements (cross-sections, coupling extractions, event shape variables) with realistic systematic uncertainty structures would be far more informative.

  2. 用于人工智能生成的分析的标准化审查协议。Standardized review protocols for AI-produced analyses.合作应制定明确的协议来审查分析，其中大部分代码和策略是由人工智能代理生成的。这些协议应指定需要进行哪些额外审查，例如，强制独立地重新实施关键结果、将代理选择与已发布的基线进行系统比较，或者针对已知良好的分析输出进行自动回归测试。我们在本文中描述的多代理审查系统是朝这个方向迈出的一步，但它补充而不是取代人工审查。Collaborations should develop explicit protocols for reviewing analyses in which substantial portions of the code and strategy were produced by AI agents. These protocols should specify what additional scrutiny is warranted—for example, mandatory independent re-implementation of key results, systematic comparison of agentchosen selections against published baselines, or automated regression testing against known-good analysis outputs. The multi-agent review system we describe in this paper is a step in this direction, but it complements rather than replaces human review.

  3. 人工智能辅助工作流程培训。Training for AI-assisted workflows.物理学家需要接受如何有效监督和验证人工智能辅助工作的实践培训。这包括培养阅读和批判性评估他们没有编写的代码的能力，了解基于 LLM 的系统的故障模式（幻觉、指令漂移、过时的 API 知识），以及学习制定足够精确的分析规范来指导代理，同时保持足够的灵活性以允许其进行判断。研究生课程应该不断发展，将人工智能素养视为与统计方法、探测器物理学和编程并列的核心能力。Physicists need practical training in how to effectively supervise and validate AI-assisted work. This includes developing the ability to read and critically evaluate code they did not write, understanding the failure modes of LLM-based systems (hallucination, instruction drift, stale API knowledge), and learning to formulate analysis specifications that are precise enough to guide an agent while remaining flexible enough to allow it to exercise judgment. Graduate curricula should evolve to treat AI literacy as a core competency alongside statistical methods, detector physics, and programming.

  4. 制度适应。Institutional adaptation.合作机构需要更新其作者身份、审查和责任规范，以适应人工智能辅助的工作。人工智能参与的披露、人工智能产生的结果的责任归属以及人工智能辅助分析的文档要求的明确标准对于维持支撑该领域科学可信度的信任和严谨至关重要。Collaborations will need to update their authorship, review, and accountability norms to accommodate AI-assisted work. Clear standards for disclosure of AI involvement, attribution of responsibility for AI-produced results, and documentation requirements for AI-assisted analyses will be essential for maintaining the trust and rigor that underpin the field’s scientific credibility.

HEP 社区有着在出版前进行严格内部审查的悠久传统。随着人工智能工具变得更加强大，这一传统应该得到延续，而不是被放弃。The HEP community has a long tradition of rigorous internal review before publication. That tradition should be extended, not abandoned, as AI tools become more capable.

5 结论5 Conclusion

基于大型语言模型的人工智能代理，结合相对较小的结构化提示集，已经可以自主执行标准 HEP 分析管道的大部分。我们有AI agents based on large language models, combined with a relatively small set of structured prompts, can already autonomously execute substantial portions of a standard HEP analysis pipeline. We have

21

通过使用存档的 LEP 数据复制已发布的 ALEPH 和 DELPHI 测量值以及使用 CMS 开放数据复制 CMS 测量值，具体地证明了这一点，代理规划自己的分析策略，从文献中检索领域知识，执行完整的分析链，接受自动多代理审查，并生成完整的书面报告。我们强调，这些分析的工具包主要由法学硕士的结构化提示和指导组成；它绝不是复杂的，鉴于进入门槛较低，我们鼓励开发相关方法。demonstrated this concretely by reproducing published ALEPH and DELPHI measurements using archived LEP data and CMS measurements using CMS Open Data, with agents that plan their own analysis strategy, retrieve domain knowledge from the literature, execute the full analysis chain, undergo automated multiagent review, and produce complete written reports. We stress that the toolkit for these analyses is largely composed of structured prompts and guidance for the LLM; it is by no means sophisticated, and we encourage the development of related approaches given the low barrier to entry.

在研究生级别进行分析的技术已经出现，值得实验 HEP 社区的认真关注。我们并不是建议人工智能代理应该取代物理学家。我们建议他们可以接管目前占用分析师大部分时间的大部分技术要求高、通常很乏味的实施工作，使物理学家能够专注于他们最擅长的事情：发展物理洞察力，提出创造性问题，并运用人工智能系统尚无法复制的专家判断。此外，我们认为这是通向更复杂的物理分析的途径。可以更彻底地梳理数据，可以探索数据中的细节和特征，并且基于这些想法建立新的、全面的分析具有巨大的潜力。The technology to perform analysis at the graduate student level is here and warrants serious attention from the experimental HEP community. We are not suggesting that AI agents should replace physicists. We are suggesting that they can take over much of the technically demanding, often tedious, implementation work that currently consumes the majority of an analyst’s time, freeing physicists to focus on what they do best: developing physical insight, asking creative questions, and exercising the expert judgment that no AI system can yet replicate. Moreover, we see this as a path towards more sophisticated physics analyses. Data can be more thoroughly combed, details and features within the data can be explored, and there is significant potential for new, comprehensive analyses to be built on these ideas.

社区现在应该开始试验这些工具，开发工作流程、基准，并审查负责任地使用它们所需的实践。问题不在于人工智能代理是否会成为 HEP 分析工具包的一部分，而在于社区适应这些强大工具的速度有多快。The community should begin experimenting with these tools now, developing the workflows, benchmarks, and review practices needed to use them responsibly. The question is not whether AI agents will become part of the HEP analysis toolkit, but how quickly the community adapts to these powerful tools.

A.1.4 本分析概述A.1.4 Overview of this analysis

该分析使用 LEP 的 ALEPH 探测器在 1992 年至 1995 年运行期间收集的约 305 万个强子事件来测量 Z 玻色子线形。使用跨越 89.4–93.0 GeV 的五个不同质心能量组的数据来提取This analysis measures the Z boson lineshape using approximately 3.05 million hadronic events collected by the ALEPH detector at LEP during the 1992–1995 running periods. 24

使用包含重建事件级数量和预先计算的选择标志的预先存在的 ALEPH ntuples 来执行分析。该数据集的主要限制是：The analysis is performed using pre-existing ALEPH ntuples containing reconstructed event-level quantities and pre-computed selection flags. The key limitations of this dataset are:

  • 数据文件中不存储任何亮度信息；光度是从公布的 ALEPH 表（1993 年数据）和理论锚定计算（其他年份）中恢复的。No luminosity information is stored in the data files; luminosities are recovered from published ALEPH tables (1993 data) and from theory-anchored calculations (other years).

  • 仅强子事件可用；根据最低带电强子多重性要求，轻子通道在 ntuple 产生水平上被去除。Only hadronic events are available; leptonic channels were removed at the ntuple production level by a minimum charged-hadron multiplicity requirement.

  • 蒙特卡洛模拟仅适用于Monte Carlo simulation is available only at[√] s = 91 .2吉伏特；没有非高峰MC。2 GeV; there is no off-peak MC.

  • MC 中不提供真实级别的粒子识别或过程代码。No truth-level particle identification or process codes are available in the MC.

尽管存在这些限制，分析表明，可以从档案 LEP 数据中提取精确的电弱测量，并全面处理系统不确定性。Despite these limitations, the analysis demonstrates that precision electroweak measurements can be extracted from archival LEP data with a complete treatment of systematic uncertainties.

A.1.5 本说明的组织A.1.5 Organization of this note

本说明的结构如下。第 2 部分描述了数据和 MC 样本。第 3 节详细介绍了事件选择及其验证。第 4 节介绍了所应用的校正：ISR 卷积、效率、背景扣除和光度确定。第 5 节记录了系统不确定性评估。第 6 节介绍了所执行的交叉检查。第 7 节描述了拟合方法。第 8 节给出了结果，包括导出的数量。第 9 节与已发布的测量结果进行比较。第 10 节和第 11 节提供了结论和未来的方向。附录包含补充表格和矩阵。This note is organized as follows. Section 2 describes the data and MC samples. Section 3 details the event selection and its validation. Section 4 presents the corrections applied: ISR convolution, efficiency, background subtraction, and luminosity determination. Section 5 documents the systematic uncertainty evaluation. Section 6 presents the cross-checks performed. Section 7 describes the fitting method. Section 8 gives the results, including derived quantities. Section 9 compares to published measurements. Sections 10 and 11 provide conclusions and future directions. The appendices contain supplementary tables and matrices.

A.2 数据和 MC 样本A.2 Data and MC Samples

A.2.1 LEP 的 ALEPH 检测器A.2.1 The ALEPH detector at LEP

在 LEP 上运行的 ALEPH（LEP 物理仪器）探测器The ALEPH (Apparatus for LEP PHysics) detector operated at the LEPe[+] e[−]1989 年至 2000 年间，欧洲核子研究组织 (CERN) 的对撞机。该探测器配有硅顶点探测器、内部跟踪室、用于带电粒子跟踪的大型时间投影室 (TPC)、电磁和强子量热计以及 μ 子能谱仪，全部浸入 1.5 T 螺线管磁场中。跟踪和量热法的结合启用了 ALEPH 能量流算法，该算法以出色的分辨率重建带电和中性粒子。有关检测器的完整说明，请参阅（[collider at CERN from 1989 to 2000. The detector featured a silicon vertex detector, an inner tracking chamber, a large time projection chamber (TPC) for charged-particle tracking, electromagnetic and hadronic calorimeters, and a muon spectrometer, all immersed in a 1.5 T solenoidal magnetic field. The combination of tracking and calorimetry enabled the ALEPH energy-flow algorithm, which reconstructed charged and neutral particles with excellent resolution. For a complete description of the detector, see ([ref-阿莱夫˙忠ref-aleph˙zhong]）以及其中的参考文献。]) and references therein.

此分析中使用的数据由预处理的 ROOT ntuples 组成，每个事件包含 151 个分支，包括事件级运动量（能量、推力、球度、缺失动量）、粒子多重性和预先计算的强子选择标志。 ntuples 是从完整的 ALEPH 重建中产生的，并在生产级别应用了质量削减，包括最低带电强子多重性要求（The data used in this analysis consist of pre-processed ROOT ntuples containing 151 branches per event, including event-level kinematic quantities (energy, thrust, sphericity, missing momentum), particle multiplicities, and pre-computed hadronic selection flags. The ntuples were produced from the full ALEPH reconstruction with quality cuts applied at the production level, including a minimum charged-hadron multiplicity requirement (英寸≥nch ≥4）有效消除纯双轻子事件。4) that effectively removes pure di-lepton events.

预先计算的选择标志是：The pre-computed selection flags are:

  • passesNTrkMin：最小带电轨道多重性（100%，预切）: minimum charged track multiplicity (100%, pre-cut)

  • passesTotalChgEnergyMin：最小总充电能量（100%，预切）: minimum total charged energy (100%, pre-cut)

  • passesSTheta：推力轴极角: thrust axis polar angle

  • passesMissP：缺少动量否决权: missing momentum veto

  • passesISR：ISR光子否决权: ISR photon veto

  • passesWW：WW背景否决权: WW background veto

  • passesNeuNch：中性/带电能量平衡: neutral/charged energy balance

A.2.5 数据完整性A.2.5 Data completeness

ntuple 事件计数约占已发布的 ALEPH 光度预期事件总数的 84%。根据 1993 年的四个扫描点确定的完整性系数为 0，其中具有独立的光度The ntuple event counts represent approximately 84% of the total events expected from the published ALEPH luminosities. The completeness factor, determined from the four 1993 scan points where independent luminosities are available, is 0. 842 ± 0 .024. 这种减少可能是由于在 ntuple 生产水平上应用的质量削减和可能的运行子集选择。 1993 年四个扫描点的完整性因子一致（范围：0.816-0.881），其中 91.290 GeV 点显示出比其他三个点（0.816-0.835）稍高的完整性（0.881）。所有亮度均针对该因素进行校正。024. This reduction likely arises from quality cuts applied at the ntuple production level and possible run-subset selection. The completeness factor is consistent across the four 1993 scan points (range: 0.816–0.881), with the 91.290 GeV point showing a modestly higher completeness (0.881) compared to the other three (0.816–0.835). All luminosities are corrected for this factor.

A.3 事件选择A.3 Event Selection

A.3.1 PassAll 复合选择A.3.1 The passesAll composite selection

主要强子事件选择使用预先计算的The primary hadronic event selection uses the pre-computedpassesAll标志，它实现了根据已发布的标准验证的标准 ALEPH 强子选择（[flag, which implements the standard ALEPH hadronic selection validated against published criteria ([ref-阿莱夫˙忠ref-aleph˙zhong ]; [ 参考性的ref-aleph˙sical]）。复合选择由顺序应用的七个单独剪切组成。每次切割都针对特定的物理背景或探测器接受效果。]). The composite selection consists of seven individual cuts applied sequentially. Each cut targets a specific physics background or detector acceptance effect.

PassNTrkMin — 最小带电轨道重数passesNTrkMin — minimum charged track multiplicity这种切割需要事件中至少有 4 个带电轨道，拒绝低多重性背景，例如双光子事件、束流-气体相互作用和宇宙射线。强子 Z 衰变通常会产生This cut requires at least 4 charged tracks in the event, rejecting low-multiplicity backgrounds such as two-photon events, beam-gas interactions, and cosmic rays. Hadronic Z decays typically produce⟨nch⟩≈20 个带电粒子，因此这种切割基本上没有信号损失。在用于此分析的 ntuples 中，此削减已应用于生产级别，导致所有数据和 MC 事件的效率为 100.00%。这种切割的三重级应用还消除了纯双轻子事件（2轨拓扑），排除了轻子横截面测量。20 charged particles, so this cut has essentially no signal loss. In the ntuples used for this analysis, this cut was already applied at the production level, resulting in 100.00% efficiency for all data and MC events. The ntuple-level application of this cut also removes pure di-lepton events (2-track topology), precluding leptonic cross-section measurements.

PassTotalChgEnergyMin — 最小总充电能量passesTotalChgEnergyMin — minimum total charged energy这种切割需要带电粒子沉积的总能量最小，拒绝具有低可见能量的束气和双光子事件。与 PassNTrkMin 一样，此削减应用于 ntuple 生产级别，并且对于分析中的所有事件都是 100.00% 有效。This cut requires a minimum total energy deposited by charged particles, rejecting beam-gas and two-photon events with low visible energy. Like passesNTrkMin, this cut was applied at the ntuple production level and is 100.00% efficient for all events in the analysis.

PassSTheta — 推力轴极角passesSTheta — thrust axis polar angle通过要求推力轴至少为This cut ensures that the event is well-contained within the detector acceptance by requiring the thrust axis to be at least∼与光束轴成 26 度。推力轴接近束流方向的事件会使粒子逃逸到束流管中，从而导致测量的事件属性不佳。该切割的效率约为 97.5%，是预切割后信号损失最大的单一来源。使用标准 ALEPH 能量流算法从所有重建粒子计算推力轴方向。26 degrees from the beam axis. Events with the thrust axis close to the beam direction have particles escaping into the beam pipe, leading to poorly measured event properties. The efficiency of this cut is approximately 97.5%, representing the largest single source of signal loss after the pre-cuts. The thrust axis direction is computed from all reconstructed particles using the standard ALEPH energy-flow algorithm.

PassMissP — 缺少动量否决权passesMissP — missing momentum veto这会否决具有大量缺失动量的事件，目标是束气事件（产生不对称的能量沉积）、来自重味衰变的中微子事件以及逃脱探测器接受的粒子的事件。缺失的动量被计算为所有重建粒子动量的矢量和的大小。效率约为 97.0%，是第二大信号损失来源。This cut vetoes events with large missing momentum, targeting beam-gas events (which produce asymmetric energy deposits), events with neutrinos from heavy-flavour decays, and events with particles escaping the detector acceptance. The missing momentum is computed as the magnitude of the vector sum of all reconstructed particle momenta. The efficiency is approximately 97.0%, the second-largest source of signal loss.

PassISR 和 PassWW — ISR 光子和 WW 背景否决passesISR and passesWW — ISR photon and WW background vetoes这些削减拒绝了与硬初始态辐射（其中高能光子降低有效碰撞能量）和类 WW 拓扑一致的事件。在 LEP-1 能量下（These cuts reject events consistent with hard initial-state radiation (where a high-energy photon reduces the effective collision energy) and WW-like topologies. At LEP-1 energies ([√] s ≈91 GeV），WW 生产在运动学上被禁止（阈值91 GeV), WW production is kinematically forbidden (threshold∼161 GeV），但这些否决权也拒绝了罕见的辐射事件和探测器伪影。两种削减的效率约为 99.0%，并且它们在逐个事件的决策中几乎相同，表明共享或重叠的削减逻辑。161 GeV), but these vetoes also reject rare radiative events and detector artifacts. The efficiencies of both cuts are approximately 99.0%, and they are nearly identical in their event-by-event decisions, suggesting shared or overlapping cut logic.

PassNeuNch — 中性/带电能量平衡passesNeuNch — neutral/charged energy balance这种削减需要事件中中性能量与带电能量的平衡比例，拒绝具有异常量热仪沉积物的事件（例如，束壁相互作用产生中性粒子簇射）或带电粒子跟踪不完整的事件。效率约为99.5%。所有子标志中最大的数据-MC 差异出现在这次削减中：数据为 99.46%，MC 为 99.75%，0.29% 的差异可能表明中性能量响应的模型略有错误。This cut requires a balanced ratio of neutral to charged energy in the event, rejecting events with anomalous calorimeter deposits (e.g., beam-wall interactions producing showers of neutral particles) or events where the charged-particle tracking is incomplete. The efficiency is approximately 99.5%. The largest data-MC discrepancy among all sub-flags occurs in this cut: 99.46% in data versus 99.75% in MC, a 0.29% difference that may indicate slight mismodeling of the neutral energy response.

复合 passAll 标志Composite passesAll flagPassAll 标志表示复合强子选择，Z 峰值处的数据总体效率为 94.74%，MC 总体效率为 94.71%。该标志并非严格意义上的所有七个子标志的逻辑 AND：0.23% 的 MC 事件具有 PassAll = True，但所有单独标志的累积乘积未通过。这种微小的差异可能反映了略有不同的剪切逻辑（例如，某些子选择的 OR 条件），并且对分析的影响可以忽略不计。我们直接使用 PassAll，因为它代表校准的 ALEPH 选择。The passesAll flag represents the composite hadronic selection with an overall efficiency of 94.74% in data and 94.71% in MC at the Z peak. The flag is not strictly the logical AND of all seven sub-flags: 0.23% of MC events have passesAll = True but fail the cumulative product of all individual flags. This minor discrepancy may reflect slightly different cut logic (e.g., OR conditions for some sub-selections) and has negligible impact on the analysis. We use passesAll directly as it represents the calibrated ALEPH selection.

A.5 系统性不确定性A.5 Systematic Uncertainties

使用 B-5 协议评估系统不确定性：主要拟合仅使用统计误差Systematic uncertainties are evaluated using the B-5 protocol: the primary fit uses statistical errors only in theχ[2]获得每个参数的统计不确定性。对于每个系统源，相关输入量会因其不确定性而发生变化，并且会在统计误差的情况下重复拟合。标称拟合和平移拟合之间最佳拟合参数的差异定义了来自该源的系统不确定性。对于成对的变化（例如，光度±0.19%），取向上和向下移动的半差。该程序避免了重复计算，因为截面点上的第 3 阶段系统误差包括相同的光度、效率和背景不确定性，而这些不确定性在系统评估中有所不同。[2] to obtain the statistical uncertainty on each parameter. For each systematic source, the relevant input quantity is shifted by its uncertainty and the fit is repeated with statistical errors. The difference in the best-fit parameters between the nominal and shifted fits defines the systematic uncertainty from that source. For paired variations (e.g., luminosity ±0.19%), the half-difference of the upward and downward shifts is taken. This procedure avoids double-counting, since the Phase 3 systematic errors on the crosssection points include the same luminosity, efficiency, and background uncertainties that are varied in the systematic evaluation.

光度系统不确定度为 0.19%，结合了实验 SICAL 精度 (0.15%) 和理论巴巴截面不确定度 (0.11%)，如 ([The luminosity systematic uncertainty is 0.19%, combining the experimental SICAL precision (0.15%) and the theoretical Bhabha cross-section uncertainty (0.11%) in quadrature, as published in ([参考性的ref-aleph˙sical]）。光度不确定度仅影响横截面的绝对归一化：以 ±0.19% 的偏移改变光度尺度]). A common luminosity shift moves all cross-section points up or down together, changing only the peak height.

0.2% 的选择效率不确定性结合了三个正交贡献：MC 统计精度（771,597 个事件的二项式误差±0.025%）、独立选择交叉检查的数据-MC 差异（±0.05%，来自选择差异的 0.03% 数据-MC 一致性，作为保守估计加倍），以及分配用于覆盖模型差异的剩余建模不确定性（±0.19%）。在数据和 MC 之间传递 NeuNch 标志 (0.29%)。The selection efficiency uncertainty of 0.2% combines three contributions in quadrature: the MC statistical precision (±0.025% from the binomial error on 771,597 events), the data-MC difference from the independent selection cross-check (±0.05%, from the 0.03% data-MC agreement on the selection difference, doubled as a conservative estimate), and a residual modeling uncertainty (±0.19%) assigned to cover the discrepancy in the passesNeuNch flag between data and MC (0.29%).

A.5.3 背景扣除A.5.3 Background subtraction

根据标准 ALEPH 实践，通过将每个背景成分改变 ±50% 来评估背景系统（[The background systematic is evaluated by varying each background component by ±50%, following standard ALEPH practice ([参考性的ref-aleph˙sical]）。 50% 的不确定性反映了背景估计方法的有限精度，该方法依赖于已发布的参考分数和能量缩放参数，而不是直接的边带测量。主要贡献来自双光子分量，它具有最大的绝对分数和最强的能量依赖性。]). The 50% uncertainty reflects the limited precision of the background estimation method, which relies on published reference fractions and energy-scaling arguments rather than direct sideband measurements. The dominant contribution comes from the two-photon component, which has the largest absolute fraction and the strongest energy dependence.

A.6.1 每周期的一致性A.6.1 Per-period consistency

每年的横截面比较测试了 1992-1995 年运行期间光度策略和探测器稳定性的一致性。 1993 年（方法 1）和 1995 年（方法 2）横截面在重叠能量点进行比较：The per-year cross-section comparison tests the consistency of the luminosity strategy and detector stability across the 1992–1995 running period. The 1993 (Tier 1) and 1995 (Tier 2) cross-sections are compared at overlapping energy points:

在所有重叠能量下，1993 年的横截面系统地低于 1995 年的值。这是从光度等级差异中预料到的：第 1 层使用已发布的 SICAL 光度，而第 2 层使用具有全局归一化因子的理论推导的光度。每个周期的不一致主要是归一化效应，而不是物理偏差，并且由光度和效率系统涵盖。The 1993 cross-sections are systematically lower than the 1995 values at all overlapping energies. This is expected from the luminosity tier difference: Tier 1 uses published SICAL luminosities while Tier 2 uses theory-derived luminosities with a global normalization factor. The per-period inconsistency is primarily a normalization effect, not a physics bias, and is covered by the luminosity and efficiency systematics.

这被归类为 B 类验证检查：重要但易于理解，并且记录了根本原因（亮度等级差异）并由系统预算涵盖。 10% 的子样本再现了这种模式，但显着性降低（This is classified as a Category B validation check: significant but understood, and the underlying cause (luminosity tier difference) is documented and covered by the systematic budget. A 10% subsample reproduces this pattern with reduced significance (χ[2] /ndf = 26 . 4 / 7, p < 0 . 001).

A.7.4 装配程序A.7.4 Fitting procedure

最小化使用两阶段方法：用于全局搜索的 Nelder-Mead 单纯形（对局部最小值具有鲁棒性），然后是用于细化的 L-BFGS-B 梯度下降（提供用于不确定性估计的 Hessian 矩阵）。 Nelder-Mead 阶段从 PDG 初始值开始并收敛于Minimization uses a two-stage approach: Nelder-Mead simplex for the global search (robust against local minima), followed by L-BFGS-B gradient descent for refinement (provides the Hessian matrix for uncertainty estimation). The Nelder-Mead stage starts from PDG initial values and converges within∼50 个功能评估。 L-BFGS-B 级精炼至机器精度，并通过有限差分二阶导数计算数值 Hessian50 function evaluations. The L-BFGS-B stage refines to machine precision and computes the numerical Hessian via finite-difference second derivatives ofχ[2] .

从 Hessian 逆矩阵的对角线元素中提取参数不确定性：The parameter uncertainties are extracted from the diagonal elements of the inverse Hessian matrix:σpj = �( H[−][1] ) jj。协方差矩阵是完全逆 Hessian 矩阵，提供参数之间的相关性。. The covariance matrix is the full inverse Hessian, providing the correlations between parameters.

A.7.5 拟合优度A.7.5 Goodness of fit

仅统计拟合：Stat-only fit: χ[2] /ndf = 39.5/2 = 19.7。这个高值反映了两个间隔很近的峰区点（低峰位于 91.196 GeV，高峰位于 91.285 GeV）之间的真正张力，其横截面与统计误差相比相差 0.32 nb[2] /ndf = 39.5/2 = 19.7. This high value reflects genuine tension between the two closelyspaced peak-region points (peak low at 91.196 GeV and peak high at 91.285 GeV), whose cross-sections differ by 0.32 nb compared to statistical errors of∼每个 0.03 nb。这个0.03 nb each. This∼ 11 σ统计紧张的出现是因为系统的不确定性（主要由光度和效率决定）statistical tension arises because the systematic uncertainties (dominated by luminosity and efficiency at∼每个 0.10 nb) 不包含在仅统计拟合中。0.10 nb each) are not included in the stat-only fit.

总误差拟合（交叉检查）：Total-error fit (cross-check): χ[2] /ndf = 3.07/2 = 1.53（p 值[2] /ndf = 3.07/2 = 1.53 (p-value≈ 0 .22）。当包含系统不确定性时，峰区张力减小为22). When the systematic uncertainties are included, the peak-region tension is reduced to∼ (1 . 2) σ，确认横截面测量在其总不确定性范围内是自洽的。, confirming that the cross-section measurements are self-consistent within their total uncertainties.

系统论主导的性质The systematics-dominated nature of theχ[2]是精密LEP测量的特点，其统计精度远远超过绝对截面尺度的系统控制。[2] is characteristic of precision LEP measurements, where the statistical precision far exceeds the systematic control of the absolute cross-section scale.

B.1 简介B.1 Introduction

B.1.1 物理动机B.1.1 Physics motivation

隆德喷气式飞机提供了喷气机内辐射模式的理论上的表示。由 Dreyer、Salam 和 Soyez 提出（[The Lund jet plane provides a theoretically motivated representation of the radiation pattern within jets. Proposed by Dreyer, Salam, and Soyez ([参考-德雷尔：2018nbfref-Dreyer:2018nbf]），主 Lund 平面将 Cambridge/Aachen (C/A) 去簇的每个步骤映射到坐标 (ln 1]), the primary Lund plane maps each step of Cambridge/Aachen (C/A) declustering to coordinates (ln 1/ ∆ θ, ln 千吨/kt/GeV)，其中 ΔGeV), where ∆θ是两个插脚之间的张角，is the opening angle between the two prongs andkt = |⃗p软的soft|正弦Δsin ∆θ是较软爪的相对横向动量。由此产生的二维密度is the relative transverse momentum of the softer prong. The resulting two-dimensional densityρ（在 1(ln 1/ ∆ θ, ln kt）直接探测 QCD 分裂函数并连接微扰发射（高) directly probes the QCD splitting function and connects perturbative emissions (highkt）到强子化区域（低) to the hadronization region (lowkt）在单个可观察量中。) in a single observable.

在微扰状态下，初级隆德平面密度近似恒定并且等于In the perturbative regime, the primary Lund plane density is approximately constant and equal toαsCF /π, 其中, whereCF = 4 /3是夸克色因子。在超前对数精度下，密度在运动学极限所限定的三角相空间内是均匀的。高阶 QCD 效应的修正，运行3 is the quark colour factor. At leading-logarithmic accuracy, the density is uniform across the triangular phase space bounded by the kinematic limit. Corrections from higher-order QCD effects, running ofαs，而非微扰强子化会产生与这种均匀模式的偏差，使隆德平面成为微扰和非微扰 QCD 动力学的敏感探针。, and non-perturbative hadronization produce deviations from this uniform pattern, making the Lund plane a sensitive probe of both perturbative and non-perturbative QCD dynamics.

隆德平面形式主义统一了几个经过充分研究的喷流子结构可观测值。隆德平面在角轴上的投影产生与射流展宽相关的排放角分布，而在The Lund plane formalism unifies several well-studied jet substructure observables. Projections of the Lund plane onto the angular axis yield the angular distribution of emissions, related to jet broadening, while projections ontokt探测软辐射的横向动量谱，与射流质量和碎片函数相关。二维结构捕获了在一维投影中丢失的这些可观测值之间的相关性。probe the transverse momentum spectrum of soft radiation, connected to the jet mass and fragmentation functions. The two-dimensional structure captures correlations between these observables that are lost in one-dimensional projections.

隆德喷气式飞机的第一次实验测量是由 ATLAS 在质子-质子碰撞中进行的The first experimental measurement of the Lund jet plane was performed by ATLAS in proton-proton collisions at[√] s = 13 TeV ([ 参考 ATLAS:2020bbnref-ATLAS:2020bbn]）。电子-正电子碰撞中不存在任何测量，其中没有潜在事件、强子的初始态辐射以及与束残余的颜色重新连接，使得环境对于测试 QCD 辐射图案和强子化模型来说是独一无二的清洁。的]). No measurement exists in electron-positron collisions, where the absence of underlying event, initial-state radiation from hadrons, and color reconnection with beam remnants makes the environment uniquely clean for testing QCD radiation patterns and hadronization models. Thee[+] e[−]Z 极的环境为隆德平面测量提供了几个独特的优势：environment at the Z pole provides several distinctive advantages for Lund plane measurements:

  • 无基础事件：No underlying event:强子最终状态完全由初级的碎片产物组成The hadronic final state consists entirely of fragmentation products of the primaryqq¯ 对，没有额外的多部分相互作用污染射流结构。¯ pair, with no additional multi-parton interactions contaminating the jet structure.

  • 已知初始状态：Known initial state:质心能量是精确已知的（The center-of-mass energy is precisely known ([√] s = MZ = 91 . 1880 ± 0 .0020 吉伏 ([0020 GeV ([参考-PDG：2024ref-PDG:2024]))，并且初始态 QCD 辐射不存在。])), and the initial-state QCD radiation is absent.

  • 半球喷气机：Hemisphere jets:Z 极的双射流拓扑提供了自然的射流定义（半球），而没有射流算法和射流搜索固有参数的模糊性。The two-jet topology at the Z pole provides a natural jet definition (hemispheres) without the ambiguities of jet algorithms and jet-finding parameters inherent topp测量。measurements.

  • 民主风味成分：Democratic flavor composition:Z 玻色子衰变为具有众所周知的支化比的所有夸克味，提供了对夸克味的包容性测量。The Z boson decays to all quark flavors with well-known branching ratios, providing an inclusive measurement over quark flavors.

该分析测量了强子 Z 衰变中的主要隆德射流平面密度This analysis measures the primary Lund jet plane density in hadronic Z decays at[√] s = 91 .2 GeV 使用 LEP 对撞机存档的 ALEPH 数据，提供了电子-正电子碰撞中的首次此类测量。2 GeV using archived ALEPH data from the LEP collider, providing the first such measurement in electron-positron collisions.

B.1.2 可观察定义B.1.2 Observable definition

测量是在带电粒子水平上定义的。稳定带电粒子（The measurement is defined at the charged-particle level. Stable charged particles (τ >cτ >使用来自强子 Z 衰变的 10 mm）。这包括带电π介子、介子、质子、电子和μ介子（及其反粒子）。根据所有稳定粒子（带电和中性）计算的推力轴将每个事件分为两个半球。这种混合定义——全粒子推力轴但仅带电粒子隆德平面内容——遵循事件形状测量的标准 LEP 约定（[10 mm) from hadronic Z decays are used. This includes charged pions, kaons, protons, electrons, and muons (and their antiparticles). The thrust axis, computed from all stable particles (charged and neutral), divides each event into two hemispheres. This mixed definition — all-particle thrust axis but charged-particle-only Lund plane content — follows the standard LEP convention for event shape measurements ([参考-LEP：QCD：2004ref-LEP:QCD:2004]）并引入了对推力轴中性粒子建模的敏感性，这被视为系统不确定性。]) and introduces sensitivity to neutral particle modeling in the thrust axis, which is treated as a systematic uncertainty.

每个半球使用剑桥/亚琛算法独立聚类（[Each hemisphere is independently clustered using the Cambridge/Aachen algorithm ([参考 Dokshitzer:1997inref-Dokshitzer:1997in]) 与]) withR = π（完整的半球覆盖，因为每个半球最多可覆盖(full hemisphere coverage, since each hemisphere subtends up toπ推力轴的弧度）和 E 方案（四矢量）重组。该实现使用 fastjet Python 绑定（[radians from the thrust axis) and E-scheme (four-vector) recombination. The implementation uses the fastjet Python bindings ([参考卡恰里：2011maref-Cacciari:2011ma ]).

66

密度The densityρ在隆德平面上每单位面积的半球进行归一化：is normalized per hemisphere per unit area in the Lund plane:

A flat-prior gate (20% threshold) is applied post-unfolding to identify and exclude bins dominated by prior dependence rather than data.

该测量被定义为包含粒子级别的 ISR。在推力计算之前，ISR 光子不会从事件中移除，但 ISR 光子本身不会聚集（仅带电粒子）。具有硬 ISR 的事件通过事件选择削减而被删除。The measurement is defined as ISR-inclusive at particle level. ISR photons are not removed from the event before thrust computation, but ISR photons themselves are not clustered (charged particles only). Events with hard ISR are removed by the event selection cuts.

先前没有对隆德喷气飞机的电子-正电子碰撞进行过测量。 ATLAS Lund 平面测量（[No prior measurement of the Lund jet plane exists in electron-positron collisions. The ATLAS Lund plane measurement ([参考 ATLAS:2020bbnref-ATLAS:2020bbn]) 在质子-质子碰撞中]) in proton-proton collisions at[√] s= 13 TeV 是主要参考，尽管碰撞环境不同（具有反作用的助推射流）= 13 TeV is the primary reference, though the different collision environment (boosted jets with anti-ktRkt R = 0 .4 和4 and点 >pT >675 GeV vs.~半球675 GeV vs.˜hemispheres at[√] s = 91 .2吉伏，2 GeV,pp对比~vs.˜e[+] e[−]) 限制了直接的数值比较。) limits direct numerical comparison.

LEP 事件形状测量，特别是全面的 LEP QCD 工作组分析（[LEP event shape measurements, particularly the comprehensive LEP QCD working group analysis ([参考-LEP：QCD：2004ref-LEP:QCD:2004]），使用相同的 ALEPH 检测器和类似的分析技术提供最接近的方法参考。这里使用的归档 ALEPH 数据集与 Baumgart 的双粒子相关分析中的数据集相同（[]), provide the closest methodological reference using the same ALEPH detector and similar analysis techniques. The archived ALEPH dataset used here is the same as in the two-particle correlation analysis by Baumgart ([参考鲍姆加特：论文ref-Baumgart:thesis]），建立了本次分析中采用的赛道和赛事选择框架。]), which established the track and event selection framework adopted in this analysis.

B.2 探测器和数据样本B.2 Detector and data samples

B.2.1 LEP 的 ALEPH 检测器B.2.1 The ALEPH detector at LEP

ALEPH（LEP 物理仪器）探测器于 1989 年至 2000 年间在欧洲核子研究中心的大型正负电子对撞机 (LEP) 上运行。该探测器是一种通用粒子物理实验，设计用于精密电弱测量，并在 Z 共振及以上搜索新物理。The ALEPH (Apparatus for LEP Physics) detector operated at the Large Electron-Positron collider (LEP) at CERN from 1989 to 2000. The detector was a general-purpose particle physics experiment designed for precision electroweak measurements and searches for new physics at the Z resonance and above.

对于本次分析至关重要的跟踪系统由 1.5 T 螺线管磁场内的三个组件组成：The tracking system, critical for this analysis, consisted of three components within a 1.5 T solenoidal magnetic field:

67

  • 硅顶点探测器 (VDET)：Silicon Vertex Detector (VDET):两层双面硅条探测器，距离光束轴半径分别为 6.3 和 10.8 厘米，提供分辨率约为 12 的精确顶点Two layers of double-sided silicon strip detectors at radii of 6.3 and 10.8 cm from the beam axis, providing precision vertexing with a resolution of approximately 12µ米在m inrϕ在最内层。at the innermost layer.

  • 内部跟踪室 (ITC)：Inner Tracking Chamber (ITC):八层圆柱形漂移室，半径为 16 至 26 厘米，每个轨道提供多达 8 个空间点并有助于触发。An eight-layer cylindrical drift chamber spanning radii from 16 to 26 cm, providing up to 8 space points per track and contributing to the trigger.

  • 时间投影室 (TPC)：Time Projection Chamber (TPC):主跟踪探测器是一个内半径为 31 厘米、外半径为 180 厘米的大型圆柱形漂移室，每个轨道提供多达 21 个三维空间点和多达 320 个电离样本，用于通过特定能量损失进行粒子识别（The primary tracking detector, a large cylindrical drift chamber with inner radius 31 cm and outer radius 180 cm, providing up to 21 three-dimensional space points per track and up to 320 ionization samples for particle identification via specific energy loss (dE/dx）。 TPC 对动量测量做出了主要贡献。). The TPC provided the dominant contribution to the momentum measurement.

组合跟踪系统实现了横向动量分辨率 ΔThe combined tracking system achieved a transverse momentum resolution of ∆点/点pT /p[2] T ≈ 1 . 2 × 10 [−][3]（GeV[3] (GeV/c ) [−][1] ([ 参考-阿莱夫：EECref-ALEPH:EEC]），为与 Z 衰变产物相关的能量范围（通常为 0.2–45 GeV）提供出色的带电粒子重建。]), providing excellent charged-particle reconstruction for the energy range relevant to Z decay products (typically 0.2–45 GeV).

除了跟踪体积之外，ALEPH 还配备了一个铅/线室夹层结构的电磁量热计 (ECAL)，具有大约 23 个辐射长度，一个铁/流光管设计的强子量热计 (HCAL)，提供大约 7 个相互作用长度，以及一个在 HCAL 外部具有两个双层流光管的 μ 子能谱仪。这些外部探测器有助于用于推力轴计算的能量流重建，但不直接进入仅使用带电轨道的隆德平面测量。Beyond the tracking volume, ALEPH featured an electromagnetic calorimeter (ECAL) of lead/wirechamber sandwich construction with approximately 23 radiation lengths, a hadron calorimeter (HCAL) of iron/streamer-tube design providing approximately 7 interaction lengths, and a muon spectrometer with two double layers of streamer tubes outside the HCAL. These outer detectors contribute to the energy-flow reconstruction used for the thrust axis computation but do not directly enter the Lund plane measurement, which uses charged tracks only.

B.2.2 数据样本B.2.2 Data samples

数据由 ALEPH 在 LEP1 在 Z 极运行期间收集的强子 Z 衰变事件组成（The data consist of hadronic Z decay events collected by ALEPH during LEP1 running at the Z pole ([√] s ≈ 91 .2 GeV）从 1992 年到 1995 年。这些文件是存档的根元组，带有预先计算的选择标志，由原始 ALEPH 重建软件生成。存档数据代表 ALEPH 在高光度 Z 极运行期间收集的完整 LEP1 数据集。2 GeV) from 1992 to 1995. The files are archived ROOT ntuples with pre-computed selection flags, produced by the original ALEPH reconstruction software. The archived data represent the full LEP1 dataset collected by ALEPH during the high-luminosity Z-pole running period.

限制[L2]：Limitation [L2]:没有具有完整 ALEPH 探测器模拟的替代生成器（HERWIG、ARIADNE）可用。强子化系统是通过粒子级重新加权而不是独立的探测器模拟来估计的。这是 LEP 事件形状测量的主要预期系统（[No alternative generator (HERWIG, ARIADNE) with full ALEPH detector simulation is available. The hadronization systematic is estimated through particle-level reweighting rather than an independent detector simulation. This is the dominant expected systematic for event shape measurements at LEP ([参考-LEP：QCD：2004ref-LEP:QCD:2004]），其中强子化校正通常为 5-10%。]), where hadronization corrections are typically 5–10%.

使用预先计算的布尔标志来选择事件，这些标志实现了标准 ALEPH 强子事件选择（[Events are selected using pre-computed boolean flags that implement the standard ALEPH hadronic event selection ([参考鲍姆加特：论文ref-Baumgart:thesis ]; [ ref-ALEPH:夸克˙胶子ref-ALEPH:quark˙gluon]）。选择标准严格遵循之前强子 Z 衰变 ALEPH 分析中使用的标准，确保与该数据集既定选择框架的一致性。]). 收费曲目的选择有两个标准：Charged tracks are selected with two criteria:

  • pwflag == 0：从主顶点重建中选择带电轨迹，不包括中性簇和光子转换。: selects charged tracks from the primary vertex reconstruction, excluding neutral clusters and photon conversions.

  • highPurity == 1：从 ALEPH 重建软件中选择高纯度轨迹，隐式执行最低跟踪质量要求，包括 TPC 命中阈值。: selects high-purity tracks from the ALEPH reconstruction software, implicitly enforcing minimum tracking quality requirements including a TPC hit threshold.

在探测器层面没有应用明确的横向动量削减；粒子级定义使用完全接受，响应矩阵处理校正。的No explicit transverse momentum cut is applied at detector level; the particle-level definition uses full acceptance and the response matrix handles the correction. ThehighPurity标志隐式强制执行最低跟踪质量要求，包括 TPC 命中阈值，尽管确切的阈值是在重建软件中编码的。明确的flag implicitly enforces minimum tracking quality requirements including a TPC hit threshold, though the exact threshold is encoded within the reconstruction software. An explicitn TPC ≥4 次切割被用作系统变异（参见第 6.5 节）。每个事件的平均选定曲目：17.5。4 cut was used as a systematic variation (see Section 6.5). Mean selected tracks per event: 17.5.

B.3.3 半球分配B.3.3 Hemisphere assignment

^ ^ 粒子根据 的符号分配到半球ˆ ˆ Particles are assigned to hemispheres based on the sign of⃗p·nT⃗p · nT, 其中, wherenT是由计算得出的推力轴is the thrust axis computed from theTTheta和andTPhi分支机构。对于数据和 reco 级 MC，遵循标准 ALEPH 约定，使用全粒子推力轴（使用带电轨道和中性能量流对象）。对于发电机级 MC，推力轴是根据所有生成的稳定粒子（带电和中性，带有branches. For data and reco-level MC, the all-particle thrust axis (using both charged tracks and neutral energy-flow objects) is used, following the standard ALEPH convention. For generator-level MC, the thrust axis is recomputed from all generated stable particles (charged and neutral, withτ >cτ >10 毫米）。10 mm).

使用全粒子推力轴（而不是仅带电）可以最大限度地减少半球迁移效应，因为当包含中性粒子时可以更好地确定推力轴。推力轴确定中对中性粒子模型的敏感性被评估为系统不确定性（第 6.7 节）。The use of the all-particle thrust axis (rather than charged-only) minimizes hemisphere migration effects, since the thrust axis is better determined when neutral particles are included. The sensitivity to neutral particle modeling in the thrust axis determination is evaluated as a systematic uncertainty (Section 6.7).

B.4 可观察的定义：隆德平面构造B.4 Observable definition: Lund plane construction

B.4.1 剑桥/亚琛聚类B.4.1 Cambridge/Aachen clustering

每个半球选定的带电轨迹均使用剑桥/亚琛 (C/A) 算法独立聚类（[Each hemisphere’s selected charged tracks are clustered independently using the Cambridge/Aachen (C/A) algorithm ([参考 Dokshitzer:1997inref-Dokshitzer:1997in]) 与]) withR = π（完整的半球覆盖，因为每个半球对向(full hemisphere coverage since each hemisphere subtends up toπ推力轴的弧度）和 E 方案（四矢量）重组。 C/A 算法是一种由距离度量定义的角度排序聚类算法radians from the thrust axis) and E-scheme (four-vector) recombination. The C/A algorithm is an angular-ordered clustering algorithm defined by the distance measure迪杰dij = 2(1 −因斯cosθij) 粒子之间) between particlesi和andj, 其中, whereθij是它们动量之间的角度。光束距离为is the angle between their momenta. The beam distance is二乙diB = 2(1 −因斯cosR）与) withR = π，使得半球中的所有粒子都聚集成一个射流。该实现使用 fastjet Python 绑定（[, so that all particles in the hemisphere are clustered into a single jet. The implementation uses the fastjet Python bindings ([参考卡恰里：2011maref-Cacciari:2011ma ]).

选择 C/A 算法是因为它的角度排序会产生一棵聚类树，其主要分簇序列直接对应于主要 Lund 平面 ([The C/A algorithm is chosen because its angular ordering produces a clustering tree whose primary declustering sequence corresponds directly to the primary Lund plane ([参考-德雷尔：2018nbfref-Dreyer:2018nbf]）。这与 ATLAS Lund 平面测量使用的算法相同（[]). This is the same algorithm used by the ATLAS Lund plane measurement ([参考 ATLAS:2020bbnref-ATLAS:2020bbn]），确保方法的一致性。]), ensuring methodological consistency.

B.4.2 初级分簇B.4.2 Primary declustering

主要的分簇过程迭代地遍历 C/A 聚类树：The primary declustering procedure walks the C/A clustering tree iteratively:

  1. 从最终合并的喷流（半球）开始。Start from the final merged jet (the hemisphere).

  2. 在每个节点，通过以下方式识别较硬和较软的插脚At each node, identify the harder and softer prongs bypT .

  3. 记录较软的插脚的隆德平面坐标：Record the softer prong’s Lund plane coordinates:

  4. ∆ θ= 反余弦(^= arccos(ˆp 1 · p^2)ˆ2)

  5. kt = |⃗p软的soft|正弦（Δsin(∆θ )

  6. 坐标：Coordinates:x = ln(1 / ∆ θ ), y = ln( 千吨/kt/吉伏）GeV)

  7. 沿着较硬的插脚到达下一个节点。Follow the harder prong to the next node.

  8. 继续直到没有进一步的结构（单个颗粒）。Continue until no further structure (single particle).

该过程在探测器水平上每个半球平均产生 5.02 个初级去簇（MC reco 中为 5.07，发生器水平上为 6.10）。 reco 和 gen 之间的差异反映了跟踪效率低下时软排放和前向排放的损失。This procedure yields an average of 5.02 primary declusterings per hemisphere at detector level (5.07 in MC reco, 6.10 at generator level). The difference between reco and gen reflects the loss of soft and forward emissions to tracking inefficiency.

B.5 纠正程序B.5 Correction procedure

从原始探测器级计数到最终粒子级密度的完整校正链分五个连续步骤进行：The full correction chain from raw detector-level counts to the final particle-level density proceeds in five sequential steps:

  1. 原始检测器级直方图：Raw detector-level histogram:为数据中的每个主要分簇计算隆德平面坐标，并将条目绘制成直方图到分析箱中以获得The Lund plane coordinates are computed for each primary declustering in data, and entries are histogrammed into the analysis bins to obtainh原始的raw,i .

  2. 假减法：Fake subtraction:使用 MC 派生的假分数减去不匹配的 reco 级别去聚（假）（等式 32）：Unmatched reco-level declusterings (fakes) are subtracted using MC-derived fake fractions (eq. 32):h已纠正corrected,i = h原始的raw,我×,i × (1 - f− f假的fake,i ).

  3. 迭代贝叶斯展开：Iterative Bayesian Unfolding:通过列归一化响应矩阵展开假减直方图The fake-subtracted histogram is unfolded through the columnnormalized response matrix里杰Rij使用 IBU (eq. 34) 和标称迭代计数（对于 ln(1 为 5using IBU (eq. 34) with the nominal iteration count (5 for ln(1/ ∆ θ), 6 表示 ln(), 6 for ln(kt))，产生展开的 bin 计数)), yielding the unfolded bin countsN展开的unfolded,i .

  4. 效率修正：Efficiency correction:针对每箱重建效率对展开计数进行校正The unfolded counts are corrected for the per-bin reconstruction efficiencyϵi（具有 reco 级别匹配的 gen 级别分簇的分数）。(the fraction of gen-level declusterings with a reco-level match).

  5. 密度归一化：Density normalization:效率校正计数被归一化为每半球每单位箱宽的 Lund 平面密度（等式 31）：The efficiency-corrected counts are normalized to the Lund plane density per hemisphere per unit bin width (eq. 31):ρi = N展开的unfolded,我/,i/ ( ϵi·Nϵi · N半hemi· ∆ i ).

下面的小节详细描述了每个步骤。Each step is described in detail in the subsections below.

B.5.1 响应矩阵构建B.5.1 Response matrix construction

输入验证Input validation在构建响应矩阵之前，根据展开测量的惯例，对进入可观测计算的所有运动学变量进行数据/MC 比较。比较使用完整的 ALEPH 数据集（289 万个选定事件）和完整的 MC 样本（731,006 个选定事件），并将 MC 标准化为数据积分以进行形状比较。Before constructing the response matrix, data/MC comparisons were produced for all kinematic variables entering the observable calculation, as required by the conventions for unfolded measurements. The comparisons use the full ALEPH dataset (2.89 million selected events) and the full MC sample (731,006 selected events), with the MC normalized to the data integral for shape comparison.

验证涵盖：跟踪The validation covers: trackpT（图24），轨道(fig. 24), trackθ（图 25）、推力（图 26）、半球多重性（图 27）以及探测器水平的 Lund 平面坐标（图 30、图 31）。附录 E 中收集了第 3 阶段的其他输入验证图。(fig. 25), thrust (fig. 26), hemisphere multiplicity (fig. 27), and the Lund plane coordinates at detector level (fig. 30, fig. 31). Additional input validation plots from Phase 3 are collected in Appendix E.

摘要：Summary:所有运动学变量的数据/MC 一致性在 5% 以内。没有观察到表明探测器响应存在明显错误建模的系统趋势。这验证了使用 PYTHIA 6 MC 构建响应矩阵。Data/MC agreement is within 5% across all kinematic variables. No systematic trends are observed that would indicate significant mismodeling of the detector response. This validates the use of PYTHIA 6 MC for response matrix construction.

施工流程Construction procedure响应矩阵将发电机级 Lund 平面 bin 映射到 reco 级 bin，由半球匹配的 reco-gen MC 对构建。匹配过程使用：The response matrix maps generator-level Lund plane bins to reco-level bins, constructed from hemisphere-matched reco-gen MC pairs. The matching procedure uses:

  1. 同一事件：Same event:Reco 和 gen 树在 ROOT 文件中共享相同的事件索引，保证事件级匹配。Reco and gen trees share the same event indexing in the ROOT files, guaranteeing event-level matching.

  2. 同一个半球：Same hemisphere:在每个事件中，reco 和 gen 分簇都使用各自的推力轴分配给半球。正推力半球中的 Reco 去簇与正推力半球中的 gen 去簇相匹配（负推力半球也类似）。Within each event, reco and gen declusterings are assigned to hemispheres using their respective thrust axes. Reco declusterings in the positive-thrust hemisphere are matched to gen declusterings in the positive-thrust hemisphere (and similarly for negative).

  3. 基于索引的分簇匹配：Index-based declustering matching:的Then- 半球内的第 reco 去簇与-th reco declustering within a hemisphere is matched to then同一半球内的第 一代分簇。-th gen declustering within the same hemisphere.

这种基于索引的匹配是一个近似值。 C/A 树结构在 reco 和 gen 级别之间不同的半球（由于创建或删除聚类节点的分辨率效应）可能会产生不匹配的条目，从而扩大响应矩阵的非对角线元素。基于几何的匹配（最接近 ΔThis index-based matching is an approximation. Hemispheres where the C/A tree structure differs between reco and gen levels (due to resolution effects creating or removing clustering nodes) may produce mismatched entries, which broaden the off-diagonal elements of the response matrix. A geometry-based matching (nearest in ∆θ - ktspace）可能会改善对角线分数，但并未实施；基于索引的匹配足以满足此测量所达到的精度水平。space) could potentially improve the diagonal fraction but was not implemented; the index-based matching is sufficient for the level of precision achieved by this measurement.

匹配从 731,006 个选定的 MC 事件中产生 4,842,848 个 reco-gen 分簇对。The matching yields 4,842,848 reco-gen declustering pairs from 731,006 selected MC events.

对于一维投影，通过将匹配的再生对独立地投影到每个坐标上来构建专用的一维响应矩阵。列归一化响应矩阵For the one-dimensional projections, dedicated 1D response matrices are constructed by projecting the matched reco-gen pairs onto each coordinate independently. Each column sums to 1.0 by construction. Efficiency corrections (for gen declusterings with no reco match) are applied separately after unfolding.

B.5.2 迭代贝叶斯展开B.5.2 Iterative Bayesian Unfolding

主要的展开方法是迭代贝叶斯展开（IBU）（[The primary unfolding method is Iterative Bayesian Unfolding (IBU) ([参考-DAgostini:1994fjxref-DAgostini:1994fjx]）。 IBU 是一种成熟的方法，用于校正分箱分布中的探测器效应，自推出以来广泛应用于粒子物理学。该算法使用贝叶斯定理迭代更新真实分布的估计：]). IBU is a well-established method for correcting detector effects in binned distributions, widely used in particle physics since its introduction. The algorithm iteratively updates the estimate of the true distribution using Bayes’ theorem:

哪里where里杰Rij = P（回收站(reco bin我|i |根斌gen binj) 是列归一化响应矩阵，) is the column-normalized response matrix,di是reco bin中的测量（假减去）数据is the measured (fake-subtracted) data in reco bini, 和, andn^[(]ˆ[(]j[k][)] 是迭代时的估计[)] is the estimate at iterationk .

第一次迭代的先验是来自 MC 的匹配生成直方图，经过标准化并缩放到校正后的数据总数。迭代次数用作正则化参数：迭代次数太少会使结果偏向于先验，而太多则放大统计噪声。最佳数量由封闭测试确定。The prior for the first iteration is the matched gen histogram from MC, normalized and scaled to the corrected data total. The number of iterations serves as the regularization parameter: too few iterations leave the result biased toward the prior, while too many amplify statistical noise. The optimal number is determined by the closure test.

选择 IBU 作为主要方法是因为：IBU was selected as the primary method because:

  1. 它通过将 2D bin 视为展平向量来自然地处理多维展开。It naturally handles multi-dimensional unfolding by treating 2D bins as a flattened vector.

  2. 它正确地考虑了箱迁移，不像逐箱校正因子（需要对角分数It properly accounts for bin migrations, unlike bin-by-bin correction factors (which require diagonal fractions>70%）。70%).

  3. 它成立于 LEP（[It is established at LEP ([参考-LEP：QCD：2004ref-LEP:QCD:2004]）并被 ATLAS 用于第一次隆德平面测量（[]) and was used by ATLAS for the first Lund plane measurement ([参考 ATLAS:2020bbnref-ATLAS:2020bbn ]).

  4. 它是透明且可重复的，只需要响应矩阵和初始先验。It is transparent and reproducible, requiring only the response matrix and an initial prior.

迭代选择Iteration selection标称迭代计数被选择为闭包测试的值The nominal iteration count is chosen as the value where the closure testχ[2] /ndf 从下方跨越 1.0。低于该值，结果校正不足（偏向于先验）；在它之上，统计噪声放大占主导地位。ndf crosses 1.0 from below. Below this value, the result is under-corrected (biased toward the prior); above it, statistical noise amplification dominates.

B.5.3 替代方法：截断 SVDB.5.3 Alternative method: truncated SVD

截断奇异值分解 (SVD) 展开用作一维投影的替代方法，为 IBU 结果提供方法上独立的交叉检查。 SVD 将响应矩阵分解为Truncated Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) unfolding is used as the alternative method for the 1D projections, providing a methodologically independent cross-check of the IBU result. SVD decomposes the response matrix asR = U Σ 电压[T]V[T]并在指定数量的奇异值处通过截断对其求逆以正则化解。and inverts it with truncation at a specified number of singular values to regularize the solution.

SVD 闭包The SVD closureχ[2] /ndf 值 11.9 和 24.6 表明 SVD 在规定的截断水平上没有收敛到事实。因此，IBU 与 SVD 的差异主要衡量 SVD 关闭失败的情况，而不是真正的方法依赖性不确定性。因此，替代方法系统性（表 35）是对真实方法依赖性的高估，应被解释为保守的上限。 SVD 保留作为交叉检查，以确认方法上独立的方法产生大致相同的结果，而不是作为精度比较。ndf values of 11.9 and 24.6 indicate that SVD does not converge to the truth at the stated truncation levels. The IBU-vs-SVD difference therefore primarily measures SVD’s failure to close rather than a genuine method-dependence uncertainty. The alternative-method systematic (tbl. 35) is consequently an overestimate of the true method dependence and should be interpreted as a conservative upper bound. SVD is retained as a cross-check to confirm that a methodologically independent approach produces results in the same ballpark, not as a precision comparison.

SVD 对于 1D 投影（条件号 6 和 10）可行，但不适用于 2D 展开（条件号 2）SVD is viable for the 1D projections (condition numbers 6 and 10) but not for the 2D unfolding (condition number 2. 75 ×10[18] ），其中从 2 到 28 个奇异值的所有截断级别都会产生10[18] ), where all truncation levels from 2 to 28 singular values produceχ[2] /NDFndf> 10[6] .

B.6 系统不确定性B.6 Systematic uncertainties

根据分析策略（第 1 阶段 STRATEGY.md，第 7 节）和展开测量的惯例，对每个预测评估 12 个系统源。每个来源在下面的专门小节中进行了描述，涵盖物理起源、评估方法以及对幸存垃圾箱的数字影响。本节末尾提供了系统预算的摘要以及与参考分析进行比较的完整性表。Twelve systematic sources are evaluated for each projection, following the analysis strategy (Phase 1 STRATEGY.md, Section 7) and the conventions for unfolded measurements. Each source is described in a dedicated subsection below, covering the physical origin, evaluation method, and numerical impact on the surviving bins. A summary of the systematic budget and a completeness table comparing to reference analyses are provided at the end of this section.

所有系统不确定性均来自 MC 模拟，因此独立于数据统计。系统位移矢量定义为标称构型和变化构型之间的展开密度之差。每个源的系统协方差贡献是其移位向量的外积：All systematic uncertainties are derived from the MC simulation and are therefore independent of the data statistics. The systematic shift vectors are defined as the difference in the unfolded density between the nominal and the varied configuration. The systematic covariance contribution from each source is the outer product of its shift vector:Cs = δs ⊗ δs .

B.6.1 先前依赖B.6.1 Prior dependence

物理起源：Physical origin:IBU 使用 MC 真值分布作为迭代贝叶斯更新的初始先验。在标称 5-6 次迭代中，结果保留了对先验的敏感性，尤其是在对角线分数较低的箱中，其中数据覆盖先验假设的能力有限。IBU uses the MC truth distribution as the initial prior for the iterative Bayesian update. At the nominal 5–6 iterations, the result retains sensitivity to this prior, especially in bins with low diagonal fraction where the data has limited power to override the prior assumption.

评价方法：Evaluation method:系统性被评估为标称结果（MC 真值先验）与通过平坦（均匀）先验获得的结果之间逐个箱的差异。这提供了一个保守的The systematic is evaluated as the bin-by-bin difference between the nominal result (MC truth prior) and the result obtained with a flat (uniform) prior. This provides a conservative

变化尺寸的理由：Variation size justification:平坦先验表示最大程度无信息的假设，并提供标准的先验依赖包络。这是 ATLAS 用于隆德平面测量的标准方法（[The flat prior represents the maximally uninformative assumption and provides the standard prior-dependence envelope. B.7.3) removes bins where this effect exceeds 20%, ensuring that the reported bins have manageable (though still dominant) prior dependence.

B.6.2 强子化模型B.6.2 Hadronization model

物理起源：Physical origin:响应矩阵由带有 Lund 字符串碎片的 PYTHIA 6 MC 构建。替代的强子化模型——特别是 HERWIG 使用的簇碎片模型——将产生不同的粒子级分布和不同的探测器响应。这是历史上 LEP 事件形状测量的主导系统，其中强子化校正通常为 5-10%（[The response matrix is constructed from PYTHIA 6 MC with Lund string fragmentation. Alternative hadronization models — in particular the cluster fragmentation model used by HERWIG — would produce different particle-level distributions and different detector responses. This is historically the dominant systematic for event shape measurements at LEP, where hadronization corrections are typically 5–10% ([参考-LEP：QCD：2004ref-LEP:QCD:2004 ]).

评价方法：Evaluation method:在没有具有完整探测器模拟的替代 MC 的情况下，使用近似重新加权程序。根级 PYTHIA 6 分布在（带电多重性、推力）的二维箱中重新加权，以近似串和簇碎片模型之间的预期差异。重新加权函数为：An approximate reweighting procedure is used in the absence of alternative MC with full detector simulation. The gen-level PYTHIA 6 distribution is reweighted in two-dimensional bins of (charged multiplicity, thrust) to approximate the expected difference between string and cluster fragmentation models. The reweighting function is:

哪里whereα = − 0 .10（抑制高多重性事件）和10 (suppressing high-multiplicity events) andβ = +0 .08（增强球形事件），经过校准以重现已知的 PYTHIA-vs-HERWIG 在 Z 极的多重性和推力方面的差异。对于 ln(08 (enhancing spherical events), calibrated to reproduce the known PYTHIA-vs-HERWIG differences in multiplicity and thrust at the Z pole. For ln(kt），硬排放被抑制约10%；对于 ln(1), hard emissions are suppressed by approximately 10%; for ln(1/ ∆ θ），分布向更宽的角度移动约 8%。), the distribution is shifted toward wider angles by approximately 8%.

重要限制：Important limitation:仅对先验/真值分布进行重新加权；响应矩阵（给定真值的条件概率）不会被修改。这意味着这种变化实际上是一个额外的先验依赖性测试，而不是真正的强子化系统，后者需要具有完整探测器模拟的第二个发生器来探测不同碎片产物与 ALEPH 探测器材料的相互作用。仅使用 PYTHIA 6，无法实现真正的强子化系统；重新加权方法是最好的可用近似方法。Only the prior/truth distribution is reweighted; the response matrix (conditional probability of reco given truth) is not modified. This means the variation is effectively an additional prior-dependence test rather than a true hadronization systematic, which would require a second generator with full detector simulation to probe the interaction of different fragmentation products with the ALEPH detector material. With only PYTHIA 6 available, a genuine hadronization systematic is not achievable; the reweighting approach is the best available approximation.

变化尺寸的理由：Variation size justification:重新加权幅度 (8–10%) 是根据已发布的 PYTHIA 与 HERWIG 在 Z 极处的比较进行校准的数量级估计值（[The reweighting magnitudes (8–10%) are order-of-magnitude estimates calibrated to published comparisons of PYTHIA vs HERWIG at the Z pole ([参考-LEP：QCD：2004ref-LEP:QCD:2004]），特别是 LEP QCD 组合分析中显示的强子化校正在发生器中的分布（该参考文献的图 6-8）。没有一个表格可以直接提供这些幅度；它们是根据发电机对推力和重型喷射质量的预测范围推断出来的。选择（多重性、推力）作为重新加权变量捕获全局事件形状和多重性差异，这是碎片模型变化的主要驱动因素。]), specifically the spread of hadronization corrections across generators shown in the LEP QCD combination analysis (Figures 6–8 of that reference). No single table provides these magnitudes directly; they are inferred from the range of generator predictions for thrust and heavy jet mass. The choice of (multiplicity, thrust) as reweighting variables captures the global event shape and multiplicity differences that are the primary drivers of fragmentation model variations.

B.6.6 中性粒子建模B.6.6 Neutral particle modeling

物理起源：Physical origin:推力轴是根据所有粒子（带电和中性）计算的，但只有带电粒子进入隆德平面。中性粒子（来自的光子）的错误建模The thrust axis is computed from all particles (charged and neutral), but only charged particles enter the Lund plane. Mis-modeling of neutral particles (photons fromπMC 中的 [0] 衰变、中性强子）会改变推力轴方向，从而改变半球边界，导致半球边界附近的粒子被分配到错误的半球。[0] decay, neutral hadrons) in the MC shifts the thrust axis direction and therefore the hemisphere boundary, causing particles near the hemisphere boundary to be assigned to the wrong hemisphere.

评价方法：Evaluation method:应用推力轴方向 1% 的变化，对应于推力轴对中性粒子建模的预期灵敏度。使用不同的推力轴重新计算半球分配，并将展开密度的差异视为系统的。A 1% variation in the thrust axis direction is applied, corresponding to the expected sensitivity of the thrust axis to neutral particle modeling. The hemisphere assignments are recomputed with the varied thrust axis and the difference in the unfolded density is taken as the systematic.

变化尺寸的理由：Variation size justification:推力轴由所有粒子动量的能量加权和确定。中性粒子携带大约 30% 的事件能量，但它们的角度分布与带电粒子方向密切相关。对仅带电推力轴与全粒子推力轴的研究表明，轴方向存在亚百分比水平的差异，因此 1% 的变化是保守的。The thrust axis is determined by the energy-weighted sum of all particle momenta. Neutral particles carry approximately 30% of the event energy, but their angular distribution is strongly correlated with the charged particle directions. Studies of the charged-only vs all-particle thrust axis show differences at the sub-percent level for the axis direction, so a 1% variation is conservative.对幸存垃圾箱的影响：Impact on surviving bins:
