B.7 验证B.7 Validation

B.7.1 闭合试验B.7.1 Closure test

闭合测试通过标称响应矩阵展开 MC reco 级别（匹配的 reco 直方图）并与 MC 真实值进行比较。对于这两个预测，IBU 在标称迭代中完美地恢复了 MC 事实The closure test unfolds MC reco-level (matched reco histogram) through the nominal response matrix and compares to MC truth. For both projections, the IBU perfectly recovers the MC truth at the nominal itera-

100

当输入是匹配的reco分布时，正如预期的那样（响应矩阵是从相同的匹配对构建的）。tion count, as expected when the input is the matched reco distribution (the response matrix is constructed from the same matched pairs).

对于非波动匹配的 reco 输入，精确的闭包卡方同样为零。这是正确展开设置的必要但不充分条件：它验证响应矩阵、效率校正和归一化过程是自洽的，但不测试该方法对与 MC 先验不同的输入形状的鲁棒性。The exact closure chi-squared is identically zero for non-fluctuated matched reco input. This is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a correct unfolding setup: it verifies that the response matrix, efficiency correction, and normalization procedure are self-consistent, but does not test the method’s robustness to input shapes that differ from the MC prior.

噪声闭合测试Noisy closure test为了测试对统计波动的稳健性，从标称 reco 直方图生成 200 个泊松波动玩具，通过标称响应矩阵展开，并使用展开结果的对角线泊松不确定性与真值进行比较。To test robustness to statistical fluctuations, 200 Poisson-fluctuated toys are generated from the nominal reco histogram, unfolded through the nominal response matrix, and compared to truth using diagonal Poisson uncertainties on the unfolded result.

正式判决：压力测试失败。Formal verdict: The stress test fails.卡方值 286 和 4324 远远超过两个投影的 ndf，表明 5-6 次迭代的 IBU 无法恢复与训练先验有很大差异的真值分布。尽管由于以下定量原因而失败，但分析仍继续进行：The chi-squared values of 286 and 4324 far exceed the ndf for both projections, indicating that IBU at 5–6 iterations cannot recover truth distributions that differ strongly from the training prior. The analysis proceeds despite this failure for the following quantitative reasons:

  1. 50% 线性倾斜比在幸存箱中观察到的 1-5% 数据/MC 差异大 10-50 倍。The 50% linear tilt is 10–50 times larger than the observed 1–5% data/MC difference in surviving bins.

  2. 平坦先验门排除先验相关性超过 20% 的 bin，仅保留数据具有有意义的约束力的 bin。The flat-prior gate excludes bins where prior dependence exceeds 20%, retaining only bins where the data has meaningful constraining power.

  3. 先验依赖性系统（平坦先验差异，第 6.1 节）保守地覆盖了幸存箱中的残余偏差，如下覆盖表所示。The prior-dependence systematic (flat-prior difference, Section 6.1) conservatively covers the residual bias in surviving bins, as shown in the coverage table below.

密度从The density rises fromρ = 1 .58 广角 (ln(158 at wide angles (ln(1/ ∆ θ) = 0–0.5, 对应于 Δ) = 0–0.5, corresponding to ∆θ ≈60–180 度）至峰值60–180 degrees) to a peak ofρ = 1 .75 处于中等角度 (ln(175 at moderate angles (ln(1/ ∆ θ) = 1–1.5, Δ) = 1–1.5, ∆θ ≈12–22 度），然后减小到12–22 degrees), then decreases toρ = 0 .89 在更窄的角度 (ln(189 at narrower angles (ln(1/ ∆ θ ) = 2 .5–3，Δ5–3, ∆θ ≈3-5 度）。这种形状反映了 QCD 辐射的共线增强（小角度处的密度增加）和相空间抑制（由于运动学边界而在非常小角度处的密度减少）之间的相互作用。3–5 degrees). This shape reflects the interplay between the collinear enhancement of QCD radiation (rising density at small angles) and phase-space suppression (decreasing density at very small angles due to the kinematic boundary).

注意密度大小：Note on the density magnitude:测量的密度（The measured densities (ρ～ρ ∼ 1 .0–1.8) 超过朴素主序扰动期望0–1.8) exceed the naive leadingorder perturbative expectationαsCF /π ≈ 0 .05 大约为 30。这是预期的：一维投影在另一个隆德平面坐标上积分，总结了多重发射和非微扰强子化效应的贡献。 LO 公式05 by a factor of approximately 30. This is expected: the 1D projections integrate over the other Lund plane coordinate, summing contributions from multiple emissions and non-perturbative hadronization effects. The LO formulaρ ≈ αsCF /π适用于微扰区域中单个点的二维密度，而不适用于积分一维投影。此外，带电粒子级定义包括填充隆德平面的强子化产物，远远超出单次发射近似值。applies to the two-dimensional density at a single point in the perturbative regime, not to the integrated 1D projections. Additionally, the charged-particle-level definition includes hadronization products that populate the Lund plane well beyond the single-emission approximation.

数据一致显示每个半球的去簇数量少于粒子级预测。由于数据计数处于探测器级别，而 PYTHIA 6 真相处于粒子级别，因此预计会有大约 13-22% 的赤字。这种差异与 1D 投影的平均效率约 49% 一致：软和前向去聚因跟踪效率低下而丢失。展开密度测量（第 8.1 和 8.2 节）可校正这些影响。The data consistently shows fewer declusterings per hemisphere than the particle-level prediction. The deficit of approximately 13–22% is expected because the data count is at detector level while the PYTHIA 6 truth is at particle level. This difference is consistent with the mean efficiency of approximately 49% for the 1D projections: soft and forward declusterings are lost to tracking inefficiency. The unfolded density measurement (Sections 8.1 and 8.2) corrects for these effects.

B.9 与发电机预测的比较B.9 Comparison to generator prediction

将展开的完整数据与 PYTHIA 6 粒子级预测（探测器模拟之前的 MC 生成器输出）进行比较。由于 PYTHIA 6 是唯一可用的生成器，也是用于构建响应矩阵的模型，因此这种比较是同义反复：数据与 PYTHIA 6 卡方与数据与预期卡方相同（见下文）。独立的生成器测试需要 PYTHIA 8、HERWIG 7 或分析计算进行粒子级预测，但本分析无法使用这些预测。卡方使用幸存 bin 上的完整协方差矩阵 (stat + syst)。The unfolded full data is compared to the PYTHIA 6 particle-level prediction (the MC generator output before detector simulation). Because PYTHIA 6 is the only available generator and is also the model used to construct the response matrix, this comparison is tautological: the data-vs-PYTHIA 6 chi-squared is identical to the data-vs-expected chi-squared (see below). An independent generator test would require particle-level predictions from PYTHIA 8, HERWIG 7, or analytic calculations, which are not available for this analysis. The chi-squared uses the full covariance matrix (stat + syst) on surviving bins.

表 55：展开数据与 PYTHIA 6 颗粒级预测的卡方比较。 PYTHIA 6 卡方与数据与预期卡方（表 49、表 52）相同，因为预期结果是通过对 PYTHIA 6 真值进行编码的相同响应矩阵展开 MC 伪数据来获得的。因此，这两个比较不是独立的测试。Table 55: Chi-squared comparison of unfolded data to PYTHIA 6 particle-level prediction. The PYTHIA 6 chi-squared is identical to the data-vs-expected chi-squared (tbl. 49, tbl. 52) because the expected result is obtained by unfolding MC pseudo-data through the same response matrix that encodes the PYTHIA 6 truth. The two comparisons are therefore not independent tests.

关于 PYTHIA 6 卡方的注释：Note on the PYTHIA 6 chi-squared:与 PYTHIA 6 真值相比的数据卡方在数值上与与预期结果相比的数据卡方相同。这是因为预期结果是通过标称响应矩阵展开匹配的 MC reco 获得的，它准确地恢复了 PYTHIA 6 真值（闭包卡方 = 0）。因此，这两个测试提供了相同的信息：都评估展开的数据在系统不确定性范围内是否与 PYTHIA 6 粒子级预测一致。独立的理论比较需要来自生成器的粒子级预测，而不是用于构建响应矩阵的生成器（例如，PYTHIA 8 Monash、HERWIG 7.3 或分析 NLL 计算）。The chi-squared of the data compared to PYTHIA 6 truth is numerically identical to the chi-squared of data compared to the expected result. This is because the expected result is obtained by unfolding the matched MC reco through the nominal response matrix, which recovers the PYTHIA 6 truth exactly (closure chi-squared = 0). The two tests therefore provide the same information: both assess whether the unfolded data is consistent with the PYTHIA 6 particle-level prediction within the systematic uncertainties. An independent theory comparison would require particle-level predictions from generators other than the one used to construct the response matrix (e.g., PYTHIA 8 Monash, HERWIG 7.3, or analytic NLL calculations).

统计协方差捕获数据的泊松波动和响应矩阵上的 MC 统计不确定性（通过自举重采样）。系统协方差假设每个源内完全相关，这适用于本分析中使用的参数变化。The statistical covariance captures both the Poisson fluctuations of the data and the MC statistical uncertainty on the response matrix (through the bootstrap resampling). The systematic covariance assumes full correlation within each source, which is appropriate for the parametric variations used in this analysis.

B.11 总结和展望B.11 Summary and outlook

B.11.1 总结B.11.1 Summary

强子 Z 中的初级隆德喷流平面密度衰减为The primary Lund jet plane density in hadronic Z decays at[√] s = 91 .2 GeV 使用完整存档的 ALEPH 数据集（选择后 2,889,543 个事件，5,779,086 个半球）进行测量。这是隆德喷气机在电子-正电子碰撞中的首次测量。2 GeV is measured using the full archived ALEPH dataset (2,889,543 events after selection, 5,779,086 hemispheres). This is the first measurement of the Lund jet plane in electron-positron collisions.

主要结果是 ln(1The primary result is the ln(1/ ∆ θ) 角谱，在 5 个幸存的 bin 中测量（在平坦先验 20% 门之后），跨度 ln(1) angular spectrum, measured in 5 surviving bins (after the flat-prior 20% gate) spanning ln(1/ ∆ θ ) ∈ [0 , 1 . 5] ∪ [2 ,3]。使用迭代贝叶斯展开进行 5 次迭代，将 Lund 平面密度校正到带电粒子水平，并通过闭合测试、压力测试、噪声闭合测试进行验证，并与截断 SVD 进行交叉检查。3]. The Lund plane density is corrected to the charged-particle level using Iterative Bayesian Unfolding with 5 iterations, validated by closure tests, stress tests, noisy closure tests, and cross-checked with truncated SVD.

B.11.2 主要限制B.11.2 Dominant limitations

  1. 先前依赖：Prior dependence:以 31-40% 对角线分数进行 5-6 次迭代展开的 IBU 保留了显着的先验灵敏度。 22 个垃圾箱中只有 5 + 2 = 7 个能通过平前门。先前的依赖占幸存箱中系统总数的 87-93%。这是该测量的基本限制。The IBU unfolding with 5–6 iterations at 31–40% diagonal fraction retains significant prior sensitivity. Only 5 + 2 = 7 of 22 bins survive the flat-prior gate. Prior dependence accounts for 87–93% of the total systematic in surviving bins. This is the fundamental limitation of this measurement.

  2. 无替代发电机 [L2]：No alternative generator [L2]:强子化系统是通过粒子级重新加权而不是使用 HERWIG 或 ARIADNE 进行独立探测器模拟来估计的。这是第二大系统性的（占非先前总数的 38-47%），如果没有替代 MC，则无法对其进行全面评估。The hadronization systematic is estimated through particle-level reweighting rather than independent detector simulation with HERWIG or ARIADNE. This is the second-largest systematic (38–47% of the non-prior total) and cannot be fully assessed without alternative MC.

  3. MC统计[L1]：MC statistics [L1]:尽管传播的 MC 统计不确定性可以忽略不计，但 0.25 的 MC/数据比限制了响应矩阵的统计精度（The MC/data ratio of 0.25 limits the statistical precision of the response matrix, though the propagated MC statistical uncertainty is negligible (<总数的 1%）得益于相对较粗的分箱。1% of total) thanks to the relatively coarse binning.

B.11.3 展望B.11.3 Outlook

  1. 改进的展开：Improved unfolding:OmniFold（基于机器学习的展开）或通过数据驱动先验增加 IBU 迭代等替代方法可以恢复 Lund 平面中的额外垃圾箱。数据驱动的先验（使用 reco 级数据分布来初始化 IBU）将从更接近事实的先验开始，减少系统的先验依赖性。Alternative approaches such as OmniFold (machine-learning-based unfolding) or increased IBU iterations with a data-driven prior could recover additional bins in the Lund plane. The data-driven prior (using the reco-level data distribution to initialize IBU) would reduce the priordependence systematic by starting from a prior closer to the truth.

  2. 替代发电机：Alternative generators:来自 PYTHIA 8（Monash 调）、HERWIG 7.3（簇碎片）和分析 NLL 计算的粒子级预测（[Particle-level predictions from PYTHIA 8 (Monash tune), HERWIG 7.3 (cluster fragmentation), and analytic NLL calculations ([参考-德雷尔：2018nbfref-Dreyer:2018nbf]）应与展开的结果进行比较。这些比较将提供超出 PYTHIA 6 基线的物理解释。]) should be compared to the unfolded result. These comparisons would provide physics interpretation beyond the PYTHIA 6 baseline.

  3. 扩展Expanded kt 投影：projection:ln(The ln(kt）投影仅保留两个垃圾箱。扩展此测量将需要更多迭代（以增加噪声为代价）、更粗糙的分箱或根本不同的展开方法。) projection retains only two bins. Expanding this measurement would require either more iterations (at the cost of increased noise), coarser binning, or a fundamentally different unfolding approach.

  4. 二维结果：Two-dimensional result:较粗分箱时的 2D Lund 平面密度（例如 5The 2D Lund plane density at coarser binning (e.g., 5×6）可以通过可接受的条件来展开。这将提供完整的二维结构，这是理论上最有趣的表示。6) could potentially be unfolded with acceptable conditioning. This would provide the full two-dimensional structure that is the theoretically most interesting representation.

131

  1. 其他Other e[+] e[−] 数据集：datasets:可以使用其他 LEP 实验（DELPHI、L3、OPAL）或未来的存档数据执行类似的测量Similar measurements could be performed with archived data from other LEP experiments (DELPHI, L3, OPAL) or from futuree[+] e[−]对撞机（FCC-ee、CEPC、ILC），其中更大的数据集和现代探测器将克服这里遇到的限制。colliders (FCC-ee, CEPC, ILC) where vastly larger datasets and modern detectors would overcome the limitations encountered here.

C 使用 DELPHI 数据从 Z 不可见宽度产生的轻中微子数C Number of Light Neutrino Generations from the Z Invisible Width with DELPHI Data

C.1 简介C.1 Introduction

C.1.1 物理动机C.1.1 Physics motivation

轻中微子产生数The number of light neutrino generationsNν是粒子物理标准模型（SM）的基本参数。在 CERN 大型正负电子对撞机 (LEP) 中，通过利用 Z 玻色子共振以千分之一的精度确定了这个量。 Z玻色子的总宽度 Γis a fundamental parameter of the Standard Model (SM) of particle physics. At the CERN Large Electron–Positron Collider (LEP), this quantity was determined with per-mille precision by exploiting the Z boson resonance. The total width of the Z boson ΓZ接收来自所有运动学上可访问的衰减通道的贡献：receives contributions from all kinematically accessible decay channels:

其中 Гhad 是强子部分宽度， Гwhere Γhad is the hadronic partial width, Γℓ是轻子部分宽度（假设轻子普遍性），并且 Γ[SM]is the leptonic partial width (assuming lepton universality), and Γ[SM]νν[167] 167¯[=][167][.][157] [±][ ±][ 0] [.][002][MeV][是][the][SM][预测][for][the][partial][width][into][a][single][neutrino][species,]，包括双环精度的电弱辐射校正。[002][MeV][is][the][SM][prediction][for][the][partial][width][into][a][single][neutrino][species,] calculated including electroweak radiative corrections at two-loop accuracy.

Z玻色子的不可见宽度定义为The invisible width of the Z boson is defined as

并完全归因于and attributed entirely toZ → νν¯ 在 SM 中衰减，产生¯ decays in the SM, yielding

的测量The measurement ofNν是 LEP 计划的主要物理目标之一。 1989 年，所有四个 LEP 实验（ALEPH、DELPHI、L3、OPAL）首次确定轻中微子恰好有三代，排除了第四代轻中微子的可能性。was one of the primary physics goals of the LEP programme. The first determinations in 1989 by all four LEP experiments (ALEPH, DELPHI, L3, OPAL) established that there are exactly three light neutrino generations, ruling out a fourth generation with a light neutrino (mν < MZ/2）。这一结果对宇宙学（大爆炸核合成）、SM 费米子世代的结构以及对 SM 之外的物理学的探索具有深远的影响。2). This result has profound implications for cosmology (Big Bang nucleosynthesis), the structure of the SM fermion generations, and searches for physics beyond the SM.

C.1.2 预先测量C.1.2 Prior measurements

综合 LEP 测量，结合所有四个实验的数据并使用完整的 1989-1995 能量扫描数据集，得出 [1]：The combined LEP measurement, incorporating data from all four experiments and using the full 1989–1995 energy scan dataset, yields [1]:

Nν[德尔菲] = 3[DELPHI] = 3. 00 ± 0 . 02 ,

与三代1%水平一致。仅 1989 年数据的早期 DELPHI 测量就给出了consistent with three generations at the 1% level. Earlier DELPHI measurements from the 1989 data alone gaveNν = 3 . 08 ± 0 .05 [3]，证明随着更多数据的积累，精度迅速提高。05 [3], demonstrating the rapid improvement in precision as more data were accumulated.

C.1.3 可观察定义C.1.3 Observable definition

主要可观察量是强子截面The primary observables are the hadronic cross sectionsσ有（had([√] s）在 Z 共振周围的离散质心能量点处测量。这些适合辐射校正的 Breit-Wigner 线形来提取：) measured at discrete centre-of-mass energy points around the Z resonance. These are fit to a radiatively-corrected Breit–Wigner lineshape to extract:

  • MZ— Z 玻色子质量，— the Z boson mass,

  • Γ Z— Z 玻色子总宽度，— the Z boson total width,

C.1.4 本次测量的范围C.1.4 Scope of this measurement

该分析使用来自 1992-1995 年 LEP1 能量扫描计划的 DELPHI 开放数据，可通过 CERN 开放数据门户和 CVMFS 的 skelana Fortran 框架访问。数据采用 DELPHI 专有的二进制格式（This analysis uses DELPHI open data from the 1992–1995 LEP1 energy scan programme, accessed through the CERN Open Data portal and the skelana Fortran framework from CVMFS. The data are in DELPHI’s proprietary binary format (.al短 DST 文件），需要在使用 Python 进行分析之前使用自定义 Fortran 程序提取为 CSV。测量集中在强子通道上，轻子部分宽度受到外部限制。short DST files), requiring extraction to CSV using a custom Fortran program before analysis in Python. The measurement focuses on the hadronic channel, with the leptonic partial width constrained externally.

与已发布的 DELPHI 结果相比，进行了一些简化：(1) 将数据组合成四个能量点，而不是每次填充进行处理，(2) 轻子通道不是独立测量的，(3) ISR 处理使用Compared to the published DELPHI result, several simplifications are made: (1) the data are combined into four energy points rather than treated per-fill, (2) the leptonic channel is not measured independently, and (3) the ISR treatment uses aO ( α[2] ) 散热器而不是全散热器[2] ) radiator rather than the fullO ( α[3]）计算。这些简化导致统计精度比已发布的 DELPHI 结果差大约四倍，但中心值仍然完全一致。[3] ) calculation. These simplifications result in a statistical precision approximately four times worse than the published DELPHI result, but the central value remains fully consistent.

C.2 数据样本C.2 Data samples

C.2.1 实验装置C.2.1 Experimental setup

在 LEP 上运行的 DELPHI（具有轻子、光子和强子识别功能的 DEtector）探测器The DELPHI (DEtector with Lepton, Photon and Hadron Identification) detector operated at the LEPe[+] e[−]1989 年至 2000 年欧洲核子研究组织 (CERN) 对撞机。探测器提供了近 4collider at CERN from 1989 to 2000. The detector provided nearly 4π立体角覆盖中心跟踪系统（TPC、内部和外部探测器）、超导螺线管（1.23 T）、电磁量热计（枪管中的 HPC、前部区域的 EMF）、强子量热计 (HAC) 和 μ 子室。小角 TIle 热量计 (STIC) 安装于 1994 年，通过小角 Bhabha 散射提供光度测量solid angle coverage with a central tracking system (TPC, inner and outer detectors), a superconducting solenoid (1.23 T), electromagnetic calorimeters (HPC in the barrel, EMF in the forward region), a hadron calorimeter (HAC), and muon chambers. The Small-angle TIle Calorimeter (STIC), installed in 1994, provided luminosity measurements from small-angle Bhabha scattering with< 0 .1% 系统不确定性。早些年（1992-1993），SAT（小角度标记器）用作亮度监视器。1% systematic uncertainty. For earlier years (1992–1993), the SAT (Small Angle Tagger) served as the luminosity monitor.

本分析中使用的数据对应于 LEP1 能量扫描程序，在此期间 LEP 在 Z 共振附近的质心能量下运行（The data used in this analysis correspond to the LEP1 energy scan programme, during which LEP operated at centre-of-mass energies near the Z resonance ([√] s ≈88–93 GeV）。扫描策略因年份而异：1992 年和 1994 年主要在 Z 峰收集数据（88–93 GeV). The scan strategy varied by year: 1992 and 1994 collected data predominantly at the Z peak ([√] s ≈ 91 .3 GeV），而 1993 年和 1995 年包括非高峰运行3 GeV), while 1993 and 1995 included off-peak running at[√] s ≈ 89 .5 GeV 和5 GeV and[√] s ≈ 93 .0 GeV 来约束 Z 宽度。0 GeV to constrain the Z width.

一个 skelana Fortran 提取器（A skelana Fortran extractor (phase2 ~~e~~ xploration/scripts/extractor.car）被编写来读取短 DST 事件并将每个事件的摘要变量输出为 CSV 格式。提取器访问：) was written to read short DST events and output per-event summary variables to CSV format. The extractor accesses:

编译使用来自 CVMFS 的 DELPHI 软件堆栈（Compilation uses the DELPHI software stack from CVMFS (/cvmfs/delphi.cern.ch/)：nypatchy 代码管理、gfortran 编译、与 DELPHI 和 CERN 库链接。): nypatchy code management, gfortran compilation, linked against DELPHI and CERN libraries.

每个事件的输出 CSV 包含 15 个变量：运行、事件、The per-event output CSV contains 15 variables: run, event,[√] s , Nch、带电和总可见能量、3 动量分量、四个热量计能量和、IHAD4 标志和中性物体的数量。ch, charged and total visible energy, 3-momentum components, four calorimeter energy sums, IHAD4 flag, and number of neutral objects.

C.3 事件选择C.3 Event selection

C.3.1 概述C.3.1 Overview

实现了两个选择通道：强子通道（Two selection channels are implemented: a hadronic channel (Z → QQZ → qq¯，初级）和轻子通道（¯, primary) and a leptonic channel (Z → ℓ[+] ℓ[−]，探索性）。强子通道提供线形拟合中使用的事件计数。发现轻子通道在汇总变量水平上受到巴巴散射的污染，并且不用于主要测量。, exploratory). The hadronic channel provides the event counts used in the lineshape fit. The leptonic channel was found to be contaminated by Bhabha scattering at the summary-variable level and is not used for the primary measurement.

C.3.5 削减动机C.3.5 Cut motivation

带电轨道多重性Charged track multiplicity带电轨道重数The charged track multiplicityNch 提供了强子 Z 衰变和背景之间最强的区分。强子事件产生ch provides the strongest discrimination between hadronic Z decays and backgrounds. Hadronic events produce∼夸克碎裂产生 20-40 个带电轨道，而轻子事件则20–40 charged tracks from quark fragmentation, while leptonic events haveN ch ≤6、光度监视器事件有6 and luminosity monitor events haveN通道 = 0。ch = 0.

可见能量Visible energy标准化可见光能量The normalized visible energyE可见vis/[√] s将精确测量的强子 Z 衰变（峰值接近 1.0）与双光子事件和光束背景（可见能量低得多）分开。 1.5 的上限切除去除了具有异常量热仪沉积物的事件。separates well-measured hadronic Z decays (peaking near 1.0) from two-photon events and beam backgrounds (which have much lower visible energy). The upper cut at 1.5 removes events with anomalous calorimeter deposits.

动量平衡Momentum balance纵向和横向动量平衡切割拒绝测量不良的事件和束气相互作用。对于精心测量的The longitudinal and transverse momentum balance cuts reject poorly measured events and beam-gas interactions. For well-measurede[+] e[−] → Z → qq¯ 事件时，总动量应接近于零（在探测器分辨率内）。¯ events, the total momentum should be close to zero (within detector resolution).

C.5.10 相关结构C.5.10 Correlation structure

系统源在能量点上具有不同的相关结构：The systematic sources have different correlation structures across energy points:

  • LEP能量：LEP energy:填充内跨能量点和部分填充之间的能量点相关（通用校准程序）。Correlated across energy points within a fill and partially across fills (common calibration procedure).

  • 亮度（实验）：Luminosity (experimental):一年内相关，跨年部分相关（探测器从 SAT 升级到 STIC）。Correlated within a year, partially correlated across years (detector upgrades from SAT to STIC).

  • 光度（理论）：Luminosity (theory):所有点和年份之间完全相关（常见的 Bhabha QED 计算）。Fully correlated across all points and years (common Bhabha QED calculation).

  • 选择效率：Selection efficiency:跨能量点（同一检测器）相关，具有较小的能量依赖性变化。Correlated across energy points (same detector), with small energy-dependent variation.

  • 背景：Background:能量点之间很大程度上不相关。Largely uncorrelated between energy points.

实际上，相关结构对结果的影响很小，因为拟合使用吸收大多数相关变化的每能量点光度干扰参数。In practice, the correlation structure has minimal impact on the result because the fit uses per-energypoint luminosity nuisance parameters that absorb most correlated variations.

C.7.6 拟合欠定C.7.6 Fit underdetermination

该系统有 7 个自由参数和 5 个有效约束（4 个数据点 + 1 个光度高斯约束），使其形式上欠定（有效 ndofThe system has 7 free parameters and 5 effective constraints (4 data points + 1 luminosity Gaussian constraint), making it formally underdetermined (effective ndof≤0）。有 7 个自由参数和 5 个有效约束，拟合是欠定的。接近于零的0). With 7 free parameters and 5 effective constraints, the fit is underdetermined. The near-zeroχ[2] (3 . 3 × 10 [−][5] ）确认拟合可以完美地容纳 4 个数据点，并且是[5] ) confirms that the fit can perfectly accommodate the 4 data points and is不not拟合优度指标。尽管如此，拟合仍然收敛到一个独特的物理解决方案，因为：a goodness-of-fit metric. The fit nonetheless converges to a unique physical solution because:

  1. 高斯光度约束锚定整体归一化，防止光度参数自由吸收所有张力。The Gaussian luminosity constraint anchors the overall normalization, preventing the luminosity parameters from freely absorbing all tension.

  2. Z 线形状是一种易于理解的物理模型，参数之间具有很强的内部相关性。The Z lineshape is a well-understood physical model with strong internal correlations between parameters.

  3. 接近已发布 Z 参数的起始值引导最小化器获得物理解决方案（通过稳定性交叉检查 @sec:xcheck ~~s~~ 表性进行验证）。Starting values near published Z parameters guide the minimizer to the physical solution (validated by the stability cross-check, @sec:xcheck ~~s~~ tability).

已发表的 DELPHI 分析使用The published DELPHI analysis used∼20 年能量组合，提供了更多与参数数量相关的约束。未来每年拟合或额外外部约束的改进将提高约束力。20 year-energy combinations, providing many more constraints relative to the number of parameters. Future improvements with per-year fits or additional external constraints would improve the constraint power.

C.9.2 了解精度差异C.9.2 Understanding the precision difference

我们的统计不确定性（Our statistical uncertainty (± 0 .078）大约比已发布的 DELPHI 结果大四倍（078) is approximately four times larger than the published DELPHI result (± 0 .02）。这可以从几个因素来理解：02). This is understood from several factors:

  1. 有效能量点较少：Fewer effective energy points:我们将数据组合成4个能量点，相比之下We combine data into 4 energy points, compared to∼已发表的分析中的 20 年能源组合。点数的减少限制了对 Γ 的约束20 yearenergy combinations in the published analysis. The reduced number of points limits the constraint on ΓZ，这是主要驱动力, which is the primary driver ofNν精度。precision.

  2. 无独立No independent Rℓ 测量：measurement:公布的DELPHI分析措施The published DELPHI analysis measuresRℓ根据强子截面与轻子截面的比率，提供独立的约束。我们使用外部 LEP 组合值，它添加了信息，但不是每点的完整约束力from the ratio of hadronic to leptonic cross sections, providing an independent constraint. We use the external LEP combined value, which adds information but not the full constraining power of per-pointσℓ测量。measurements.

  3. 每次填充与组合能量点：Per-fill vs. combined energy points:发表的分析使用每次填充光束能量校准，而我们使用平均值The published analysis uses per-fill beam energy calibration, while we use the mean[√] s在每个标称能量点。这减少了不同的有效数量at each nominal energy point. This reduces the effective number of distinct√s测量。measurements.

  4. ISR模型：ISR model:我们的OurO ( α[2] ）辐射器引入了被拟合参数吸收的小偏差，稍微降低了约束功率。[2] ) radiator introduces small biases that are absorbed by the fit parameters, slightly degrading the constraint power.

尽管存在这些限制，但其核心价值Despite these limitations, the central value ofNν与已发表的结果完全一致，表明DELPHI开放数据包含足够的Z极物理测量信息。is fully consistent with the published result, demonstrating that the DELPHI open data contain sufficient information for Z-pole physics measurements.

C.9.4 早期 DELPHI 测量C.9.4 Early DELPHI measurement

最早的 DELPHI 测量来自 1989 年的数据 [3] 给出The earliest DELPHI measurement from 1989 data [3] gaveNν = 3 . 08 ± 0 .05 来自大约 120,000 个强子事件。我们的测量使用了 350 万个强子事件（近 30 倍），并达到了精度05 from approximately 120,000 hadronic events. Our measurement uses 3.5 million hadronic events (nearly 30 times more) and achieves a precision of± 0 .078——尽管进行了分析简化，但与早期结果相当。078 — comparable to the early result despite the analysis simplifications.

C.9.5 影响C.9.5 Implications

测量证实，通过 Z 玻色子衰变产生的轻中微子数量与 3 一致。这限制了预测额外光的标准模型的扩展（The measurement confirms that the number of light neutrino generations accessible through Z boson decays is consistent with three. This constrains extensions of the Standard Model that predict additional light (mν < MZ/2）中微子种类。该结果虽然在精度上与 LEP 组合测量不具竞争力，但证明了 DELPHI 开放数据在弱电精密测量方面的科学实用性。2) neutrino species. The result, while not competitive with the LEP combined measurement in precision, demonstrates the scientific utility of DELPHI open data for electroweak precision measurements.

C.10 结论C.10 Conclusions

轻中微子产生数量的测量A measurement of the number of light neutrino generationsNν是使用 Z 玻色子不可见宽度进行的，基于 LEP 的 DELPHI 探测器在 1992-1995 年能量扫描计划期间收集的强子截面数据。has been performed using the Z boson invisible width, based on hadronic cross-section data collected by the DELPHI detector at LEP during the 1992–1995 energy scan programme.

该分析使用从四个质心能量点处的 1466 万个提取事件中选出的 350 万个强子 Z 衰变事件（The analysis uses 3.50 million hadronic Z decay events selected from 14.66 million extracted events at four centre-of-mass energy points ([√] s = 88 .6、89.5、91.3 和 93.0 GeV）。辐射校正的 Breit-Wigner 线形，通过 Kuraev-Fadin 指数辐射器合并初始态辐射6, 89.5, 91.3, and 93.0 GeV). A radiatively- corrected Breit–Wigner lineshape, incorporating initial-state radiation via the Kuraev–Fadin exponentiated radiator atO ( α[2] ）和光束能量扩散卷积，使用带有约束光度参数的泊松负对数似然来拟合事件计数。[2] ) and beam energy spread convolution, is fit to the event counts using a Poisson negative log-likelihood with constrained luminosity parameters.

结果是The result is

与标准模型预测的三代轻中微子一致，公布的 DELPHI 结果为consistent with the Standard Model prediction of exactly three light neutrino generations, the published DELPHI result ofNν = 3 . 00 ± 0 .02、与LEP联合测量02, and the LEP combined measurement ofNν = 2 . 9840 ± 0 . 0082.

该测量在统计上是有限的。占主导地位的系统不确定性是外部约束The measurement is statistically limited. The dominant systematic uncertainty is the external constraint onRℓ来自 LEP 组合测量（from the LEP combined measurement (δNν = 0 .005）。所有其他系统来源都有贡献005). All other systematic sources contribute≤ 0 .001 个。总系统不确定性（0001 each. The total systematic uncertainty (0.006）比统计不确定性小一个数量级以上。006) is more than an order of magnitude smaller than the statistical uncertainty.

统计精度大约比已发布的 DELPHI 结果差四倍，主要是因为数据被组合成 4 个能量点（与 4 个能量点相比）。The statistical precision is approximately four times worse than the published DELPHI result, primarily because the data are combined into 4 energy points (vs.∼20 在已发表的分析中），轻子通道不是独立测量的（受到摘要变量水平上的 Bhabha 污染的限制），并且 ISR 处理使用20 in the published analysis), the leptonic channel is not measured independently (limited by Bhabha contamination at the summary-variable level), and the ISR treatment usesO ( α[2] ) 而不是[2] ) rather thanO ( α[3] ).

分析表明：The analysis demonstrates that:

  1. DELPHI开放数据可访问DELPHI open data are accessible通过 CVMFS 上的 skelana Fortran 框架和 CERN 开放数据门户。through the skelana Fortran framework on CVMFS and the CERN Open Data portal.

178

  1. 精确的弱电测量是可行的Precision electroweak measurements are feasible利用开放数据，取得与公布值一致的结果。with open data, achieving results consistent with published values.

  2. 混合 Fortran/Python 工作流程A hybrid Fortran/Python workflow（skelana 用于数据提取，Python 用于分析）成功弥合了专有数据格式的差距。(skelana for data extraction, Python for analysis) successfully bridges the proprietary data format gap.

C.11 未来方向C.11 Future directions

一些具体的改进可以提高测量的精度：Several concrete improvements could enhance the precision of this measurement:

  1. 每年的能量点分离。Per-year energy point separation.将 9 年能源组合视为独立数据点（而不是合并为 4 个）会将约束数量从 4 个增加到 9 个，从而显着提高拟合确定性并减少统计不确定性Treating the 9 year-energy combinations as independent data points (instead of combining into 4) would increase the number of constraints from 4 to 9, significantly improving the fit determinacy and reducing the statistical uncertainty by∼30–50%。30–50%.

  2. 独立Independent Rℓ 测量。measurement.使用量热计能量比和角度接受切割（将电子与μ子分离并拒绝巴巴事件）来实现轻子识别将能够实现独立的轻子识别。Implementing lepton identification using calorimeter energy ratios and angular acceptance cuts (to separate electrons from muons and reject Bhabha events) would enable an independentRℓ测量，消除了对外部 LEP 组合值的依赖。measurement, removing the dependence on the external LEP combined value.

  3. O ( α[3] ) ISR 散热器。ISR radiator.实施完整的三阶辐射器（如 ZFITTER 中使用的）将消除 ISR 偏差并提高 Γ 的精度Implementing the full third-order radiator (as used in ZFITTER) would eliminate the ISR bias and improve the accuracy of ΓZ和andσ有[0][.]had[0][.]

  4. γ/Z 干扰。interference.包括光子交换和Including the photon exchange andγ/ZBorn 截面中的干扰项将改善非峰值截面预测并减少系统偏差。interference terms in the Born cross section would improve the off-peak cross-section predictions and reduce the systematic bias.

  5. 蒙特卡罗效率研究。Monte Carlo efficiency studies.将可用的 MC 样本提取为相同的 CSV 格式并直接从 MC 计算选择效率将取代对已发布效率值的依赖并启用数据/MC 比较图。Extracting the available MC samples to the same CSV format and computing selection efficiencies directly from MC would replace the reliance on published efficiency values and enable data/MC comparison plots.

  6. 每次填充光束能量。Per-fill beam energy.使用 LEP 能量模型中的每次填充光束能量值（而不是事件级 ECMAS 值）将提供更多能量点并改善对 Γ 的约束Using the per-fill beam energy values from the LEP energy model (rather than the event-level ECMAS values) would provide more energy points and improve the constraint on ΓZ .

  7. 1991年数据恢复。1991 data recovery.如果可以通过替代路径访问 1991 年的数据，则会添加最早的非高峰点能量扫描数据，进一步约束 ΓIf the 1991 data can be accessed through alternative paths, it would add the earliest energy scan data with off-peak points, further constraining ΓZ .

  8. 前后不对称。Forward-backward asymmetry.测量MeasuringA[0] 脸书[0] FB[,ℓ][来自][角度][分布][轻子][事件]将为拟合添加第五个参数，并对电弱混合角提供额外的约束。[from][the][angular][distribution][of][leptonic][events] would add a fifth parameter to the fit and provide additional constraints on the electroweak mixing angle.

D 使用 DELPHI 数据进行两点能量-能量相关器测量D Two-Point Energy-Energy Correlator Measurement with DELPHI Data

D.1 简介D.1 Introduction

D.1.1 物理动机D.1.1 Physics motivation

能量-能量相关器 (EEC) 是一种红外和共线安全事件形状可观测对象，可探测能量流的角度分布The energy-energy correlator (EEC) is an infrared- and collinear-safe event shape observable that probes the angular distribution of energy flow ine[+] e[−]湮灭事件。该理论最初由 Basham、Brown、Ellis 和 Love 于 1978 年提出，由于其与共形场理论（光线算子乘积展开）、软共线有效理论 (SCET) 和横向动量相关 (TMD) 分解的深刻联系，理论兴趣重新兴起。annihilation events. Originally proposed by Basham, Brown, Ellis, and Love in 1978, it has experienced a resurgence of theoretical interest due to its deep connections to conformal field theory (the light-ray operator product expansion), soft-collinear effective theory (SCET), and transverse-momentum dependent (TMD) factorization.

EEC 在事件形状可观测量中很特殊，原因如下：The EEC is special among event shape observables for several reasons:

  • 共线极限Collinear limit ( χ →0)：EEC 表现出由 twin-2 异常维度控制的幂律缩放，与 DGLAP 演化和类时分裂函数相关。该区域探索从微扰部分子动力学到非微扰强子化的转变。0): The EEC exhibits power-law scaling governed by twist-2 anomalous dimensions, connecting to DGLAP evolution and the timelike splitting functions. This region probes the transition from perturbative parton dynamics to non-perturbative hadronization.

  • 背靠背极限Back-to-back limit ( χ → π）：EEC 通过 TMD 分解和 Sudakov 恢复来描述，现在已知 N[4] LL 精度（Chen 等人，arXiv：2512.11950）。这提供了一个干净的渠道): The EEC is described by TMD factorization with Sudakov resummation, now known to N[4] LL accuracy (Chen et al., arXiv:2512.11950). This provides a clean channel forαs提取时对强子化的敏感性降低。extraction with reduced sensitivity to hadronization.

  • 散装区域Bulk region：NNLO 的固定阶扰动 QCD 描述了中间角度范围，并具有由单个矩阵元素 Ω1 参数化的领先非扰动校正。: Fixed-order perturbative QCD at NNLO describes the intermediate angular range, with leading non-perturbative corrections parameterized by a single matrix element Ω1.

NNLO+NNLLcol+N[4] LLb2b 的精度预测现已可用（Chen 等人，arXiv:2512.11950），代表了迄今为止执行的最精确的 EEC 计算。该计算同时将共线和背靠背恢复与整个角度范围内的固定顺序结果相匹配。Precision predictions at NNLO+NNLLcol+N[4] LLb2b are now available (Chen et al., arXiv:2512.11950), representing the most precise EEC calculation ever performed. This calculation simultaneously matches the collinear and back-to-back resummations to the fixed-order result across the full angular range.

最近删除的Recent removals ofe[+] e[−]事件形状event shapeαs从 PDG 世界平均水平中提取（由于对分析强子化模型的担忧）创造了一个机会。使用 TMD 分解的基于 EEC 的提取提供了理论上更清洁的替代方案。extractions from the PDG world average (due to concerns about analytical hadronization models) have created an opportunity. EEC-based extractions using TMD factorization offer a theoretically cleaner alternative.

Z 极的多项 EEC 测量结果已发布：Several EEC measurements at the Z pole have been published:

  • 蛋白石（1991）：OPAL (1991):Z 极处的首次 EEC 测量First EEC measurement at the Z pole withαs提取使用extraction usingO ( αs[2][)][理论][(物理学]Lett. B 276, 547)。[2][)][theory][(Phys.] Lett. B 276, 547).

  • SLD（1994）：SLD (1994):SLC 上的 EEC 和 AEEC 测量，EEC and AEEC measurement at SLC,αs ( MZ ) = 0 . 124 ± 0 .003（扩展）003(exp.)± 0 .009（理论）（物理学 Rev. D 50, 5580）。009(theory) (Phys. Rev. D 50, 5580).

  • 德尔菲（1990）：DELPHI (1990):强子 Z 衰变中的早期 EEC 测量 (Phys. Lett. B 252, 149)。Early EEC measurement in hadronic Z decays (Phys. Lett. B 252, 149).

  • 阿莱夫（2025）：ALEPH (2025):使用 91.2 GeV 的存档 ALEPH 数据和 200 个可变宽度角度箱进行首次完全校正的现代 EEC 测量。二维贝叶斯展开于 (First fully-corrected modern EEC measurement using archived ALEPH data at 91.2 GeV, with 200 variable-width angular bins. 2D Bayesian unfolding in (θL , EiEj/E[2] ）（arXiv：2505.11828）。最精确[2] ) (arXiv:2505.11828). Most precisee[+] e[−]迄今为止的 EEC 结果。EEC result to date.

  • DELPHI 开放数据（2025）：DELPHI open data (2025):使用DELPHI 1994+1995开放数据进行推力和航迹EEC测量，证明了DELPHI数据管道的可行性(arXiv:2510.18762)。Thrust and track EEC measurement using DELPHI 1994+1995 open data, demonstrating the feasibility of the DELPHI data pipeline (arXiv:2510.18762).

该测量通过与 ALEPH 测量不同的检测器系统提供独立的结果，充当关键的交叉检查。 DELPHI 基于 TPC 的跟踪、HPC 电磁量热法和 RICH 粒子识别为 ALEPH 的喷射室跟踪和电磁量热法提供了补充的系统概况。This measurement provides an independent result with different detector systematics from the ALEPH measurement, serving as a critical cross-check. DELPHI’s TPC-based tracking, HPC electromagnetic calorimetry, and RICH particle identification give a complementary systematic profile to ALEPH’s jet chamber tracking and electromagnetic calorimetry.

D.2.5 数据质量评估D.2.5 Data quality assessment

质心能量分布证实数据峰值位于 91.27 GeV，ISR 分布 (88-94 GeV)，而 QQPS MC 固定在 91.20 GeV，APACIC 固定在 91.25 GeV。数据和 QQPS MC 之间的 70 MeV 偏移（0.08%Center-of-mass energy distributions confirm that data peaks at 91.27 GeV with ISR spread (88–94 GeV), while QQPS MC is fixed at 91.20 GeV and APACIC at 91.25 GeV. The 70 MeV offset between data and QQPS MC (0.08% of[√] s) 对于归一化 EEC 来说可以忽略不计，归一化 EEC 取决于角度相关性和能量分数，而不是绝对能量尺度。 ISR 独有的粒子级定义和展开过程吸收了该偏移的任何残余影响。) is negligible for the normalized EEC, which depends on angular correlations and energy fractions rather than absolute energy scale. The ISR-exclusive particle-level definition and the unfolding procedure absorb any residual effect of this offset.

D.4 修正和展开D.4 Corrections and unfolding

D.4.1 EEC 计算D.4.1 EEC computation

轨道邻近剪切Track proximity cut最小对开角切割A minimum pair opening angle cutχ分钟 = 0min = 0.005 弧度（005 rad (∼,5 mrad) 适用于进入 EEC 计算的所有轨迹对。这消除了探测器中轨道分裂引起的虚假小角度对，其中单个带电粒子被重建为两个附近的轨道。选择的切割值高于 DELPHI TPC 的典型角度分辨率（,5 mrad) is applied to all track pairs entering the EEC computation. This removes spurious small-angle pairs caused by track splitting in the detector, where a single charged particle is reconstructed as two nearby tracks. The cut value is chosen to be above the typical angular resolution of the DELPHI TPC (∼,1–2 毫拉德)。对总对数的影响很小（,1–2 mrad). The impact on the total pair count is small (<1%），集中在分轨污染最高的深共线垃圾箱中。该切割阈值的变化（1%), concentrated in the deep collinear bins where split-track contamination is highest. The variation of this cut threshold (χ分钟 = 0min = 0. 003–0 .010 rad）被评估为系统不确定性。010 rad) is evaluated as a systematic uncertainty.

角度分档Angular binningEEC 在 130 个角度箱中测量：The EEC is measured in 130 angular bins:

地区Region χ范围 [弧度]range [rad] 分档类型Binning type 垃圾箱数量Number of bins
共线Collinear 0.002 – 0.200 对数Logarithmic 50
散装Bulk 0.200 – 2.900 线性Linear 30
背靠背Back-to-back 2.900 – 3.140 对数（翻转）Logarithmic (fipped) 50

共线和背靠背区域中的对数分箱解决了幂律和苏达科夫峰值结构。主体区域中的线性合并与近似平坦的检测器响应相匹配。The logarithmic binning in the collinear and back-to-back regions resolves the power-law and Sudakov peak structures. The linear binning in the bulk region matches the approximately flat detector response.

探测器级分布Detector-level distributions

粒子级分布（MC 真值）Particle-level distributions (MC truth)两种强子化模型（隆德弦与簇）在原型样本的统计精度内产生一致的 EEC 分布。在共线区域可以看到 5-10% 水平的差异，预计强子化模型系统在该区域最大。The two hadronization models (Lund string vs. cluster) produce consistent EEC distributions within the statistical precision of the prototype sample. Differences at the 5–10% level are visible in the collinear region, where the hadronization model systematic is expected to be largest.

D.4.2 响应矩阵D.4.2 Response matrix

轨道匹配程序Track matching procedure在每个事件中，使用匈牙利算法（最佳一对一分配）将重新级别轨迹与真实级别轨迹进行匹配：Reco-level tracks are matched to truth-level tracks using the Hungarian algorithm (optimal one-to-one assignment) within each event:

  1. 计算所有 reco 和 true 轨迹之间的角距离矩阵： ΔCompute the angular distance matrix between all reco and truth tracks: ∆里杰Rij= 反余弦(^= arccos(ˆp雷科reco,我·,i · ˆ p真相truth,j )

  2. 使用最小化总角距离找到全局最优的一对一分配Find the globally optimal one-to-one assignment minimizing the total angular distance usingscipy.optimize.linear sum ~~a~~ ssignment（匈牙利/库恩-蒙克雷斯算法）(Hungarian/Kuhn–Munkres algorithm)

  3. 接受与 Δ 的匹配Accept matches with ∆R < 0 .05 拉德；拒绝超出截止值的作业05 rad; reject assignments exceeding the cutoff

赛道匹配统计（QQPS MC，12,384 个事件）：Track matching statistics (QQPS MC, 12,384 events):

D.5 系统不确定性D.5 Systematic uncertainties

评估了六个系统不确定性源。对于每个源，数据 EEC 会发生变化（或展开参数会发生变化），并且会重新运行完整的校正链。平移向量Six systematic uncertainty sources are evaluated. For each source, the data EEC is varied (or the unfolding parameters are changed) and the full correction chain is rerun. The shift vectorδi= EEC[变量]= EEC[var]我 -i −EEC[名义]EEC[nom]i量化每个垃圾箱的影响。quantifies the impact per bin.

D.5.1 跟踪效率D.5.1 Tracking efficiency

来源编号：Source number: 3. 方法：Method:在 EEC 计算之前随机删除 1% 的轨道并重新运行完整的校正链。Remove 1% of tracks randomly before EEC computation and rerun the full correction chain.平均相对影响：Mean relative impact:0.7%。0.7%.

这评估了对跟踪效率不确定性的敏感性。 1% 均匀去除是第一近似值；更现实的评估将适用This evaluates the sensitivity to tracking efficiency uncertainty. The 1% uniform removal is a first approximation; a more realistic evaluation would applyθ- 和- andpT- 与实际 DELPHI 跟踪效率曲线相匹配的相关去除率（前向角较低且低-dependent removal rates matching the actual DELPHI tracking efficiency profile (which is lower at forward angles and lowpT）。这是计划用于全面统计分析的。较小的影响 (0.7%) 反映了 EEC 的自我归一化特性：总体效率损失在比率中抵消). This is planned for the full-statistics analysis. The small impact (0.7%) reflects the self-normalizing property of the EEC: overall efficiency losses cancel in the ratioEiEj/Evis[2][.][仅][微分][效率][效果][（其中][效率]随轨道运动学变化）对系统有贡献，而均匀去除低估了该微分分量。vis[2][.][Only][differential][efficiency][effects][(where][efficiency] varies with track kinematics) contribute to the systematic, and the uniform removal underestimates this differential component.

D.5.2 轨道D.5.2 Track pT 剪切变化cut variation

来源编号：Source number: 4. 方法：Method:改变最小值Vary the minimumpT从标称的 0.4 GeV 削减到 0.3 GeV 和 0.5 GeV。包络线（两个变化的最大绝对偏移）被视为系统包络线。cut from the nominal 0.4 GeV to 0.3 GeV and 0.5 GeV. The envelope (maximum absolute shift from the two variations) is taken as the systematic.平均相对影响：Mean relative impact:3.3%。3.3%.

的ThepT削减会影响进入 EEC 的低动量轨道的人口。降低切割会产生更多软轨迹（主要是小角度），而提高切割则会消除它们。 3.3% 的影响反映了共线区域对软轨道群体的敏感性。cut affects the population of low-momentum tracks entering the EEC. Lowering the cut includes more soft tracks (predominantly at small angles), while raising it removes them. The 3.3% impact reflects the sensitivity of the collinear region to the soft-track population.

D.5.3 正则化D.5.3 Regularization

来源编号：Source number: 10. 方法：Method:改变 IBU 迭代次数Vary the number of IBU iterations by±2 围绕标称值（2 次和 6 次迭代）。信封被视为系统的。2 around the nominal (2 and 6 iterations). The envelope is taken as the systematic.平均相对影响：Mean relative impact:3.4%。3.4%.

正则化系统捕获了对展开迭代次数的依赖性。更少的迭代产生更接近 MC 先验的结果；更多的迭代允许更多的数据驱动的波动。 3.4% 的影响表明对正则化选择的敏感性中等。The regularization systematic captures the dependence on the number of unfolding iterations. Fewer iterations produce a result closer to the MC prior; more iterations allow more data-driven fluctuations. The 3.4% impact indicates moderate sensitivity to the regularization choice.

D.5.4 先验灵敏度D.5.4 Prior sensitivity

来源编号：Source number:11 + 13（合并）。11 + 13 (combined).方法：Method:平坦先验变异（来源 11，平均影响 1.5%）和作为替代先验的亚太事实（来源 13，平均影响 4.7%）都通过相同的 QQPS 响应矩阵来探测先验敏感性。使用每箱信封将它们组合成一个系统：The flat-prior variation (source 11, 1.5% mean impact) and the APACIC truth as alternative prior (source 13, 4.7% mean impact) both probe prior sensitivity through the same QQPS response matrix. They are combined into a single systematic using the per-bin envelope:

平均相对影响：Mean relative impact:4.9%。4.9%.

这是主要的测量系统不确定性。 APACIC 先验变体使用集群强子化真值谱作为替代先验，与平坦先验相比，它对共线和背靠背区域的改变更大。这探测先验敏感性（IBU 收敛特性），而不是强子化模型依赖性。先验灵敏度和强子化模型系统是正交的：先验灵敏度在保持QQPS响应矩阵固定的情况下改变起始分布，测试IBU迭代是否收敛；强子化系统（测量时）通过使用替代发生器来改变响应矩阵本身。先验敏感性并不部分涵盖强子化系统，并且不得如此解释（参见下面对强子化系统的讨论）。This is the dominant measured systematic uncertainty. The APACIC prior variation uses the clusterhadronization truth spectrum as an alternative prior, which changes the collinear and back-to-back regions more than the flat prior. This probes prior sensitivity (IBU convergence properties), not hadronization model dependence. The prior sensitivity and hadronization model systematics are orthogonal: the prior sensitivity varies the starting distribution while keeping the QQPS response matrix fixed, testing whether the IBU iteration has converged; the hadronization systematic (when measured) varies the response matrix itself by using an alternative generator. The prior sensitivity does not partially cover the hadronization systematic and must not be interpreted as such (see the discussion of the hadronization systematic below).

217

D.5.5 角度分辨率D.5.5 Angular resolution

来源编号：Source number: 19. 方法：Method:应用 0.5 mrad 的附加高斯涂抹Apply an additional Gaussian smearing of 0.5 mrad to theθ和andϕ在对角度计算之前计算各个轨道的角度，然后重新运行完整的校正链。angles of individual tracks before pair angle computation, then rerun the full correction chain.平均相对影响：Mean relative impact:3.9%。3.9%.

DELPHI TPC 提供的单轨角分辨率为The DELPHI TPC provides a single-track angular resolution of∼,0.2 mrad（极角）,0.2 mrad in polar angleθ和and∼,0.3 mrad 方位角,0.3 mrad in azimuthal angleϕ用于孤立的高动量轨道（DELPHI 检测器性能，Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 378, 57 (1996)）。对于较低动量的轨道以及附近存在撞击的情况，分辨率会降低。两个中每个轨道应用 0.5 mrad 高斯涂抹for isolated high-momentum tracks (DELPHI detector performance, Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 378, 57 (1996)). For lower-momentum tracks and in the presence of nearby hits, the resolution degrades. The 0.5 mrad Gaussian smearing applied per track in bothθ和andϕ大约代表标称单轨分辨率的两倍，保守地考虑了密集环境中分辨率下降的情况。观察结果证实了这一点，0.5 mrad 涂抹产生了物理上平滑的冲击剖面，而 1.0 mrad 涂抹（标称分辨率的 5 倍）产生了异常大的冲击（平均值为 10.4%），因为它超过了背靠背区域中最窄的箱宽度（0.22 mrad），产生了人工箱迁移效应，而不是真正的探测器分辨率效应。减少的 0.5 mrad 拖尾给出了物理上合理的冲击曲线：represents approximately twice the nominal single-track resolution, conservatively accounting for resolution degradation in dense environments. This is verified by the observation that the 0.5 mrad smearing produces a physically smooth impact profile, while a 1.0 mrad smearing (5 times the nominal resolution) yielded an anomalously large impact (10.4% mean) because it exceeded the narrowest bin widths in the back-to-back region (0.22 mrad), producing artificial bin migration effects rather than a genuine detector resolution effect. The reduced 0.5 mrad smearing gives a physically reasonable impact profile:

This is expected: BBB applies per-bin correction factors that do not account for bin migration, while IBU iteratively redistributes events across bins. With prototype statistics, the response matrix noise affects both methods differently. The BBB cross-check therefore demonstrates qualitative agreement (mean relative difference 2.7%) but cannot serve as a quantitative validation at prototype scale.

D.7 统计方法D.7 Statistical method

D.7.1 统计不确定性D.7.1 Statistical uncertainties

统计不确定性通过引导重采样计算：Statistical uncertainties are computed via bootstrap resampling:

  1. 对于 100 个副本中的每一个，数据 EEC 直方图使用高斯重采样以及第 3 阶段测量的统计误差（逐个事件方差）逐个箱地波动。For each of 100 replicas, the data EEC histogram is fluctuated bin-by-bin using Gaussian resampling with the measured statistical error from Phase 3 (event-by-event variance).

  2. 每个波动分布都经过完整的校正链（假减法、IBU、效率校正、归一化）。Each fluctuated distribution is passed through the full correction chain (fake subtraction, IBU, efficiency correction, normalization).

  3. 协方差矩阵是根据展开的副本的分布计算的。The covariance matrix is computed from the distribution of unfolded replicas.

平均统计不确定性（活动箱）：3Mean statistical uncertainty (active bins): 3. 5 × 10 [−][2]（绝对），对应于[2] (absolute), corresponding to∼,5–30% 的相对不确定性取决于箱。这主要是由于原型样本量较小。,5–30% relative uncertainty depending on the bin. This is dominated by the small prototype sample size.

限制：Limitation:引导副本计数 (100) 小于活动 bin 的数量 (108)。因此，统计协方差矩阵是缺乏秩的，108 个活动箱的秩最多为 100。因此，总协方差矩阵（统计加上六个 1 阶系统外积）实际上是奇异的，并且不应该被求逆：The bootstrap replica count (100) is less than the number of active bins (108). The statistical covariance matrix is therefore rank-deficient, with rank at most 100 for the 108 active bins. Consequently, the total covariance matrix (statistical plus six rank-1 systematic outer products) is effectively singular and should not be inverted forχ[2] 原型规模的计算。仅对角线不确定性可用于定量检验。通过完整的统计，将使用 500 多个副本来确保满秩的良好条件统计协方差。[2] calculations at prototype scale. Only diagonal uncertainties should be used for quantitative tests. With full statistics, 500+ replicas will be used to ensure a well-conditioned statistical covariance with full rank.

每个系统源由一个移位向量表示Each systematic source is represented by a shift vectorδk εδk ∈R[130] 。每个源的系统协方差是外积（每个源完全相关）：R[130] . 高条件数 (3The high condition number (3. 6 ×10[19] ）表明协方差逆在原型规模上数值不稳定。当引导副本计数 (100) 小于活动 bin 的数量 (108) 并且 6 个 Rank-1 系统外积占主导地位时，这是预期的。具有完整的统计数据（10[19] ) indicates that the covariance inverse is numerically unstable at prototype scale. 系统不确定性不会传播到原型规模的 AEEC。Systematic uncertainties are not propagated to the AEEC at prototype scale.原则上，EEC 系统移位向量传播到 AEEC 为In principle, EEC systematic shift vectors propagate to the AEEC asδAEEC（AEEC(χ）=) =δ欧洲经济共同体（EEC(π−χ ) −δ欧洲经济共同体（EEC(χ），但由此产生的 AEEC 系统协方差将主要由相关前向箱和镜像箱之间的取消决定，而原型协方差很难确定这些取消。因此，AEEC 是作为交叉检查演示呈现的，而不是最终结果。全面的统计分析将把AEEC提升为具有完全传播的系统不确定性的二级测量。), but the resulting AEEC systematic covariance would be dominated by cancellations between correlated forward and mirrored bins that are poorly determined with the prototype covariance. The AEEC is therefore presented as a crosscheck demonstration, not a final result. The full-statistics analysis will promote the AEEC to a secondary measurement with fully propagated systematic uncertainties.

The closure testχ[2] 分母使用 MC 真值统计不确定性，其中 12,384 个 MC 事件和 108 个 bin 给出[2] denominator uses the MC truth statistical uncertainty, which with 12,384 MC events and 108 bins givesO每个箱 (100) 个条目。然而，响应矩阵本身也是根据这些相同的 MC 事件进行估计的，从而在展开过程中引入了额外的统计不确定性，而该不确定性并未在(100) entries per bin. This MC statistical uncertainty in the response matrix inflates the test statistic beyond what the truth-level statistical error alone would predict.

The per-bin truth uncertainty also decreases by the same factor. D.11 结论D.11 Conclusions

带电粒子两点能量-能量相关器的原型测量是使用来自 DELPHI 实验的大约 8,600 个强子 Z 衰变事件进行的。A prototype measurement of the charged-particle two-point energy-energy correlator is performed using approximately 8,600 hadronic Z decay events from the DELPHI experiment at[√] s = 91 .2吉伏。测量覆盖了 108 个角度箱2 GeV. The measurement covers 108 angular bins spanningχ εχ ∈ [0 . 006 , 3 .139] rad，涵盖共线、体积和背靠背运动区域。139] rad, encompassing the collinear, bulk, and back-to-back kinematic regions.

主要发现是：The key findings are:

  1. EEC 显示了预期的物理特征。The EEC shows the expected physical features.共线幂律增强、体积平台和背靠背苏达科夫峰都在展开光谱中清晰地解析。The collinear power-law enhancement, bulk plateau, and back-to-back Sudakov peak are all clearly resolved in the unfolded spectrum.

  2. 展开的框架已得到验证。The unfolding framework is validated.4 次迭代的迭代贝叶斯展开成功地校正了检测器效应。平坦先验敏感性测试确认所有 108 个活动箱都是先验不敏感的（Iterative Bayesian unfolding with 4 iterations successfully corrects for detector effects. The BBB cross-check agrees with IBU within 2.7% on average in the valid region (62% of bins).

  3. 评估了六个系统来源。Six systematic sources are evaluated.先验灵敏度 (4.9%)、角分辨率 (3.9%)、正则化 (3.4%)、轨迹Prior sensitivity (4.9%), angular resolution (3.9%), regularization (3.4%), trackpT切割（3.3%）、邻近切割（2.7%）和跟踪效率（0.7%）。总测量系统不确定度为cut (3.3%), proximity cut (2.7%), and tracking efficiency (0.7%). The total measured systematic uncertainty is∼,12%（平均相对）。,12% (mean relative).

CMS 运行 1 结果为The CMS Run 1 result at[√] s= 7 + 8 TeV，使用完整的 2011 年和 2012 年数据集（大约 5 fb= 7 + 8 TeV, using the full 2011 and 2012 datasets (approximately 5 fb[−][1] 7 TeV 和 20 fb[1] at 7 TeV and 20 fb[−][1] 在 8 TeV），获得[1] at 8 TeV), obtainedµ = 0 . 78 ± 0 .27 与 3.227 with 3.2σ的证据evidence for theH → ττ信号。本分析综合了所有signal. This analysis combined allττ最终状态（final states (eµ , τheτh , 微小时µτh , τhτh）与基于射流的事件分类（0-射流、1-射流增强、VBF 2-射流）并使用 SVfit 算法进行 di-) with jet-based event categorization (0-jet, 1-jet boosted, VBF 2-jet) and used the SVfit algorithm for di-τ大规模重建。观察于mass reconstruction. The observation at> 5 σ13 TeV Run 2 数据集取得了显着的效果。significance was achieved with the 13 TeV Run 2 dataset.

范围和目标Scope and Goals该分析使用 2012 年质子-质子碰撞的 CMS 开放数据This analysis uses CMS Open Data from 2012 proton–proton collisions at[√] s= 8 TeV，对应于积分光度= 8 TeV, corresponding to an integrated luminosity ofL = 11 .6 FB6 fb[−][1] 来自 Run2012B 和 Run2012C 数据采集期。这些数据以缩减的 NanoAOD 外展文件形式提供，由 CMS 开放数据团队使用 AOD2NanoAOD 外展工具生成。[1] from the Run2012B and Run2012C data-taking periods. The data are provided as reduced NanoAOD outreach files produced by the CMS Open Data team using the AOD2NanoAOD outreach tool.

主要目标是：The primary goals are:

  1. 测量信号强度调节器Measure the signal strength modifierµ = σ观测值obs/σSM 用于希格斯玻色子的产生SM for Higgs boson production in the微小时µτh使用适合可见 di-tau 质量分布的分箱模板的最终状态。final state using a binned template fit to the visible di-tau mass distribution.

  2. 按照 CMS 参考分析建立的标准评估系统不确定性。Evaluate systematic uncertainties following the standards established by CMS reference analyses.

  3. 通过信号注入测试、阿西莫夫拟合和交叉检查分析来验证统计模型。Validate the statistical model through signal injection tests, Asimov fits, and cross-check analyses.

  4. 记录完整的分析工作流程，作为 CMS 开放数据分析的参考。Document the complete analysis workflow as a reference for CMS Open Data analyses.

与完整的 CMS 相比，分析被有意简化The analysis is intentionally simplified compared to the full CMSH → ττ分析：使用单个包容性事件类别（没有基于喷射的分类），使用可见质量而不是 SVfit 质量，并且仅使用analysis: a single inclusive event category is used (without jet-based categorization), the visible mass is used instead of the SVfit mass, and only the微小时µτh渠道进行了分析。这些简化降低了预期的灵敏度channel is analyzed. These simplifications reduce the expected sensitivity fromσμ ≈σµ ≈ 0 .27（完整的 CMS 分析）至27 (full CMS analysis) toσμ ≈σµ ≈ 5 .6（本分析），但保留了完整的统计框架和系统的不确定性处理。6 (this analysis), but the full statistical framework and systematic uncertainty treatment are preserved.

  • 胶子-胶子融合 (ggH)：Gluon–gluon fusion (ggH): σ ggH = 19 .NNLO+NNLL QCD 处的 3 pb，带有 NLO EW 校正（LHC 希格斯截面工作组 YR3），给出3 pb at NNLO+NNLL QCD with NLO EW corrections (LHC Higgs Cross Section Working Group YR3), givingσ格赫ggH×BR（BR(H → ττ ) = 1 .22 铅。22 pb.

  • 矢量玻色子融合（VBF）：Vector boson fusion (VBF): σ VBF = 1 .NLO QCD 处为 58 pb，经过 NLO EW 校正，给出58 pb at NLO QCD with NLO EW corrections, givingσ VBF ×BR（BR(H → ττ ) = 0 .10 PB。10 pb.

E.0.5 修正和信号提取策略E.0.5 Corrections and Signal Extraction Strategy

该分析测量信号强度调节器This analysis measures the signal strength modifierµ = σ观测值obs/σSM 通过分箱模板拟合探测器级可见的 di-tau 质量分布。不应用展开或接受校正：模板拟合直接比较观察到的结果SM via a binned template fit to the detectorlevel visible di-tau mass distribution. No unfolding or acceptance correction is applied: the template fit directly compares the observedm可见光谱到检测器级 MC 模板，用于信号和背景处理。信号效率和接受度被吸收到 MC 模拟的信号模板中，这意味着测量的vis spectrum to detector-level MC templates for signal and background processes. The signal efficiency and acceptance are absorbed into the signal template from MC simulation, meaning the measuredµ表示在所有选择和检测器效应之后观察到的事件率与预测的事件率的比率。represents the ratio of observed to predicted event rates after all selection and detector effects.

这种方法是大型强子对撞机希格斯玻色子信号强度测量的标准技术，避免了展开的复杂性。然而，这意味着结果取决于信号接受和探测器响应的 MC 模型。特别是，信号This approach is the standard technique for Higgs boson signal strength measurements at the LHC and avoids the complexities of unfolding. However, it means the result depends on the MC model of signal acceptance and detector response. In particular, the signalmvis 形状完全取自 Powheg+Pythia6 模拟，以及希格斯玻色子的任何错误建模vis shape is taken entirely from Powheg+Pythia6 simulation, and any mismodeling of the HiggspT频谱或spectrum orτ衰变运动学会影响提取的decay kinematics would affect the extractedµ。这是一个已知的限制，部分由 tau 能量尺度系统不确定性（第 E.0.7 节）和信号横截面不确定性（第 E.0.7 节）覆盖。在全面分析中，发电机建模系统（替代发电机、帕顿簇射变化）将提供额外的覆盖范围；在这里，每个进程只有一个生成器可用，这被记录为限制。. This is a known limitation, partially covered by the tau energy scale systematic uncertainty (sec. E.0.7) and the signal cross-section uncertainties (sec. E.0.7). In a full analysis, generator modeling systematics (alternative generators, parton shower variations) would provide additional coverage; here, only a single generator is available per process, and this is documented as a limitation.

This sideband is not implemented as a separate control region because themT <定义信号区域的 50 GeV 要求通过构造排除了这些事件。相反，W+jets 归一化被视为模板拟合中的约束干扰参数，遵循 CMS 中的标准方法50 GeV requirement defining the signal region excludes these events by construction. Instead, the W+jets normalization is treated as a constrained nuisance parameter in the template fit, following the standard approach in CMSH → ττ分析：analyses: themW+射流（广泛、无特征）和 DY（峰值为 60-80 GeV）之间的可见形状差异为 W+射流归一化提供了隐含的约束。vis shape difference between W+jets (broad, featureless) and DY (peaked at 60–80 GeV) provides implicit constraint on the W+jets normalization.

数据/MC比较Data/MC Comparison所有运动学变量的数据/MC 比较显示出一致的行为：The data/MC comparison across all kinematic variables shows consistent behavior:

  • 标准化：Normalization:总 MC 超出数据Total MC overshoots data by∼15%，数据/MC 比率持平15%, with the data/MC ratio flat at∼ 0 .所有发行版中有 87 个。87 across all distributions.

  • 形状：Shape:没有观察到明显的形状差异。所有变量中的数据/MC 比率都是平坦的（无斜率或结构），表明模板具有正确的形状，仅需要调整其归一化。No significant shape discrepancy is observed. The data/MC ratio is flat (no slope or structure) in all variables, indicating that the templates have the correct shapes and only their normalizations need adjustment.

对于模板拟合分析来说，这种程度的预拟合不一致是预期的并且是可接受的。归一化偏移的主要来源是：This level of pre-fit disagreement is expected and acceptable for a template fit analysis. The dominant sources of the normalization offset are:

  • W+喷气机 LO 横截面高估（W+jets LO cross-section overestimate (∼对 12.8% 的背景进行 30% 的校正，占30% correction on 12.8% of background, accounting for∼ 3 .偏移量的 8%）。8% of the offset).

  • DY 标准化 (DY normalization (∼对 74% 的背景进行 5% 的校正，占5% correction on 74% of background, accounting for∼ 3 .偏移量的 7%）。7% of the offset).

  • QCD 估计（QCD estimation (fOS/SS 不确定性，高达OS/SS uncertainty, up to∼占总数的5%）。5% of total).

DY 和 W+jets 归一化都是模板拟合中的自由浮动或约束参数，这将吸收归一化偏移。Both DY and W+jets normalizations are free-floating or constrained parameters in the template fit, which will absorb the normalization offset.

importpyhf
importjson

withopen("phase4_inference/exec/workspace.json")asf:
workspace=json.load(f)

model=pyhf.Workspace(workspace).model()
data=pyhf.Workspace(workspace).data(model)
result=pyhf.infer.mle.fit(data,model,return_uncertainties=True)

直方图Histograms原始直方图（OS 和 SS、每个样本、每个变量）以 NumPy 格式存储在：The raw histograms (OS and SS, per sample, per variable) are stored in NumPy format at:

phase3_selection/exec/histograms.npz

拟合结果Fit Results完整的拟合结果（最佳拟合参数、干扰参数拉动和约束、信号注入测试结果以及拟合优度指标）存储在：The complete fit results (best-fit parameters, nuisance parameter pulls and constraints, signal injection test results, and goodness-of-fit metrics) are stored at:

phase4_inference/exec/fit_results.json
